elementId.description: Optional. The element to retrieve context dependent autotext keys for (its own properties, plus the ones common to all element types, e.g. 'Element ID', 'Area'). When omitted, only the property based autotext keys common to all element types are returned. The other autotexts (Project Info, layout, drawing, date, ...) are returned either way.

key.description: The autotext's key. To embed it in the content of a Text or Label element, surround it with '<' and '>', e.g. '<PROJECTNAME>' or '<PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548>'.

name.description: The autotext's name, as shown in the Insert Autotext dialog of Archicad.

GetAutoTextName.description: Retrieves the display names of one or more autotext keys (as returned inside a '<...>' embedded key), with a direct guid lookup for property-based keys instead of enumerating every property definition.
GetAutoTextName.name: GetAutoTextName

keys.description: Autotext keys as returned by GetAutoTextKeys or GetProjectInfoFields (without the surrounding '<' and '>'), e.g. 'PROPERTY-69A58F6F-DD3B-478D-B5EF-09A16BD0C548' or 'PROJECTNAME'.

GetAvailableLibraryParts.description: Lists library parts currently available to the project. Filter by typeId (e.g. 'Door', 'Window', 'Object', 'Lamp').
GetAvailableLibraryParts.name: GetAvailableLibraryParts

filterByTypeId.description: Optional. Filter by libpart type (matches the value returned by LibPartTypeIdToString).

skippedCount.description: Library parts that ACAPI_LibraryPart_Get failed to read. Non-zero means the inventory is partial.

skippedSample.description: First five failed indices with their ACAPI error code, for diagnostic.

GetBodyMaterialsOfElements.description: Gets the building material of each body of the 3D model of the given elements. The 3D model is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so a composite structure has one body per skin and the 3D window is not changed. The output is aligned with the input array of elements. Available from Archicad 28.
GetBodyMaterialsOfElements.name: GetBodyMaterialsOfElements

bodyMaterials.description: The bodies of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

bodies.description: The bodies of the element's 3D model generated with separate components: a composite structure has one body per skin. Empty when the element has no 3D model.

bodyIndex.description: The index of the body in the element, starting from 0.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material of the body. Left out when it cannot be found among the attributes of the project.

buildingMaterialName.description: The name of the building material. Left out together with buildingMaterialId.

GetBuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties.description: Retrieves the physical properties of the given Building Materials.
GetBuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties.name: GetBuildingMaterialPhysicalProperties

GetBuildingMaterials.description: Returns the details of the given Building Material attributes.
GetBuildingMaterials.name: GetBuildingMaterials

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Building Material. If omitted, every field is returned.

buildingMaterials.description: A list of building materials or errors.

GetCalculatedParametersOfCurtainWallSubE.description: Gets the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given Curtain Wall Frame, Panel, Junction and Accessory elements as Archicad calculated them for their place in the curtain wall. GetGDLParametersOfElements returns the parameters the sub-element was set up with instead.
GetCalculatedParametersOfCurtainWallSubE.name: GetCalculatedParametersOfCurtainWallSubElements

calculatedParametersOfElements.description: The calculated parameters of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not a curtain wall frame, panel, junction or accessory.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the sub-element as Archicad calculated them for its place in the curtain wall.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

displayName.description: The display name of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

value.description: The value of the parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for length values.

roundInch.description: Fractional inches.

GetCameras.description: Gets the Camera Sets (camera paths) of the project with their name, whether the set is the active one, its current camera, and its cameras in path order. Each camera has its element id, whether it is active in the path, and its perspective: camera and target position, distance, azimuth, view cone, roll angle, two-point perspective and sun, in the shape Set3DProjectionSettings accepts, so passing a camera's perspective there shows its view in the 3D window. Archicad cameras are always perspective; they have no name of their own.
GetCameras.name: GetCameras

cameraSets.description: The Camera Sets (camera paths) of the project, each with its cameras.

activeCameraElementId.description: The current camera of the set. Missing when the set has none.

cameras.description: The cameras of the set, in the order of the path.

isActiveInPath.description: True when the camera is active in the path of its Camera Set.

perspective.description: The perspective of the camera, in the shape Set3DProjectionSettings accepts as its perspective, so passing it there shows the camera's view in the 3D window.

isActive.description: True for the active Camera Set.

name.description: The name of the Camera Set, as the navigator shows it.

GetCategoryValuesOfDefaults.description: Gets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the tool defaults of the given element types, the values new elements of the type get, optionally only for the given category types. A category the default has no value in is listed without categoryValueId; an element type without any of the requested categories gets an error item. The names are localized: use the type and the categoryValueId in scripts.
GetCategoryValuesOfDefaults.name: GetCategoryValuesOfDefaults

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category of the project.

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

categoryValuesOfDefaults.description: The category values of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the input. A category Archicad cannot read for the type is left out of its list; an invalid element type, or one with none of the requested categories, is represented by an error object.

categoryValueId.description: Left out when the default has no value in this category.

name.description: The localized name of the value, for display only. Left out when the default has no value in this category.

GetCategoryValuesOfElements.description: Gets the category values (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status ...) of the given elements, optionally only for the given category types. An element that has none of the requested categories (an annotation, for example) gets an error item. The names are localized: use the type and the categoryValueId in scripts.
GetCategoryValuesOfElements.name: GetCategoryValuesOfElements

categories.description: The categories to read. Left out: every category the element has.

categoryValuesOfElements.description: The category values of each element, in the order of the input. A category the element does not have is left out of its list; an element that does not exist or has none of the requested categories (an annotation, for example) is represented by an error object.

GetClassificationItemParents.description: Returns the parent item and the classification system of the given Classification Items; a top level item has no parent. The output is aligned with the input array of items.
GetClassificationItemParents.name: GetClassificationItemParents

classificationItemParents.description: The parent and the system of each given item, in the order of the input. A non-existing item is an error item.

GetClassificationItemVisibility.description: Tells whether the given classification items are visible (offered) for the given elements, element tool defaults and attributes, such as building materials. Non-existing targets and classification items are reported as errors. Visibility does not tell whether the target is classified with the item, and an item can be visible even if its parent item is not.
GetClassificationItemVisibility.name: GetClassificationItemVisibility

targets.description: The elements, element tool defaults and attributes to check the classification items for.

elementType.description: The tool default of this element type is checked.

classificationItemVisibilities.description: One entry per target, in the order of the input. A non-existing element or attribute, or an invalid element type, is represented by an error object.

GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem.description: Returns the classification of the given attributes (for example Building Materials) in the given classification system. classificationItemId is omitted for an unclassified attribute.
GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem.name: GetClassificationOfAttributesInSystem

attributeClassifications.description: Order of the items is the same as in the input. classificationItemId is omitted when the attribute is unclassified in the system. Non-existing attributes or a non-existing classification system are represented by error objects.

GetClassificationsOfAttributes.description: Returns the classifications of the given attributes (building materials, composites, surfaces, etc.) in every classification system they are classified in.
GetClassificationsOfAttributes.name: GetClassificationsOfAttributes

attributeClassifications.description: The classifications of the attributes, in the order of the input. A non-existing attribute is represented by an error object.

GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults.description: Returns the classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types in the given classification systems.
GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults.name: GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

elementDefaultClassifications.description: Order of the outer list is that of the given element types, the inner list that of the given classification systems. Invalid element types or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

GetClassificationsOfElements.description: Returns the classification of the given elements in the given classification systems. It works for subelements of hierarchal elements also.
GetClassificationsOfElements.name: GetClassificationsOfElements

elementClassifications.description: Order of the ids are the same as in the input. Non-existing elements or non-existing classification systems are represented by error objects.

GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults.description: Returns every classification of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, in all classification systems at once. Unlike GetClassificationsOfElementDefaults it needs no list of classification systems; systems in which a default is unclassified are left out.
GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults.name: GetClassificationsOfToolDefaults

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

classificationsOfToolDefaults.description: The classifications of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

GetCollisions.description: Detect collisions between the given two groups of elements.
GetCollisions.name: GetCollisions

performSurfaceCheck.description: Enables surface collision check. If disabled the surfaceTolerance value will be ignored. By default it's false.

surfaceTolerance.description: Intersection body surface area greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

volumeTolerance.description: Intersection body volume greater then this value will be considered as a collision. Default value is 0.001.

GetCommands.description: Retrieves every command of the Tapir Add-On with its command group, the Tapir version it was introduced in and its description, so a script can check that a command exists before calling it.
GetCommands.name: GetCommands

commands.description: Every command of the Tapir Add-On, in the order of the command reference.

description.description: The description of the command, as in the command reference.

group.description: The name of the command group, e.g. "Application Commands".

name.description: The name of the command.

version.description: The Tapir version the command was introduced in, in the form of "1.1.1".

GetCommentsFromIssue.description: Retrieves comments information from the specified issue.
GetCommentsFromIssue.name: GetCommentsFromIssue

GetComponentsOfElements.description: Returns the components of the elements: the building material skins of composite walls, slabs, roofs and shells, and the parts of complex profile walls, beams and columns. The components have their own property values (building material, thickness, area, volume and the properties of the building material); read them with GetPropertyValuesOfElementComponents.
GetComponentsOfElements.name: GetComponentsOfElements

componentsOfElements.description: The components of each element, in the order of the given elements. Each component id carries the element id too, so the items can be passed on to GetPropertyValuesOfElementComponents as they are.

GetComposites.description: Returns the details of the given Composite attributes.
GetComposites.name: GetComposites

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Composite. If omitted, every field is returned.

composites.description: A list of composites or errors.

GetConnectedElements.description: Gets the elements hosted by (connected to) the given owner elements, filtered to the given element type: for example the Windows or Doors of a Wall, the frames, panels, junctions and accessories of a Curtain Wall, the risers, treads and structures of a Stair, or the posts, rails and panels of a Railing.
GetConnectedElements.name: GetConnectedElements

connectedElementType.description: The type of the connected elements to collect, e.g. Window or Door for a Wall owner, or a subelement type of a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing owner.

elements.description: The owner (host) elements whose connected elements are collected, e.g. Walls, Curtain Walls, Stairs or Railings.

GetContainingDatabases.description: Returns the database (window type, database id and name) that contains each of the given elements, from any database, not only the current one. Pass the windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it, for example to find an element placed on a layout.
GetContainingDatabases.name: GetContainingDatabases

databases.description: The database of each element, in the order of the input elements. Pass windowType and databaseId to ChangeWindow to open it.

GetCoordinateOrigins.description: Gets the offset of the virtual coordinate system origin from the world origin, and the user origin of the current database. Use it to tell which origin the coordinates of different sources (elements, views, survey point) are relative to.
GetCoordinateOrigins.name: GetCoordinateOrigins

userOrigin.description: The user origin of the current database, relative to the origin of the virtual coordinate system. Missing when the current window has none (only floor plan, section, detail and 3D windows have one).

virtualOriginOffset.description: The offset of the origin of the virtual coordinate system from the world origin. Archicad sets it after a project is opened when the model is far from the world origin. Missing when Archicad does not return it for the current window.

GetCurrentAnalyticalModel.description: Retrieves the Structural Analytical Model created for the current view. Available from Archicad 27.
GetCurrentAnalyticalModel.name: GetCurrentAnalyticalModel

analyticalModelId.description: The identifier of the Structural Analytical Model of the current view.

GetCurrentLayerCombination.description: Returns the layer combination in effect in the current window. No layer combination is returned when the current state of the layers matches none.
GetCurrentLayerCombination.name: GetCurrentLayerCombination

layerCombinationId.description: The layer combination in effect in the current window. Missing when the current state of the layers matches no layer combination.

name.description: The name of the layer combination. Missing together with layerCombinationId.

GetCurrentPenTable.description: Returns the current Pen Table (its index, attribute identifier and name) and its number of pens. Pass the returned attributeId to GetPenTables to read the pens.
GetCurrentPenTable.name: GetCurrentPenTable

index.description: The attribute index of the current Pen Table, as returned by Archicad.

isPenTableAttribute.description: True if the index refers to an existing Pen Table attribute. When false, attributeId and name are omitted; the pens in effect can not be read with GetPenTables.

name.description: The name of the current Pen Table attribute.

penCount.description: The number of pens in the current Pen Table. Omitted when it can not be read.

GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts.description: Retrieves all changes belong to the last revision of the given layouts.
GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts.name: GetCurrentRevisionChangesOfLayouts

GetCurrentTool.description: Returns the tool active in the Toolbox: its element type, its variation (the subtype, e.g. Door, Skylight or a library part subtype of an add-on) and, for the tools of add-ons, its class id, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts. Nothing is returned when the active tool makes no element, e.g. the Arrow or the Marquee.
GetCurrentTool.name: GetCurrentTool

returns.description: The tool active in the Toolbox, in the form SetCurrentTool accepts. Empty when the active tool makes no element, e.g. the Arrow or the Marquee.

classId.description: The class id (a guid) of the tool of an add-on, whose elementType is Unknown. Archicad 26 and later.

elementType.description: The element type of the tool. Unknown for the tools of add-ons, which classId identifies.

variation.description: The four-character subtype of the tool, e.g. DOOR, SKYL, CRWD, or the signature of a library part subtype registered by an add-on. Missing for the generic tool of the element type.

GetCurrentViewImage.description: Returns what the 3D window, or the PhotoRendering window, shows as a base64 encoded png or jpg image with its size in pixels, without writing a file. Available from Archicad 30.
GetCurrentViewImage.name: GetCurrentViewImage

height.description: The height of the image in pixels.

image.description: The base64 encoded image, in the requested format.

width.description: The width of the image in pixels.

GetCurrentWindowDrawingScale.description: Returns the drawing scale of the current (active) window, the scale shown in the bottom bar, as its denominator: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Unlike GetViewSettings it needs no saved view. It reads the scale of the current database: the floor plan, a section, elevation, interior elevation, detail, worksheet or 3D document window, each of which has its own. Layouts always return 1.0.
GetCurrentWindowDrawingScale.name: GetCurrentWindowDrawingScale

scale.description: The denominator of the drawing scale of the current window: 100.0 for 1:100, 20.0 for 1:20. Always 1.0 for layouts.

GetCurrentWindowType.description: Returns the type of the current (active) window and, when it has one, the databaseId of the database it shows, which ChangeWindow takes to bring the window back after a script switched to another one. The saved view (View Map item) the window was opened from is not returned, as Archicad does not tell which one it was.
GetCurrentWindowType.name: GetCurrentWindowType

databaseId.description: The database shown in the current (active) window, the same id GetDatabases and GetContainingDatabases return. Pass it to ChangeWindow to bring this window back. Missing when the window has no database of its own that can be identified, for example a report, a rendering or a custom add-on window. The saved view (View Map item) the window was opened from is not returned: Archicad does not tell which one it was, and several saved views can show the same database.

GetCurtainWallAbsoluteBottoms.description: Gets the absolute bottom level of curtain walls or their subelements (segments, frames, panels, junctions, accessories). The output is aligned with the input array of elements.
GetCurtainWallAbsoluteBottoms.name: GetCurtainWallAbsoluteBottoms

absoluteBottoms.description: The absolute bottom of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

GetCustomCurveMemberStretch.description: Retrieves the lengths added to the start and end of the given curve members. Available from Archicad 29.
GetCustomCurveMemberStretch.name: GetCustomCurveMemberStretch

stretches.description: The custom stretch of the curve member of each element, in the order of the input. An element the stretch cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

GetCutPolygonsOfElements.description: Cuts each body of the 3D model of the given elements with a plane and returns, for each body, its building material, the area of the cut surface and its polygons (outline and holes) in 2D coordinates of the plane. From Archicad 28 the 3D model is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so a composite structure has one body per skin and the 3D window is not changed. Before Archicad 28 the bodies are those of the element's 3D model (a composite structure is one body) and their building materials are left out. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.
GetCutPolygonsOfElements.name: GetCutPolygonsOfElements

cutPlane.description: The cutting plane. axisX, axisY and axisZ should be unit vectors perpendicular to each other; axisZ is the normal of the plane.

axisX.description: The direction of the x axis of the returned 2D coordinates.

axisY.description: The direction of the y axis of the returned 2D coordinates.

basePoint.description: A point of the plane, the origin of the returned 2D coordinates.

cutPolygons.description: The cut of each body of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

bodies.description: The bodies of the element's 3D model generated with separate components: a composite structure has one body per skin. Empty when the element has no 3D model.

area.description: The area of the cut surface of the body. 0 when the plane does not cut the body.

bodyIndex.description: The index of the body in the element, starting from 0.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material of the body. Left out when it cannot be found among the attributes of the project.

buildingMaterialName.description: The name of the building material. Left out together with buildingMaterialId.

polygons.description: The polygons of the cut surface of the body, in 2D coordinates of the plane (basePoint, axisX, axisY). Curved edges are given by their end points. Empty when the plane does not cut the body.

GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId.description: Gets the ID of the database associated with the supplied navigator item id
GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId.name: GetDatabaseIdFromNavigatorItemId

GetDatabases.description: Lists every database of the given types (sections, elevations, interior elevations, details, worksheets, 3D documents, layouts, master layouts) with its database ID, name and reference ID, without walking the navigator trees.
GetDatabases.name: GetDatabases

types.description: The types of the databases to list. Optional, by default the databases of every type are listed.

GetDescriptorsOfElements.description: Gets the descriptors of the given elements: the listing descriptors in the property objects of each element, with the library part that declares them (index, name and guid), their listing database set and index, and their status (Normal, Deleted or Local). The output is aligned with the input array of elements.
GetDescriptorsOfElements.name: GetDescriptorsOfElements

descriptorsOfElements.description: The descriptors of each element, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews.description: Retrieves which design option combination the given views show: only the main model, a combination, a custom set of design options or a deleted combination. Available from Archicad 27.
GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews.name: GetDesignOptionCombinationOfViews

navigatorItemIds.description: The navigator items of the views (View Map items).

designOptionCombinationId.description: The design option combination the view shows. Given for the Standard status and, on Archicad 27 and 28, also for the Custom status (the combination the custom set was made from). On Archicad 29 and newer it is given only when exactly one combination has the name of the view's settings.

name.description: The name of the design option combination settings of the view, as Archicad reports it.

status.description: MainModelOnly: the view shows only the main model, no design option. Standard: the view shows a design option combination. Custom: the view shows a set of design options modified by the user, without a name. Missing: the combination of the view was deleted.

GetDesignOptionCombinations.description: Retrieves information about existing design option combinations.
GetDesignOptionCombinations.name: GetDesignOptionCombinations

GetDesignOptionForElements.description: Retrieves the design option association for the specified elements. Available from Archicad 29.
GetDesignOptionForElements.name: GetDesignOptionForElements

GetDesignOptionSets.description: Retrieves information about existing design option sets, and in Teamwork projects the Teamwork identifier of the design options. Available from Archicad 29.
GetDesignOptionSets.name: GetDesignOptionSets

designOptionSetId.description: The guid identifier of the design option set.

designOptions.description: The list of design options in the set.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option set can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork).

name.description: The name of the design option set.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option set is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

teamworkId.description: The Teamwork identifier of the project's design options. Present only in Teamwork projects.

GetDesignOptions.description: Retrieves information about existing design options. Available from Archicad 29.
GetDesignOptions.name: GetDesignOptions

GetDetailsOfElements.description: Gets the details of elements (geometry parameters etc). When elements is omitted, all elements matching the optional server-side filter (types, floorIndices, layerIndices) are queried; an empty elements list returns no details. Use the optional fields parameter to return only the fields you need (e.g. elementId, type, id, floorIndex) and skip the computation of the others (for example floorPlanPolygons). Use the optional additionalFields parameter to also get the info string, the compound info string, the library part unique ID and the creator tool unique ID. An element of another database (a layout, a section, a worksheet ...) returns only its header fields (type, floor index, layer, draw index) with fromOtherDatabase set to true.
GetDetailsOfElements.name: GetDetailsOfElements

additionalFields.description: Optional extra fields to return for each element, on top of the ones selected by fields. None of them is returned unless listed here, so callers that do not give this parameter get the same response as before.

elements.description: Optional list of elements to get details for. When omitted, all elements in the current database (optionally filtered by the filter parameter) are used; an empty list returns no details.

fields.description: Optional filter for the fields to return for each element. When omitted, every field is returned. Fields not listed are not computed at all, so listing only what you need skips in particular the floorPlanPolygons extraction, which regenerates each element's 2D drawing primitives and can dominate the execution time of batch reads.

filter.description: Optional server-side filter. Without elements, only the elements matching it are returned. A listed element that does not match it gets an error entry in its place.

detailsOfElements.description: One entry per input element, in the same order as the input elements array. An element that cannot be read, or that does not match the filter, gets an error entry in its place, so the position of an entry tells which input element it belongs to. Without elements, one entry per element that matches the filter.

GetDialogAutoClose.description: Tells whether the dialog auto close is on, the same state SetDialogAutoClose writes, so a script can restore it afterwards. The state belongs to the running Archicad process: it is off when Archicad starts (unless the TAPIR_DIALOG_AUTOCLOSE environment variable is true), it stays as last set until Archicad quits, and it is shared by every add-on and script in that Archicad.
GetDialogAutoClose.name: GetDialogAutoClose

enabled.description: Whether the dialog auto close is on: true while Archicad closes the dialogs it would show with their default button instead of waiting for the user. This is the same state SetDialogAutoClose writes.

GetDimensionData.description: Gets the data of existing dimension chains: the line pen, the marker type and pen and the default witness line, and per witness point the coordinates, measured value, witness line and the text height, pen and frame.
GetDimensionData.name: GetDimensionData

elements.description: The identifier of the dimension elements.

GetDimensionStandards.description: Gets the dimension standards of the project (Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions) with their name and the unit, decimals and rounding of each dimension type, optionally only the one with the given name. Read-only. Available from Archicad 27.
GetDimensionStandards.name: GetDimensionStandards

name.description: Only the dimension standard with this name is returned (case-sensitive). The list is empty when no standard has this name.

items.description: A dimension standard of the project, as listed in Options > Project Preferences > Dimensions.

index.description: The 1-based index of the dimension standard.

name.description: The name of the dimension standard, as the dimensionStyle of GetViewSettings and SetViewSettings.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.
Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.
Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

roundInch.description: Rounding of fractional inches.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

roundInch.description: Rounding of fractional inches.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

roundInch.description: Rounding of fractional inches.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

roundInch.description: Rounding of fractional inches.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

roundInch.description: Rounding of fractional inches.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Whether trailing zero decimals are hidden.

roundInch.description: Rounding of fractional inches.

showSmall5.description: The extra accuracy (small 5) setting of the displayed values, 0 when off, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroInch.description: Whether zero inches are displayed, as Archicad stores it.

showZeroWhole.description: Whether a zero whole part is displayed.

GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults.description: Gets the defaults a newly created 3D Document starts with: name, reference ID, vectorial hatching and sun shadows, transparency, connection to the model, surfaces, boundary contours and the uniform cut, uncut, shadow and hidden edge attributes.
GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults.name: GetDocumentFrom3DDefaults

boundaryLineType.description: The index of the line type of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

boundaryPen.description: The pen of the boundary contours, used with OverrideContours.

cMater.description: The index of the uniform surface (material), used when materialFrom3D is false.

materialFrom3D.description: Use the surfaces of the 3D model; when false, cMater is used for every element.

name.description: The name of a new 3D Document.

refId.description: The reference ID of a new 3D Document.

GetDrawingContentBoxes.description: Returns the full content box of the given Drawing elements, independent of their frames, as ACAPI_Drawing_GetFullDrawingContentBox reports it. Available from Archicad 27.
GetDrawingContentBoxes.name: GetDrawingContentBoxes

contentBoxes.description: One item per input element, in the same order: the full content box of the Drawing, or an error.

GetDrawingNumberingGridLines.description: Gets the lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout (start and end point, pen index, line type index), for example to find which grid cell a drawing on the layout sits in. The current window must be a layout (see ChangeWindow), and only a layout that uses grid-based drawing numbering has such a grid.
GetDrawingNumberingGridLines.name: GetDrawingNumberingGridLines

lines.description: The lines of the grid of the grid-based drawing numbering of the current layout. Only a layout that uses grid-based drawing numbering has such a grid.

GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements.description: Returns the 2D drawing primitives (points, lines, arcs, texts, polylines, triangles, polygons, pictures) Archicad draws each given floor plan element from, in drawing order, as ACAPI_DrawingPrimitive_ShapePrimsExt decomposes it on every story and unclipped. Control items (type Ctrl_*) mark the beginning and the end of sub-parts such as hatches and texts. Texts are returned without their content and polylines without their vertices. A Ctrl_ElementRef item names the element it refers to: the drawing of a Wall ends with one for each Window and Door in it, while Windows and Doors give no primitives of their own. The floor plan must be the current database. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.
GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements.name: GetDrawingPrimitivesOfElements

drawingPrimitivesOfElements.description: The drawing primitives of each element, in the order of the input elements.

GetEditModeState.description: Tells whether Archicad is in a hierarchical editing mode (curtain wall, stair, beam or column editing), and which element is being edited. Read only: it never enters, leaves or cancels an editing mode. Commands that modify the project can fail while such a mode is active. The overall inEditMode flag requires Archicad 29 or later; the command requires Archicad 27 or later.
GetEditModeState.name: GetEditModeState

inEditMode.description: True when Archicad is in any hierarchical editing mode (curtain wall, stair, railing, beam, column, MEP elements, etc.). Only returned from Archicad 29.

GetElectricalCircuits.description: Gets the given electrical circuits, the circuits of the given panels, or every circuit of the project: name, description, owner panel, connected devices and panels, voltage, phases, wiring type, loads, voltage drop and estimated cable length. Available from Archicad 30.
GetElectricalCircuits.name: GetElectricalCircuits

electricalPanels.description: Optional list of electrical panels whose circuits are returned. When neither elements nor electricalPanels is given, every circuit of every electrical panel of the project is returned.

elements.description: Optional list of electrical circuits.

electricalCircuits.description: The given circuits first, in their order, then the circuits of the given panels, in the order of the panels.

GetElectricalDevices.description: Gets the electrical devices (lights, sockets and other consumers) of the project or the given ones: parent circuit, placement, apparent power, load classification, demand load and directly connected MEP elements. Available from Archicad 30.
GetElectricalDevices.name: GetElectricalDevices

elements.description: Optional list of electrical devices. Every electrical device of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalDevices.description: The electrical devices, in the order of the given elements.

GetElectricalPanels.description: Gets the electrical panels (distribution boards) of the project or the given ones: name, circuit naming, circuits, parent circuit, placement and the connected and demand loads in total and per phase. Available from Archicad 30.
GetElectricalPanels.name: GetElectricalPanels

elements.description: Optional list of electrical panels. Every electrical panel of the project is returned when it is not given.

electricalPanels.description: The electrical panels, in the order of the given elements.

GetElectricalProjectSettings.description: Gets the electrical project settings: the default voltage, the wiring types with their cross-sectional area and the load classifications with their demand factor. Available from Archicad 30.
GetElectricalProjectSettings.name: GetElectricalProjectSettings

voltage.description: The default voltage of the project.

GetElementAtCoordinate.description: Finds the element of the given polygonal type (for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch) at a coordinate of the floor plan of the current database, the way a click there would. Use the optional filters parameter (the values of FilterElements) to consider only, for example, the elements visible by layer, and the optional z parameter to give the elevation of the point. Returns found: false when there is no such element. Useful together with GetPointFromUser.
GetElementAtCoordinate.name: GetElementAtCoordinate

coordinate.description: The point to search at, in the project's coordinates, on the floor plan of the current database.

elementType.description: The type of the element to look for. Only polygonal element types can be searched, for example Slab, Roof, Mesh, Zone or Hatch.

filters.description: Optional. Only an element passing every given filter is found (the same values as FilterElements accepts).

z.description: Optional. The elevation of the search point, handed to Archicad together with the coordinate. Default is 0; without z a point 1 mm higher is also tried, so an element whose top is at 0 (for example a slab at the story level) is found.

elementId.description: The identifier of the found element. Absent when nothing was found.

found.description: True when an element of the given type was found at the coordinate.

GetElementCategories.description: Lists the element categories of the project (Structural Function, Position, Renovation Status, Renovation Filter and, in the German version, BRI) with their possible values. The names of the categories and values are localized: identify a category by its type and a value by its categoryValueId, never by name.
GetElementCategories.name: GetElementCategories

categories.description: The element categories of the project, each with its possible values.

GetElementChangesSince.description: Returns the new, modified and deleted elements between a state captured by CaptureElementState and either another captured state (toStateId) or the current state of the project. Scripts that keep an external copy of the model use it to sync only what changed instead of re-reading every element. The changes come from Archicad's element difference generator, which tracks the model elements: 2D elements such as texts, labels and hatches can be missing from the lists, so read those directly. Fails for a stateId that is unknown - never captured, released, or lost because the project was closed or Archicad restarted.
GetElementChangesSince.name: GetElementChangesSince

stateId.description: The state to compare from, as returned by CaptureElementState.

toStateId.description: The state to compare to, as returned by CaptureElementState with the same type as stateId. If omitted, the current state of the project is used, so the response lists what changed since stateId was captured.

deletedElements.description: The elements that exist in the earlier state but not in the later one. They cannot be read any more, only their identifiers are known.

modifiedElements.description: The elements that exist in both states and changed between them.

newElements.description: The elements that exist in the later state but not in the earlier one.

GetElementConnections.description: Gets the connections among the given elements: each pair of touching elements once, with the polygons of the surface where they touch, in world coordinates. The 3D model of the elements is generated with separate components in a temporary sight, so the 3D window is not changed. Also returns, aligned with the input array of elements, whether each element was found. Available from Archicad 28.
GetElementConnections.name: GetElementConnections

elements.description: The elements to search connections among. Only connections between two of these elements are returned.

connections.description: The connected pairs of the given elements. Each pair appears once.

polygons.description: The polygons of the surface where the two elements touch, in world coordinates. The last point of a polygon repeats its first.

executionResults.description: Aligned with the input array of elements: whether the element was found and taken into the search.

GetElementFromUser.description: Asks the designer to click an element in the current window and returns its id, its type and the clicked point. A click on empty space or on an element of a type not asked for asks again. Archicad waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; cancelling returns cancelled.
GetElementFromUser.name: GetElementFromUser

constraint.description: Constrains every click, for example to a fixed X coordinate or to a direction. Default: no constraint.

elementTypes.description: Only an element of one of these types is accepted. A click on empty space or on an element of another type asks for the click again. Default: any element.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to, for example only the points and edges of the element types asked for. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

cancelled.description: True when the input was cancelled with Escape; no other field is returned then.

elementId.description: The clicked element. In a section or elevation window it is the model element the section element was cut from.

elementPosition.description: The coordinate of the clicked part of the element (e.g. its node or hotspot), when Archicad gives one for it.

elementType.description: The type of the clicked element (one of the ElementType values, or Unknown).

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates, as GetPointFromUser returns it.

GetElementPreviewImage.description: Returns the preview image of the given element.
GetElementPreviewImage.name: GetElementPreviewImage

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

GetElementSetData.description: Gets the elements and the custom data of each given element set. Element sets are created by add-ons to link elements together; the custom data is returned as Base64 encoded bytes.
GetElementSetData.name: GetElementSetData

elementSets.description: The element sets to get the data of.

elementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

elementSets.description: The data of each given element set, or an error.

elements.description: The elements of the element set.

userData.description: The custom data stored with the element set by the add-on that created it.

data.description: The raw bytes of the data, Base64 encoded. Empty when the element set has no data.

dataVersion.description: The version of the data, as set by the add-on that created the element set.

platformSign.description: The platform sign of the data, telling the byte order it was written with.

GetElementSetsOfElements.description: Gets the element sets that contain each given element. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined; sets created by other add-ons are not found.
GetElementSetsOfElements.name: GetElementSetsOfElements

elementSetsOfElements.description: The element sets that contain each given element, or an error, in the order of the input. Only element sets created by the Tapir Add-On are examined.

GetElementTrims.description: Which roofs and shells trim each queried element, with the trim type, and which elements it trims.
GetElementTrims.name: GetElementTrims

elementTrims.description: One item per queried element, in order. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not trimmed.

GetElementTypeNames.description: Gets the localized names of the given element types, as the running Archicad shows them (for example 'Wand' for Wall in German Archicad). The output is aligned with the input array of element types. Available from Archicad 27.
GetElementTypeNames.name: GetElementTypeNames

elementTypes.description: The element types to get the localized names of.

names.description: The localized name of each element type, aligned with the input, or an error.

GetElementUserData.description: Reads the values stored on elements by SetElementUserData: every key of each element, or only the given keys.
GetElementUserData.name: GetElementUserData

keys.description: Optional. Only the pairs with these keys are returned; a key an element does not hold is left out of its pairs. When omitted, every pair stored on each element is returned.

elementUserData.description: One item per element, in the input order: the pairs stored on the element (none when the element holds no user data of Tapir), or an error when the element was not found or its data could not be read.

userData.description: The key-value pairs stored on the element.

value.description: The stored value.

GetElementsAttachedToIssue.description: Retrieves attached elements of the specified issue, filtered by attachment type.
GetElementsAttachedToIssue.name: GetElementsAttachedToIssue

GetElementsByClassification.description: Returns the elements classified with the given classification items, one list per item, so elements can be filtered by classification in a single call.
GetElementsByClassification.name: GetElementsByClassification

elementsOfClassificationItems.description: The elements classified with each classification item, aligned with the input, or an error for a non-existing classification item.

GetElementsByCriteria.description: Returns the elements, or with countOnly only their number, that match all the given criteria: element types, home stories, layers, Archicad's element filter flags and property criteria (a value compared in internal units, or a value status such as hasValue, isUserUndefined, isNotAvailable, isDefault or hasCustomValue). An unknown type, property or operator is an error, not ignored. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.
GetElementsByCriteria.name: GetElementsByCriteria

countOnly.description: If true, only returns the count of matching elements without listing their GUIDs. Minimizes token usage.

filters.description: Optional Archicad API element filter flags. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs, railings and curtain walls) are left out unless IncludeSubElemObjects is given, as in GetElementsByType and GetAllElements.

layerIndices.description: Optional filter for layer attribute indices.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching elements to list. The count is still the total number of matches.

propertyCriteria.description: Optional list of property evaluation criteria. All criteria must match (AND condition).

operator.description: Evaluation operator. Default is 'equals'. hasValue (alias hasAnyValue) matches a property with a value, isUserUndefined (alias isUndefined) one set to undefined by the user, isNotAvailable one that does not apply to the element. isDefault matches a property whose value comes from its default, hasCustomValue one whose value was set on the element (also to undefined). Archicad gives the default status only together with the evaluated value, so isDefault and hasCustomValue take as long as reading the value, also for expression properties.

propertyGroupName.description: Case-insensitive property group name, to choose between properties of the same name in different groups.

propertyName.description: Case-insensitive property definition name, as shown in the project's language. An error is returned when it matches no property, or properties in more than one group and propertyGroupName is not given. Prefer propertyId in scripts that must work in any language.

value.description: Expected value as a string. Required for the comparison operators. For number, integer, length, area, volume and angle properties, equals, notEquals and the range operators compare numbers in internal units (m, m², m³, rad) written with a decimal point, independent of the project's display settings; other properties compare the displayed text, case-insensitively.

elements.description: List of matching elements.

GetElementsByIFCIds.description: Retrieves the elements by the given IFC identifiers. Accepts IFC GlobalIds in every Archicad version.
GetElementsByIFCIds.name: GetElementsByIFCIds

ifcIds.description: A list of IFC identifiers to get the corresponding elements for. Each one is either an IFC GlobalId (22 characters) or, before Archicad 28, the 36 character GUID form that GetIFCIdsOfElements returns there as ifcId.

GetElementsByType.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the given type on the plan. It works for any type. Use the optional filter parameter for filtering. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.
GetElementsByType.name: GetElementsByType

GetElementsInCreationOrder.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the current database, or of the given databases, in the order the elements were created.
GetElementsInCreationOrder.name: GetElementsInCreationOrder

GetElementsInDrawOrder.description: Returns the identifier of every element of the current database, or of the given databases, in Archicad's drawing order (the order set by Bring to Front and Send to Back), as ACAPI_DrawOrder_DrawOrderGetNext walks it. Use the optional elementType and filters parameters for filtering. Objects that belong to another element (zone stamps, the parts of stairs and railings) are left out unless the IncludeSubElemObjects filter is given.
GetElementsInDrawOrder.name: GetElementsInDrawOrder

databases.description: The databases to list the elements of, each in its own drawing order. If omitted, the current database is used.

elementType.description: Optional. Only elements of this type are returned, still in drawing order. If omitted, every element is returned.

filters.description: Optional. The filters an element must pass to be returned, the same as for GetElementsByType.

GetElementsOfDesignOptions.description: Retrieves the elements associated with the given design options. Available from Archicad 29.
GetElementsOfDesignOptions.name: GetElementsOfDesignOptions

GetElementsOfGroups.description: Gets the elements directly contained by each given group.
GetElementsOfGroups.name: GetElementsOfGroups

groups.description: The groups to get the elements of.

elementsOfGroups.description: The elements directly contained by each given group, or an error.

GetExportTolerance.description: Gets the export tolerance: the largest distance allowed between an arc and the straight segments that replace it when curves are segmented for export. Archicad only provides this value while an export is in progress, so outside an export the command returns an error saying so.
GetExportTolerance.name: GetExportTolerance

arcTolerance.description: The largest distance allowed between an arc and the straight segments that replace it when Archicad segments curves for export, in meters.

GetFavoriteContents.description: Returns the Favorites of a folder of the Favorites palette and of its subfolders (every Favorite when no folder is given), each with its folder path, classifications, element category values and property values, read through the Favorite manager. Available from Archicad 29.
GetFavoriteContents.name: GetFavoriteContents

folderPath.description: The folder to read, the folder names from the root of the Favorites palette down. The Favorites of its subfolders are returned too. Omit it or leave it empty for every Favorite.

favorites.description: The Favorites of the folder and of its subfolders, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

GetFavoriteDefaults.description: Reads the element default stored in each given Favorite through the Favorite manager, without applying it or placing an element: the element type, the layer, the element ID, the folder, the library part and GDL parameters, the marker of every element type that has one, and the sub-elements with each of their kinds (Curtain Wall frames and panels, Stair treads and risers, Railing posts and rails, markers ...). Available from Archicad 29.
GetFavoriteDefaults.name: GetFavoriteDefaults

favoriteDefaults.description: The element default of each given Favorite, in the order of the input, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

GetFavoriteDetails.description: Returns the classifications, property values and element category values stored in the given favorites, so they can be audited before elements are placed. Each property value comes with its evaluation status and default-value flag; the value itself is only returned when it has been evaluated.
GetFavoriteDetails.name: GetFavoriteDetails

favoriteDetails.description: The details of the given favorites, in the order of the input, or an error for a favorite that could not be read.

GetFavoriteFolders.description: Returns the folder tree of the Favorites palette from its root folder: the name and path of every folder and the names of the Favorites in it. Available from Archicad 29.
GetFavoriteFolders.name: GetFavoriteFolders

GetFavoritePreviewImage.description: Returns the preview image of the given favorite.
GetFavoritePreviewImage.name: GetFavoritePreviewImage

format.description: The image format. Default is png.

height.description: The height of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

imageType.description: The type of the preview image. Default is 3D.

width.description: The width of the preview image in pixels. Default is 128.

GetFavoriteSettings.description: Reads the stored settings of the given favorites without applying them or placing an element: the element type, the folder, the library part and GDL parameters, the marker (library part and parameters) of Window and Door favorites, and the sub-elements. A favorite without a marker has no marker field, which is not an error. The other settings of the element (pens, layer, structure, etc.) are not returned.
GetFavoriteSettings.name: GetFavoriteSettings

favoriteSettings.description: The settings of each given Favorite, in the order of the input, or an error for a Favorite that could not be read.

GetFavoritesByType.description: Returns a list of the names of all favorites with the given element type
GetFavoritesByType.name: GetFavoritesByType

GetFills.description: Returns the details of the given Fill attributes.
GetFills.name: GetFills

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Fill. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching lineItems/symbolLines/symbolArcs/symbolHotspots, which can be large.

fills.description: A list of fills or errors.

GetFontsByName.description: Finds loaded fonts by name through Archicad's font search and returns their index (as Text and Label fields reference fonts in fontIndex) and name, or an error for a name no loaded font has.
GetFontsByName.name: GetFontsByName

fontNames.description: Names of the fonts to find, as the Text tool's font list shows them and GetDetailsOfElements reports them in fontName, e.g. 'Arial'.

fonts.description: One item per name, in the order given: the font found, or an error when no loaded font has the name.

GetGDLDate.description: Gets the date GDL scripts see: year, month, day, hour, minute and second.
GetGDLDate.name: GetGDLDate

GetGDLParametersOfElements.description: Gets all the GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given elements.
GetGDLParametersOfElements.name: GetGDLParametersOfElements

GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts.description: Gets the default GDL parameters (name, display name, type, array dimensions, value, flags) of the given library parts by name, read from the library part without placing it or changing any defaults. The output is in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements, without isLocked and possibleValues, which need a placed element. To read a part by its file name, as SetLibraryPartParameters writes it, use GetLibraryPartParameterValues.
GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts.name: GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read the default GDL parameters of.

libraryPartName.description: The name of the library part, the same name CreateObjects, CreateLamps, CreateWindows and CreateDoors take as libraryPartName.

gdlParametersOfLibraryParts.description: The default GDL parameters of each given library part, in the order of the input, or an error for a name that no loaded library part has.

libPart.description: The library part found by the name. Absent when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the library part with their default values as stored in the library part (its Parameter Script is not run). The description of each parameter is the displayName of the same entry.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

displayName.description: The display name (description) of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

value.description: The default value of the parameter. An array value is a flat list of dimension1 x dimension2 items, as GetGDLParametersOfElements returns it. Absent for a Dictionary parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

GetGDLUserGlobals.description: Returns the current GDL global variables the GDL interpreter gets, with their names, types and values. Available from Archicad 28.
GetGDLUserGlobals.name: GetGDLUserGlobals

globals.description: The GDL parameters, in the format GetGDLParametersOfElements uses. Separators, titles and dictionary parameters have no value here and are left out.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of an array parameter.

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of an array parameter, 1 for a one-dimensional array.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

value.description: The value of the parameter as the parameter list holds it: a number, a boolean, a string, or 'On' or 'Off' for a LightSwitch. For an array parameter, a list of its dimension1 x dimension2 items, the first index outer.

GetGeoLocation.description: Gets the project location details: the project location, and the survey point's position, geo-referencing parameters, visibility and lock state (the lock from Archicad 26).
GetGeoLocation.name: GetGeoLocation

GetGhostStorySettings.description: Gets the Trace & Reference ghost story settings of the floor plan: whether it is on, whether one story, the story above or the one below is shown, which story, its color and the element types shown in it.
GetGhostStorySettings.name: GetGhostStorySettings

filter.description: The element types shown in the ghost story. Types without a Tapir element type name (for example MEP or external ones) are left out, so passing this list to SetGhostStorySettings hides them.

ghostColor.description: The color the ghost story is drawn in.

on.description: Whether the ghost story (Trace & Reference) is shown on the floor plan.

showAbove.description: Whether the story above the current one is the ghost story.

showBelow.description: Whether the story below the current one is the ghost story.

showOne.description: Whether the story at storyIndex is the ghost story.

storyIndex.description: The index of the ghost story, as GetStories reports it. Meaningful when showOne is true.

GetGraphicOverrideCombinations.description: Gets all graphic override combinations of the project with the rules they contain. Available from Archicad 27.
GetGraphicOverrideCombinations.name: GetGraphicOverrideCombinations

graphicOverrideCombinations.description: The graphic override combinations of the project.

graphicOverrideRuleIds.description: The rules of the combination, in priority order.

GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups.description: Gets all graphic override rule groups of the project with the rules they contain, empty groups included. Available from Archicad 27.
GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups.name: GetGraphicOverrideRuleGroups

graphicOverrideRuleGroups.description: The graphic override rule groups of the project, empty ones included.

GetGraphicOverrideRules.description: Gets all graphic override rules of the project, with their rule group, criterion and style. With includeCriterion the criterion also comes as structured conditions, which CreateGraphicOverrideRules and ModifyGraphicOverrideRules take back. Available from Archicad 27.
GetGraphicOverrideRules.name: GetGraphicOverrideRules

includeCriterion.description: Also return each rule's criterion as structured conditions ('criterion'), in the shape CreateGraphicOverrideRules and ModifyGraphicOverrideRules take. Default: false.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules of the project.

GetGraphicOverrideRulesByName.description: Gets graphic override rules by name, with their rule group, criterion and style. The rule group narrows the search; without it the rule is searched in every rule group. With includeCriterion the criterion also comes as structured conditions. Available from Archicad 27.
GetGraphicOverrideRulesByName.name: GetGraphicOverrideRulesByName

graphicOverrideRules.description: The graphic override rules to get, by name.

includeCriterion.description: Also return each rule's criterion as structured conditions ('criterion'), in the shape CreateGraphicOverrideRules and ModifyGraphicOverrideRules take. Default: false.

graphicOverrideRules.description: The rules, or errors, in the order of the input.

GetGraphicalOverrideRules.description: Returns every graphic override rule with its criterion XML. Needs Archicad 27 or later.
GetGraphicalOverrideRules.name: GetGraphicalOverrideRules

criterionXML.description: The criterion in Archicad's own XML format. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicalOverrideRule to make similar rules.

ruleGroupName.description: Name of the rule group the rule belongs to.

GetGraphicalOverrideStyleOfElements.description: Returns the graphic override style each element is drawn with in the current window: for every overridable member (line type, pens, fill types, surfaces, ...) whether the active graphic override combination replaces it, and with what. Needs Archicad 27 or later.
GetGraphicalOverrideStyleOfElements.name: GetGraphicalOverrideStyleOfElements

styles.description: The graphic override style of each element in the current window, aligned with the input, or an error.

GetGridElementDefaults.description: Returns the Grid Tool defaults: library part, size and GDL parameters of a new grid element. Needs Archicad 26 or later.
GetGridElementDefaults.name: GetGridElementDefaults

angle.description: Direction of the grid line in radians.

elementId.description: The grid element. The zero GUID for the tool defaults.

floorIndex.description: Home story index.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index.

length.description: Length of the grid line: the GDL parameter AC_Length of the Grid Tool's grid marker, or the object's A size for a library part without it.

level.description: Elevation of the object from its home story.

libraryPartName.description: Localized name of the library part.

parameters.description: GDL parameters, separators left out. Only when requested.

dimension1.description: First dimension of an array parameter.

dimension2.description: Second dimension of an array parameter.

type.description: Integer, Length, Angle, RealNum, LightSwitch, ColorRGB, Intensity, LineType, Material, FillPattern, PenColor, String, Boolean, Title, BuildingMaterial, Profile, Dictionary or Unknown.

value.description: Number for numeric and boolean types, string for String and Title. Not given for arrays.

pos.description: Insertion point: the start of the grid line.

useXYFixSize.description: Whether xRatio and yRatio hold the sizes themselves.

variation.description: Four-character variation of the object: 'GREL' for a grid element.

xRatio.description: The object's xRatio as stored: its A size with useXYFixSize on, otherwise the A size divided by the library part's own A.

yRatio.description: The object's yRatio as stored, like xRatio for the B size.

GetGridElements.description: Lists the grid elements (placed with the Grid Tool or created by CreateGridElements) with their position, angle, size, library part and optionally GDL parameters. Needs Archicad 26 or later.
GetGridElements.name: GetGridElements

includeParameters.description: Also return the GDL parameters of each grid element. Default false.

angle.description: Direction of the grid line in radians.

elementId.description: The grid element. The zero GUID for the tool defaults.

floorIndex.description: Home story index.

layerIndex.description: Layer attribute index.

length.description: Length of the grid line: the GDL parameter AC_Length of the Grid Tool's grid marker, or the object's A size for a library part without it.

level.description: Elevation of the object from its home story.

libraryPartName.description: Localized name of the library part.

parameters.description: GDL parameters, separators left out. Only when requested.

dimension1.description: First dimension of an array parameter.

dimension2.description: Second dimension of an array parameter.

type.description: Integer, Length, Angle, RealNum, LightSwitch, ColorRGB, Intensity, LineType, Material, FillPattern, PenColor, String, Boolean, Title, BuildingMaterial, Profile, Dictionary or Unknown.

value.description: Number for numeric and boolean types, string for String and Title. Not given for arrays.

pos.description: Insertion point: the start of the grid line.

useXYFixSize.description: Whether xRatio and yRatio hold the sizes themselves.

variation.description: Four-character variation of the object: 'GREL' for a grid element.

xRatio.description: The object's xRatio as stored: its A size with useXYFixSize on, otherwise the A size divided by the library part's own A.

yRatio.description: The object's yRatio as stored, like xRatio for the B size.

GetGridSettings.description: Gets the grid and snap grid settings of the database of the current window, and which database that is. Each database has its own grid settings. Available from Archicad 27.
GetGridSettings.name: GetGridSettings

GetGroupsOfElements.description: Gets the identifier of the group that directly contains each given element. Returns an error for elements that are not part of any group.
GetGroupsOfElements.name: GetGroupsOfElements

groupGuids.description: The identifier of the group that directly contains each given element, or an error for elements that are not part of any group.

GetHierarchicalElementOwners.description: Gets the owner of each given element in its hierarchical element: the root (e.g. the Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing of a frame, tread or post) or the immediate parent. Also returns whether the given element is a main element, a subelement or not part of a hierarchical element.
GetHierarchicalElementOwners.name: GetHierarchicalElementOwners

elements.description: The elements whose owners are looked up, e.g. Curtain Wall frames or panels, Stair treads or Railing posts.

owners.description: The owner of each element, aligned with the input.

GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails.description: Reads the design option table of hotlink nodes: the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked source file, and which of them the node shows. Available from Archicad 29.
GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails.name: GetHotlinkDesignOptionTableDetails

hotlinkNodes.description: The hotlink nodes, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes.

hotlinkDesignOptionTables.description: One item per requested node, in order: the design options of the hotlinked source file and which of them the node shows, or an error.

activeCombination.description: The name of the combination the node shows. Left out when none is active.

combinations.description: The names of the design option combinations of the source file.

filterMode.description: What the node shows: only the main model of the source, the active option of each set, or the active combination.

nodeGuid.description: The node guid the design option table belongs to.

sets.description: The design option sets of the source file.

activeOption.description: The name of the option the node shows from this set. Left out when none is active.

name.description: The name of the set.

options.description: The names of the design options in the set.

GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables.description: Retrieves the design option table of the given hotlink nodes and placed hotlink instances: the filter mode (main model only, by options or by combination), the design option sets, options and combinations of the hotlinked module and which of them are active. Available from Archicad 29.
GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables.name: GetHotlinkDesignOptionTables

hotlinks.description: The hotlink nodes (hotlinkNodeId from GetHotlinks) and placed hotlink instances (elementId of a Hotlink element) to read the design option table of.

hotlinkDesignOptionTables.description: The design option tables, in the order of the given hotlinks.

activeDesignOptionCombination.description: The name of the active combination. Missing when no combination is active.

designOptionCombinations.description: The names of the design option combinations of the hotlinked module.

designOptionSets.description: The design option sets of the hotlinked module.

activeDesignOption.description: The name of the active design option of the set. Missing when no option of the set is active.

designOptions.description: The names of the design options in the set.

filterMode.description: Which elements of the hotlinked module are shown: only its main model, the main model and the active option of each set, or the main model and the options of the active combination.

hotlinkNodeId.description: The hotlink node the table belongs to; for an instance, the node it is placed from.

GetHotlinkOwnersOfElements.description: Tells for each element whether it comes from a hotlinked module, and returns the hotlink element that contains it and the hotlink instance it belongs to. Available from Archicad 27.
GetHotlinkOwnersOfElements.name: GetHotlinkOwnersOfElements

hotlinkOwners.description: The hotlink each element comes from, aligned with the input.

GetHotlinkProxyElementTable.description: Maps the proxy elements of placed hotlink instances to the elements of the source file they were made from, so an element seen in a hotlinked module can be traced back to its source element.
GetHotlinkProxyElementTable.name: GetHotlinkProxyElementTable

hotlinkInstances.description: The placed hotlink instances: elements of type Hotlink, for example the hotlinkId of an element inside one. Not the nodes GetHotlinks returns.

proxyElementTables.description: One item per requested instance, in order: its proxy elements with the source elements they were made from, or an error.

GetHotlinkSourceStatus.description: Tells for each hotlink source file whether it is available, missing, not accessible, incompatible or offline. Available from Archicad 27.
GetHotlinkSourceStatus.name: GetHotlinkSourceStatus

hotlinks.description: The source files of hotlinks of the project, for example the location of each node GetHotlinks returns.

hotlinkSourceStatuses.description: One item per requested hotlink, in order: the availability of its source file, or an error.

GetHotlinks.description: Gets the file system locations (path) of the hotlink modules and the instance elements placed from each node. The hotlinks can have tree hierarchy in the project.
GetHotlinks.name: GetHotlinks

GetHotspotsOfElements.description: Gets the 2D hotspots of the given library part instances (Objects, Lamps, Windows, Doors, Skylights, Zones, Curtain Wall parts, etc.), e.g. to dimension to them.
GetHotspotsOfElements.name: GetHotspotsOfElements

hotspotsOfElements.description: The hotspots of the given library part instances, in the order of the input.

hotspots.description: The 2D hotspots of the placed library part instance, as Archicad returns them.

GetIFCAssignments.description: Returns the IFC assignments of the project: the root IFC groups, and for each object the objects assigned to it (children) and the objects it is assigned to (parents). Each object is given by its hash value, its element where it belongs to one, its IFC type and its GlobalId. Available from Archicad 28.
GetIFCAssignments.name: GetIFCAssignments

childObjects.description: Each IFC object that has objects assigned to it, with those objects.

parentObjects.description: Each IFC object that is assigned to other objects, with those objects.

rootGroups.description: The IFC groups (e.g. IfcGroup, IfcZone, IfcSystem) that are not assigned to another group.

GetIFCAttributesOfElements.description: Retrieves the IFC attributes (Name, Description, ObjectType, Tag, PredefinedType, LongName, ...) of the given elements, subelements included: the name, the IFC value type and the value of each attribute. On Archicad 25, 26 and 27 storedOnly returns only the attributes stored on the elements.
GetIFCAttributesOfElements.name: GetIFCAttributesOfElements

storedOnly.description: Return only the attributes stored on the elements, not the ones Archicad would generate on IFC export. Used only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27. Default: false.

GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements.description: Retrieves the IFC classification references of the given elements, subelements included: identification, name, location, description and sort (from Archicad 29), the name of the IfcRelAssociatesClassification (from Archicad 28), the referenced classification (name, source, edition, edition date, description and location) and whether the reference comes from the preview translator or is stored locally. On Archicad 25, 26 and 27 the source is not given and storedOnly returns only the references stored on the elements.
GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements.name: GetIFCClassificationReferencesOfElements

storedOnly.description: Return only the classification references stored on the elements, not the ones Archicad would generate on IFC export. Used only in Archicad 25, 26 and 27. Default: false.

GetIFCExportTranslators.description: Lists the IFC export translators of the project in the order of Archicad's translator list. preview marks the first one, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator; no API identifies the preview translator otherwise, and in some projects the IFC Translators dialog shows another one as preview. Pass one of the names to IFCFileOperation as translatorName.
GetIFCExportTranslators.name: GetIFCExportTranslators

translators.description: The IFC export translators of the project, in the order of Archicad's translator list. The first one, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator, has preview true.

GetIFCIdsOfElements.description: Retrieves the IFC identifiers of the given elements. Before Archicad 28 it also returns their IFC GlobalIds.
GetIFCIdsOfElements.name: GetIFCIdsOfElements

GetIFCPropertiesOfElements.description: Retrieves the IFC properties of the given elements.
GetIFCPropertiesOfElements.name: GetIFCPropertiesOfElements
