GetIFCSpatialStructure.description: Returns the IfcProject, IfcSite and IfcBuilding objects of the project's IFC model (hash value, IFC type and GlobalId), and for the given elements the index of the story they are assigned to in the IFC model. Available from Archicad 28.
GetIFCSpatialStructure.name: GetIFCSpatialStructure

elements.description: Elements to get the IFC story index of. Optional.

building.description: The IfcBuilding object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

elements.description: The story of each given element in the IFC model, in the order of the input. Left out when no elements were given.

project.description: The IfcProject object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

site.description: The IfcSite object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

GetIFCTypeOfElements.description: Retrieves the IFC types of the given elements.
GetIFCTypeOfElements.name: GetIFCTypeOfElements

isTagTextElemVisible.description: The visibility of the attached tag text element

name.description: Issue name

GetKeynoteAutoTexts.description: Retrieves the autotext tokens of the given keynote items. The tokens can be used as label text content to reference the fields of a keynote item. Available from Archicad 28.
GetKeynoteAutoTexts.name: GetKeynoteAutoTexts

keynoteItems.description: The keynote items to get the autotext tokens for.

GetKeynoteTree.description: Retrieves the whole keynote folder and item hierarchy. The technical root folder is not included in the output; the top-level folders and items are returned directly. Available from Archicad 28.
GetKeynoteTree.name: GetKeynoteTree

foldersInRoot.description: The top-level keynote folders with their content recursively. The technical root folder itself is not included.

itemsInRoot.description: The keynote items located directly in the technical root folder.

GetLCSOfAnalyticalMembers.description: Retrieves the local coordinate system of the given analytical member parts, optionally in their intersection with another member part. Available from Archicad 26.
GetLCSOfAnalyticalMembers.name: GetLCSOfAnalyticalMembers

memberParts.description: The member parts to get the local coordinate system of.

localCoordinateSystems.description: The local coordinate system of each member part, in the order of the input. A member part the coordinate system cannot be got for is represented by an error object.

GetLast3DDefaultLevels.description: Gets the last 3D default levels of the given element types' defaults.
GetLast3DDefaultLevels.name: GetLast3DDefaultLevels

elementTypes.description: The element types to get the last 3D default level of.

levels.description: The last 3D default level of each element type, in the order of elementTypes, in meters.

GetLastValidEmbeddedLibraryPartName.description: Gets the name and file path of the last valid library part of the embedded library.
GetLastValidEmbeddedLibraryPartName.name: GetLastValidEmbeddedLibraryPartName

name.description: The name of the last valid library part of the embedded library.

path.description: The path of the file of that library part.

GetLayerCombinations.description: Returns the details of layer combination attributes.
GetLayerCombinations.name: GetLayerCombinations

GetLayerOfElementDefaults.description: Returns the layer of the tool defaults of the given element types: the layer new elements of that type are placed on.
GetLayerOfElementDefaults.name: GetLayerOfElementDefaults

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults are read.

layersOfElementDefaults.description: One item per element type, in the input order: the layer of its tool defaults, or an error when the type is unknown or has no tool defaults.

layerId.description: The layer new elements of this type are placed on.

GetLayers.description: Returns the details of the given Layer attributes.
GetLayers.name: GetLayers

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Layer. If omitted, every field is returned.

layers.description: A list of layers or errors.

GetLayoutCustomScheme.description: Gets the Layout Info Panel custom field definitions (name and key) from Book Settings.
GetLayoutCustomScheme.name: GetLayoutCustomScheme

GetLayoutSettings.description: Gets settings of layouts, including their master layout and Layout Info Panel custom data fields.
GetLayoutSettings.name: GetLayoutSettings

masterLayoutDatabaseId.description: The database of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

masterLayoutName.description: The name of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

masterNavigatorItemId.description: The Layout Book navigator item of the master layout of the layout. Not present for master layouts.

GetLayoutSubsetSettings.description: Gets the settings of existing Layout Book subsets: the same fields CreateLayoutSubset accepts (name, ID prefix, numbering style, ...).
GetLayoutSubsetSettings.name: GetLayoutSubsetSettings

subsetSettings.description: One item per input navigator item, in the same order: the subset's settings with the field names of CreateLayoutSubset, or an error.

GetLibPartTransformations.description: Gets the placement transformation of library part instances (Window, Door, Object, Lamp, Zone) as Archicad computes it: the location, the rotation angle and the x/y scaling. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.
GetLibPartTransformations.name: GetLibPartTransformations

transformations.description: The placement transformation of each element, aligned with the input, or an error.

GetLibraries.description: Gets the list of loaded libraries. From Archicad 28 a library package also gets its package information (ID, versions, minimum Archicad version and dependencies).
GetLibraries.name: GetLibraries

GetLibrariesOfLibParts.description: Gets the library of each given library part (by file name or guid): display name, location, embedded/built-in/package/local/missing flags and the Library Manager tree path. Available from Archicad 29.
GetLibrariesOfLibParts.name: GetLibrariesOfLibParts

libraryParts.description: Library parts to look up, each given by exactly one of name and guid.

libraries.description: One entry per input library part, in the same order.

GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives.description: Gets the lines, arcs and polygons (with their holes, and whether they are fills) of the 2D symbol of a loaded library part, drawn with its default parameters or with the parameters of a placed instance.
GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives.name: GetLibraryPart2DPrimitives

elementId.description: Optional. A placed instance of the library part whose parameters are used for drawing the symbol. Without it the default parameters of the library part are used.

gdlContext.description: Optional. The GDL context the 2D symbol is drawn in, the value of the GLOB_CONTEXT GDL global (2 is the floor plan). Default value is 2.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part, without the file extension (a trailing '.gsm' is accepted too).

primitives.description: The lines, arcs and polygons of the 2D symbol, in the order Archicad draws them, in the coordinate system of the library part. Other primitives (texts, hotspots, ...) are not returned.

begAngle.description: The start angle of an Arc, in radians.

begCoordinate.description: The start point of a Line.

endAngle.description: The end angle of an Arc, in radians.

endCoordinate.description: The end point of a Line.

isFill.description: Whether a Polygon is the outline of a fill.

isWhole.description: Whether an Arc is a full circle.

GetLibraryPartCustomSection.description: Gets a custom section of a loaded library part by its section identifier and index: whether it exists, its data version and its content as base64. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartCustomSection.name: GetLibraryPartCustomSection

index.description: Optional. The index of the section among the sections with the same identifier. By default 0.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

sectionId.description: The type identifier of the custom section. A four-character code is given as its integer value, the first character in the highest byte (e.g. 'ABCD' is 1094861636).

data.description: The content of the section, base64 encoded. Left out when the section does not exist.

dataVersion.description: The data version stored with the section. Left out when the section does not exist.

exists.description: Whether the library part has this custom section.

GetLibraryPartDetails.description: Gets the details of loaded library parts, by name or index: path, library tree path, containing library, and for GDL objects the GUID, subtype, license, UI default flag, which scripts and pictures they have, and optionally the interface and migration scripts. Can also tell whether each one is in the subtype of another library part. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartDetails.name: GetLibraryPartDetails

includeScripts.description: Optional. When true, the interface script and the forward and backward migration scripts are returned too. By default false.

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read, each by its name or by its index.

subTypeOf.description: Optional. The name of another loaded library part, e.g. a subtype template. When given, the isInSubTypeOf field of each library part tells whether it is in that subtype.

libraryParts.description: The details of each given library part, or an error, in the order of the input. A field is omitted when Archicad cannot return it for that library part.

GetLibraryPartFileInfo.description: Reads library part files (.gsm) without loading them into the libraries of the project: the unique ID of the part, the unique ID of its subtype and its master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts. Password protected parts need their password. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartFileInfo.name: GetLibraryPartFileInfo

files.description: The absolute paths of the library part files (.gsm) to read. The files are read without loading them into the libraries of the project.

password.description: The password of password protected library parts. Reading a script of a protected part without the right password is an error for that file.

scripts.description: The scripts to read. All five by default.

files.description: The information of the files in the order of the input, or an error for a file that cannot be read.

GetLibraryPartIdentities.description: Gets the unique ID (main and revision GUID), the reference GUID and the Teamwork lock status of library parts given by index or file path, and whether they are in a server library.
GetLibraryPartIdentities.name: GetLibraryPartIdentities

libraryParts.description: The library parts, each given by its index or by the path of its file.

identities.description: One item for each given library part, in the same order.

GetLibraryPartMetadata.description: Returns the description, keywords, author and placeable, password protected and hierarchical pages flags of loaded library parts, given by file name. Use it to search library parts by description or keywords and to tell placeable parts from macros. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartMetadata.name: GetLibraryPartMetadata

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read the metadata of.
The metadata of each given library part, or an error, in the order of the input.

GetLibraryPartOriginalLocations.description: Gets the original location of the given library parts, the file they came from, e.g. before they were embedded into the project. The library parts are given by the index GetAvailableLibraryParts returns. Available from Archicad 27.
GetLibraryPartOriginalLocations.name: GetLibraryPartOriginalLocations

libraryParts.description: The library parts to look up.

locations.description: The original location of each given library part, in the order of the input.

GetLibraryPartParameterValues.description: Returns the parameters of loaded library parts, given by their file name as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it, with their default values and descriptions, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements: the read counterpart of SetLibraryPartParameters. Unlike GetGDLParametersOfLibraryParts, which finds a part by its name and also returns the index, flags and value descriptions of each parameter, it reads through the Library Manager. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartParameterValues.name: GetLibraryPartParameterValues

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read.

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

libraryParts.description: The default parameters of each given library part, in the order of the input, or an error for a library part that could not be read.

GetLibraryPartPictures.description: Gets the preview picture and the GDL pictures of a loaded library part as base64 encoded PNGs, and from Archicad 29 also their dark user interface variants. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartPictures.name: GetLibraryPartPictures

name.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

darkGdlPictures.description: The GDL pictures for the dark user interface, as base64 encoded PNGs. Left out before Archicad 29.

darkPreviewPicture.description: The preview picture for the dark user interface as a base64 encoded PNG. Left out when the library part has none, and before Archicad 29.

gdlPictures.description: The pictures stored in the library part for its GDL scripts, as base64 encoded PNGs, in their stored order.

previewPicture.description: The preview picture as a base64 encoded PNG. Left out when the library part has none.

GetLibraryPartScripts.description: Gets the master, parameter, 2D, 3D and properties scripts of loaded library parts, given by name or by an element placed from them, with the unique ID of each part. A script section the part does not have is reported as not present. Password protected parts need their password. Available from Archicad 28.
GetLibraryPartScripts.name: GetLibraryPartScripts

libraryParts.description: The library parts to read, each given by its name or by an element placed from it.

libraryPartName.description: The name of the loaded library part file with its extension, as returned in the fileName field of GetAvailableLibraryParts (e.g. 'My Door.gsm').

elementId.description: An object, lamp, window, door, skylight, zone or curtain wall frame, panel, junction or accessory; the library part it is placed from is read.

password.description: The password of password protected library parts. Reading a script of a protected part without the right password is an error for that part.

scripts.description: The scripts to read. All five by default.

libraryParts.description: The scripts of the library parts in the order of the input, or an error for a library part that cannot be read.

GetLibraryPartSection.description: Reads the text of a text section (a script or the comment) of a library part given by index, without opening it in the GDL editor. Takes the password of a protected library part.
GetLibraryPartSection.name: GetLibraryPartSection

index.description: The index of a loaded library part, as GetAvailableLibraryParts returns it.

password.description: The password of a protected library part.

sectionType.description: The four-character code of the section type, as GetLibraryPartSections returns it. A shorter code is padded with spaces.

subIdent.description: The sub-identifier of the section, as GetLibraryPartSections returns it. 0 when not given.

GetLibraryPartSections.description: Lists the sections of library parts given by index: their four-character type code, sub-identifier, size and whether they are text (scripts, comments) or binary (previews).
GetLibraryPartSections.name: GetLibraryPartSections

libraryParts.description: The library parts to list the sections of.
One item for each given library part, in the same order.

GetLibraryPartTypeDetails.description: Returns the type details of the given library parts (ACAPI_LibraryPart_GetDetails): full unique ID and its direct parent's, type, the detail flags of objects, lamps, labels and zones, the frame and orientation settings of doors and windows, and the element type and variation of the tool that places the library part. For their path, library, GUID, license and scripts see GetLibraryPartDetails.
GetLibraryPartTypeDetails.name: GetLibraryPartTypeDetails

libraryParts.description: The library parts to get the details of.
The details of the library parts, in the order of the input, or an error for a library part that was not found.

creatorElementType.description: The type of the element the library part is placed as (its creator tool). Missing when Archicad does not report one.

creatorVariation.description: The four character variation ID of the creator tool, when it is not the generic variation.

fileName.description: The file name of the library part.

index.description: The current index of the library part. It may change when the libraries are reloaded.

name.description: The name of the library part.

parentUnId.description: The full unique ID of the direct parent subtype of the library part.

unId.description: The full unique ID (main and revision GUID) of the library part.

GetLineFromUser.description: Waits for the user to input a line in the active Archicad window and returns start and end coordinates.
GetLineFromUser.name: GetLineFromUser

constraint.description: Constrains the end point, for example to a direction from the start point (type Angle with fromLastPoint). The start point is not constrained. Default: no constraint.

endPrompt.default: Click the end point of the line
endPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the line end point.

showRubberLineFeedback.description: If true, draws a unit-square rubber feedback around the cursor while input is active.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to, for both points. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the line
startPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the line start point.

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (ESC).

endPoint.description: The end point of the line. It is only valid if cancelled is false.

startPoint.description: The start point of the line.

GetLines.description: Returns the details of the given Line attributes.
GetLines.name: GetLines

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Line. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching dashItems/lineItems, which can be large.

lines.description: A list of lines or errors.

GetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements.description: Gets how property objects (the library parts of the old listing system) are linked to the given elements, or to the element defaults of the given element types: whether the property objects matching their criteria are linked, which of them match, and which one is assigned individually, each with the library part's index (the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts), name and guid. The output is aligned with the input array of elements.
GetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements.name: GetLinkedPropertyObjectsOfElements

elements.description: A list of elements, or of element types to read the links of the element defaults of that type.

elementType.description: Read the links of the element defaults of this type instead of an element.

linkedPropertyObjectsOfElements.description: The property object links of each element or element default, aligned with the input array of elements, or an error.

GetLinksOfElements.description: Gets the links created by LinkElements that start from the given elements: the linked element and the flags of each link. Links pointing to an element are not returned; query the elements they start from. Returns an error item for an element that does not exist.
GetLinksOfElements.name: GetLinksOfElements

elements.description: The elements whose outgoing links are returned.

linksOfElements.description: The links starting from each element, aligned with the input.

GetLockableObjectSetStatus.description: Returns the Teamwork reservation status of a non-element lockable object set and the users who hold it.
GetLockableObjectSetStatus.name: GetLockableObjectSetStatus

objectSetName.description: The name of the lockable object set, as the Archicad API documents it: BuildingMaterials, Cities, Composites, Favorites, FillTypes, LayerSettingsDialog (layers and layer combinations), LineTypes, MarkupStyles, MEPSystems, ModelViewOptions, OperationProfiles, PenTables, Profiles, ProjectInfo, GeoLocation (project location), PreferencesDialog (project preferences and dimension standards), GraphicOverrides (renovation override styles), Surfaces or ZoneCategories. Other names the Archicad API accepts work too.

conflicts.description: The users who hold a reservation on the object set.

status.description: Free: nobody has reserved it. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see conflicts). NotAvailable: the Teamwork server is offline or not available. NotExist: there is no Teamwork connection, for example the project is not a Teamwork project. An unknown object set name is reported as an error, not as a status.

GetMEPDistributionSystems.description: Retrieves the MEP distribution systems of the project with their domain, MEP system attribute, member elements, physical systems (from Archicad 29) and optionally their tree: the elements from the root element on, each with its previous and next elements and the connecting ports. Available from Archicad 28.
GetMEPDistributionSystems.name: GetMEPDistributionSystems

includeTree.description: Whether to return the tree of each system: its elements from the root element on, each with the element it is connected to on the way from the root. False when not given.

distributionSystems.description: The distribution systems of the project.

ports.description: The ports in the distribution systems graph (see GetMEPPorts).

GetMEPElementDetails.description: Retrieves the type-specific details of the given MEP elements: insulation thickness and routing segment of rigid segments, control points and polyline of flexible segments, radius factor, insulation thickness, preference table and routing node of elbows (from Archicad 29), angle, length and insulation thickness of branches, and offsets, wider and narrower ports, insulation thickness, routing node and (from Archicad 29) preference table of transitions. Available from Archicad 28.
GetMEPElementDetails.name: GetMEPElementDetails

elementDetails.description: The details of the given MEP elements, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not an MEP element, and in Archicad 28 for an elbow. A value that cannot be read is left out.

GetMEPElements.description: Retrieves the MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) elements of the project (every element the MEP API lists, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panels and devices), optionally filtered by type and domain. MEP elements are ordinary elements, so the generic element commands work on them as well (for example they can be deleted with the DeleteElements command). Available from Archicad 28.
GetMEPElements.name: GetMEPElements

domains.description: Optional filter for the MEP domains.

elementTypes.description: Optional filter for the MEP element types.

elements.description: The MEP elements.

GetMEPPhysicalSystemsOfElements.description: Returns the physical systems each of the given MEP elements is part of. Available from Archicad 29.
GetMEPPhysicalSystemsOfElements.name: GetMEPPhysicalSystemsOfElements

physicalSystemsOfElements.description: The physical systems of each given element, in the order of the elements.

GetMEPPorts.description: Retrieves the ports of the given MEP elements including position, shape, size, connection status (Archicad 27: whether the port is connected, from Archicad 28: whether it is physically connected) and connection style (from Archicad 30), the flow direction of piping and ventilation ports (from Archicad 28), the nominal size of piping ports (from Archicad 30), and the outer diameter, wall thickness and flange size (Archicad 30) of piping and ventilation ports. Available from Archicad 27.
GetMEPPorts.name: GetMEPPorts

GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.description: Lists the preference tables of the Piping, Ventilation and Cable Carrier preference table containers of Archicad 27: their id, name, whether they exist and their number of rows per shape, and whether the container exists. Only for Archicad 27; from Archicad 28 use GetMEPPreferenceTables.
GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.name: GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers

domains.description: The domains whose preference tables to list. Defaults to all three.

items.description: The MEP domain of a preference table container.

containers.description: The preference table container of each domain, in the order of the domains.

GetMEPPreferenceTableRows.description: Gets rows of a segment, branch, elbow or (from Archicad 29) transition preference table by their key (the reference ids and, for branch and elbow rows from Archicad 29, the angle): whether the row is valid and its values (diameters, wall thickness, radius, length, angle, branch offset, connection length, description), and whether the table exists. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables only give whether they exist, as their rows have no key. On Archicad 27, which has one kind of preference table, a row is found by its shape and index and has a value and a description; the table's name and number of rows per shape are returned too. Available from Archicad 27.
GetMEPPreferenceTableRows.name: GetMEPPreferenceTableRows

keys.description: The keys of the rows to get.

tableId.description: The guid of a preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables (the branch, elbow and transition tables with includeFittingTables): a pipe or circular duct segment table, a branch or elbow table of the Piping or Ventilation domain, or, from Archicad 29, a transition table. Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables are found too, but their rows have no key. Archicad 27: any preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTableContainers.

name.description: Archicad 27 only: the name of the table.

rows.description: The rows in the order of the keys.

sizes.description: Archicad 27 only: the number of rows of each shape.

GetMEPPreferenceTables.description: Gets the circular cross section preference tables (referenceId, diameter, wall thickness, description) and the reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain, optionally with the elbow, branch and transition preference tables, plus the rectangular duct tables of the Ventilation domain or the segment tables of the CableCarrier domain. Each table has its name and whether it is editable; the segment tables also have their segmentation lengths from Archicad 29. The rows of the circular, elbow, branch and transition tables say whether they are valid, and the reference set and the angle set say which of their reference ids and angles are defined. The angle set and the transition tables are available from Archicad 29. Every row has its index in the table, as ModifyMEPPreferenceTables expects it. Available from Archicad 28.
GetMEPPreferenceTables.name: GetMEPPreferenceTables

domain.description: The MEP domain of the segment preference tables.

includeFittingTables.description: Also return the elbow, branch and transition preference tables. Defaults to false. Ignored for the CableCarrier domain.

branchTables.description: The branch preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true.

cableCarrierTables.description: The segment preference tables of the CableCarrier domain.

elbowTables.description: The elbow preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true.

rectangularTables.description: The rectangular segment preference tables of the Ventilation domain.

referenceSet.description: The reference set of the Piping or Ventilation domain. Not returned for the CableCarrier domain.

tables.description: The circular segment preference tables of the domain. Empty for the CableCarrier domain.

transitionTables.description: The transition preference tables of the domain. Only when includeFittingTables is true, available from Archicad 29.

GetMEPRoutingElements.description: Retrieves the details of the given MEP routing elements: domain, MEP system, offset from the home story, branch preference table, the ports logically connected at the route's beginning and end, the floor plan display settings (cut plane position, floor plan display option, show projection and on-story visibility, from Archicad 29), route polyline, segments with cross section data (shape, size, preference table and reference id), begin and end nodes, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style, insulation thickness and rigid segments, and nodes with their incoming and outgoing segments, preferred transition placement, elbows and transitions. Available from Archicad 28.
GetMEPRoutingElements.name: GetMEPRoutingElements

GetMEPRoutingParameters.description: Gets the routing parameters of placed MEP elements: of a routing element its routing node parameters (preferred transition placement, elbow from Archicad 29, transition) and routing segment parameters (cross section, preference table, anchor, reference line offsets, wall thickness, flange size, connection style); of a routing node its elbow (from Archicad 29) and transition parameters; of a routing segment its rigid segment parameters (Archicad 28 only). Available from Archicad 28.
GetMEPRoutingParameters.name: GetMEPRoutingParameters

elements.description: MEP routing elements, routing nodes or routing segments.

routingParameters.description: The routing parameters of the given elements, in their order.

GetMEPSystemGroups.description: Gets the MEP system groups of the project with their physical systems: name, editable flag, root element and MEP system. Available from Archicad 29.
GetMEPSystemGroups.name: GetMEPSystemGroups

systemGroups.description: The system groups of the project with their physical systems.

GetMEPSystems.description: Returns the details of the given MEP System attributes (domain, pens, fill, center line type, surface and insulation surface).
GetMEPSystems.name: GetMEPSystems

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each MEP System. If omitted, every field is returned.

mepSystems.description: A list of MEP systems or errors.

GetMEPToolDefaults.description: Retrieves the current settings of the MEP tools per domain, without changing them: the routing tool (MEP system, branch preference table, floor plan display settings from Archicad 29, and its segment, node, elbow (Archicad 27 and from Archicad 29) and transition defaults), its rigid segment and branch defaults, the flexible segment tool, the library part, insulation and port settings of the terminal, accessory, fitting and equipment tools, and from Archicad 30 the electrical panel tool with its number of circuit defaults. Archicad 27 gives fewer settings, and only the shape of the ports. Available from Archicad 27.
GetMEPToolDefaults.name: GetMEPToolDefaults

domains.description: The domains to return the tool defaults of. All three when not given.

equipment.description: The default of the Equipment tool, which has no domain. Left out when Archicad gives none.

toolDefaults.description: The tool defaults of each requested domain, in the order requested.

GetMagicWandSettings.description: Returns the settings of Archicad's Magic Wand Settings dialog: how curves are approximated with straight segments (a number of segments along arcs or circles, a largest deviation from the curve, or a segment length) and the trace method. Useful to know how the Magic Wand will trace a curve. Changes nothing in the project.
GetMagicWandSettings.name: GetMagicWandSettings

curveApproximation.description: How the Magic Wand approximates curves with straight segments: a fixed number of segments along arcs or along full circles (segmentCount), segments that deviate from the curve by at most maxDeviation, or segments of segmentLength. Unknown for a mode this version of Tapir does not know.

maxDeviation.description: The largest distance of the segments from the curve, in meters, used by DeviationFromCurves.

segmentCount.description: The number of segments along an arc or circle, used by SegmentsAlongArcs and SegmentsAlongCircles.

segmentLength.description: The length of the segments, in meters, used by SegmentLength.

traceMethod.description: How curves are traced: Linear traces them with straight segments as set above, BestMatch with the curves that match them best. Unknown for a method this version of Tapir does not know.

GetMainGroups.description: Gets the top level group of each given group. A group that is not nested in another group is its own top level group.
GetMainGroups.name: GetMainGroups

groups.description: The groups to get the top level group of.

mainGroups.description: The top level group of each given group (the group itself if it is not nested in another group), or an error.

GetMarkerParametersOfElements.description: Gets the marker library part and the marker's GDL parameters (name, type, value) of the given Window and Door elements. The marker is the stamp drawn next to the opening on the floor plan; its parameters are separate from the opening's own GDL parameters, which GetGDLParametersOfElements returns.
GetMarkerParametersOfElements.name: GetMarkerParametersOfElements

markerParametersOfElements.description: The marker of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error for an element that is not a window or a door.

libPart.description: The library part of the marker. Absent when it could not be read.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the marker.

GetMarquee.description: Gets the marquee of the current window: its shape (rectangle, rotated rectangle or polygon), whether it is multi-story, and its outline as a polygon. Returns the type 'none' when there is no marquee.
GetMarquee.name: GetMarquee

box.description: The rectangle of a 'rectangle' or 'rotatedRectangle' marquee. For a rotated rectangle it is given as Archicad stores it: in the coordinate system rotated by rotationAngle around the project origin, not around the box itself. Use polygon for the corners on the plan.

multiStory.description: True for a multi-story (thick) marquee, false for a single-story (thin) one. Absent when there is no marquee.

polygon.description: The vertices of the marquee outline on the plan, each listed once: the four corners of a 'rectangle' or 'rotatedRectangle' marquee, the vertices of a 'polygon' marquee.

rotationAngle.description: The rotation angle (radians) of a 'rotatedRectangle' marquee.

type.description: The shape of the marquee in the current window, or 'none' when there is no marquee.

GetMergedElements.description: Gets the elements each queried element is merged with, one item per queried element; an unknown element is an error item.
GetMergedElements.name: GetMergedElements

elementMerges.description: One item per queried element, in order: the elements it is merged with. An unknown or deleted element is an error item, so it cannot be mistaken for an element that is simply not merged.

GetMissingAttributes.description: Lists the references of placed elements to layers, fills, surfaces, building materials, composites, profiles, line types, pen tables and zone categories that do not exist in the project, for the given types or all of them, and of the tool defaults, Favorites, graphic override rules, Model View Options combinations and attributes: the structured counterpart of the missing attributes report of Archicad's GDL palette. Every element of the floor plan and of every view and layout (hotlinked ones too) is checked, and so is every tool default and Favorite (with its sub-elements): its layer, its attribute fields and memo data as ReindexAttributes finds them, its composite or profile when its structure type uses one, a drawing's own pen table, and its library part parameters of attribute types; of every graphic override rule the line type, fill and surface it overrides with; of every Model View Options combination the surfaces and line types of the stair and railing schemes and the library part settings' GDL parameters of attribute types; of every composite the building materials of its skins and the line types of its separators, of every building material its cut fill and cut surface, of every surface the fill of its vectorial hatching, of every MEP system its fill, center line type and surfaces, and of every profile the building material, surface or fill of each skin and its contour, cut end and edge line types. The sources input limits the check to elements, tool defaults, Favorites, graphic override rules, Model View Options or attributes. Each item names the source; for an element the element (and the element it is part of, for a curtain wall frame, a column segment, ...) and the story or view it sits on, for a tool default the tool, for a Favorite its name and tool, for a graphic override rule its guid and name, for a Model View Options combination its guid and name (and the library part option set), for an attribute its type, guid and name; then the attribute type, the missing index and the field or GDL parameter that holds it. Index 0 counts as no attribute. Read only. Available from Archicad 27.
GetMissingAttributes.name: GetMissingAttributes

attributeTypes.description: The attribute types to check. All of them when omitted.

sources.description: What to check: the placed elements (element), the tool default settings (toolDefault), the Favorites (favorite), the graphic override rules (overrideRule), the Model View Options combinations (modelViewOption) and the attributes that refer to other attributes (attribute: composites, building materials, surfaces, MEP systems and profiles). All of them when omitted.

checkedAttributeCount.description: The number of composites, building materials, surfaces, MEP systems and profiles checked for references to other attributes. Missing when they were not checked.

checkedElementCount.description: The number of placed elements checked; 0 when the elements were not checked.

checkedFavoriteCount.description: The number of Favorites checked. Missing when the Favorites were not checked.

checkedModelViewOptionCount.description: The number of Model View Options combinations checked. Missing when they were not checked.

checkedOverrideRuleCount.description: The number of graphic override rules checked. Missing when the rules were not checked or could not be listed.

checkedToolDefaultCount.description: The number of tool defaults checked. Missing when the tool defaults were not checked.

missingAttributes.description: One item per reference to an attribute index that has no attribute in the project: first the placed elements in the order they were found (the floor plan first, then the views and layouts), then the tool defaults, then the Favorites, then the graphic override rules, then the Model View Options combinations, then the attributes that refer to other attributes.

databaseId.description: The database the element is in, the same id GetDatabases returns. Only for source element.

databaseName.description: The name of the view or layout (e.g. the worksheet) the element is in. Missing for the floor plan.

databaseReference.description: The reference id of that view or layout. Missing when it has none.

databaseType.description: The type of that database, e.g. FloorPlan, Worksheet, Details, Section, Layout. Only for source element.

elementId.description: The placed element. Only for source element.

elementType.description: The element's type, as GetElementsByType names it: for a tool default or a Favorite the type of its tool. Missing for a graphic override rule, a Model View Options combination and an attribute.

favoriteName.description: The name of the Favorite. Only for source favorite.

field.description: The element's setting that holds the index, named as in the Archicad API (e.g. layer, contLtype, cWallFrameDefaults.material); for a graphic override rule lineType, fillOverride or surfaceOverride; for a Model View Options combination the field as GetModelViewOptionDetails names it (e.g. stair.stairSchemeSurfaceIndex); for an attribute the field as GetComposites, GetBuildingMaterials, GetSurfaces, GetMEPSystems or GetProfiles names it (e.g. skins[0].buildingMaterialId, cutFillIndex). Missing when gdlParameter is given.

gdlOptionsName.description: When the reference is a GDL parameter of the library part settings of a Model View Options combination, the name of that option set (the gdlOptions name GetModelViewOptionDetails returns). Missing otherwise.

gdlParameter.description: The library part parameter that holds the index, with the cell for an array parameter (e.g. gs_frame_mat, matArray[2][1]). Missing when field is given.

inHotlinkedModule.description: True when the element comes from a hotlinked module: it has to be fixed in the module's file. Missing otherwise.

index.description: The attribute index the element, tool default, Favorite, graphic override rule, Model View Options combination or attribute refers to, which no attribute of attributeType has.

modelViewOptionId.description: The Model View Options combination, the id GetModelViewOptionDetails returns. Only for source modelViewOption.

modelViewOptionName.description: The name of the Model View Options combination. Only for source modelViewOption.

overrideRuleId.description: The graphic override rule. Only for source overrideRule.

overrideRuleName.description: The name of the graphic override rule. Only for source overrideRule.

ownerAttributeId.description: The attribute that refers to the missing one. Only for source attribute.

ownerAttributeName.description: The name of that attribute. Only for source attribute.

ownerAttributeType.description: The type of the attribute that refers to the missing one. Only for source attribute.

parentElementId.description: The element this one is part of (the curtain wall of a frame, the column of a segment, ...). Missing for an element that is not part of another one.

source.description: What refers to the missing attribute: a placed element, the default settings of a tool, a Favorite, a graphic override rule, a Model View Options combination, or another attribute.

storyIndex.description: The element's home story. Only for elements of the floor plan.

storyName.description: The name of that story. Only for elements of the floor plan.

subElementType.description: When the reference is in a sub-element the Favorite keeps apart (e.g. a stair's structure), the type of that sub-element. Missing otherwise.

warnings.description: What could not be checked. Missing when everything was checked.

GetMissingLibPartNames.description: Gets the library part name of the given placed Object, Lamp, Window or Door elements, even if the library containing the part is not loaded. Use it to find the parts of elements that are shown as dots because their library part is missing.
GetMissingLibPartNames.name: GetMissingLibPartNames

libPartNames.description: The library part name of each given element, in the order of the input, or an error.

GetModelExtent.description: Returns the 3D extent (xMin, yMin, zMin, xMax, yMax, zMax) of the current database, the region Archicad's Fit in Window would show.
GetModelExtent.name: GetModelExtent

GetModelViewOptionDetails.description: Gets the settings stored in model view option combinations (Document > Model View > Model View Options), all of them or the ones given by id or by name: the model view options in the fields of GetViewOptions, and the options library parts add to the combination (gdlOptions) with their GDL parameter values. Read-only: the Archicad API has no function to change, rename or create a stored combination; SetViewOptions changes the options of the current window. Available from Archicad 27.
GetModelViewOptionDetails.name: GetModelViewOptionDetails

modelViewOptions.description: The model view option combinations to read, each given by id or by name. When omitted, every combination of the project is returned.

modelViewOptionId.description: The identifier of the model view option combination (see FindModelViewOption).

name.description: The name of the model view option combination, as shown in Document > Model View > Model View Options.

modelViewOptionDetails.description: The settings of each model view option combination, in the order of the input, or in the order of the project when no input is given.

gdlOptions.description: The model view options that library parts add to the combination (the library part settings of the Model View Options dialog, e.g. of doors, windows and objects), with their GDL parameter values.

guid.description: The unique id of the option set.

name.description: The name of the option set, e.g. the name of the library global settings part.

parameters.description: The GDL parameters of the option set with their values in this combination.

supersetGuid.description: The id of another option set that has all of the functionality of this one. When it is given, this set is filled but not shown in the Model View Options dialog.

index.description: The index of the model view option combination, the one SetViewOptions takes as modelViewOptionIndex.

modelViewOptions.description: The fields of API_ModelViewOptions stored in the combination, with the curtainWall, stair and railing parts as nested objects: the same fields as viewOptions.modelViewOptions of GetViewOptions. Values are the numeric API constants; attribute indices are plain integers.

name.description: The name of the model view option combination.

items.description: Represents the model view options.

GetModulData.description: Gets the module data Tapir stored in the project with StoreModulData: the given names, or all of them, with their data version and, unless includeContent is false, their content. Module data are the custom data sections of Archicad's ModulData Manager: text saved in the project file under a name, kept apart from project data (SetProjectData).
GetModulData.name: GetModulData

includeContent.description: Whether the content is returned too. When false, only the names and data versions are read, without loading the data. The default is true.

names.description: The names of the module data to get; the empty name is the default section. When omitted, every module data Tapir stored in the project is returned.

modulData.description: The module data in the order of the given names (or of the list Archicad returns), or an error for a name that has no module data.

content.description: The content of the module data. Left out when includeContent is false.

dataVersion.description: The version number stored with the data.

name.description: The name of the module data.

GetNavigatorItemTree.description: Returns the full navigator item tree for the specified map. With includeChildCount true every item also reports the number of its direct children.
GetNavigatorItemTree.name: GetNavigatorItemTree

includeChildCount.description: Set to true to add childCount, the number of direct children Archicad reports, to every item. Defaults to false.

publisherSetName.description: The name of the publisher set to retrieve. Used only when navigatorMapId is PublisherSets. Without it the first publisher set is returned.

GetNavigatorParentItems.description: Returns the parent of each given navigator item: the folder, subset or layout book item it is in. The root of a map has no parent and gets an error.
GetNavigatorParentItems.name: GetNavigatorParentItems

parentItems.description: The parent of each requested navigator item, in the order of the input, or an error for an item whose parent cannot be read.

GetNoteAutoTextKeywords.description: Retrieves the keywords of note autotexts (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes) by their numeric API_NoteAutotextID values. Available from Archicad 26.
GetNoteAutoTextKeywords.name: GetNoteAutoTextKeywords

autoTextIds.description: Numeric values of the API_NoteAutotextID enumeration of the Archicad API (the autotexts of dimension, label and other element notes).

keywords.description: One result per input id, in the same order.

GetNoteAutotexts.description: Retrieves the autotexts available in the notes of an element type (e.g. a Dimension), each with the element types it is available for. The autotexts are identified by the numeric value of their API_NoteAutotextID. For a Dimension, the optional dimensionAppearance (Linear by default) chooses the dimension type. Needs Archicad 26 or later.
GetNoteAutotexts.name: GetNoteAutotexts

dimensionAppearance.description: Optional dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings, whose note autotexts are listed when noteOwnerType is 'Dimension'. Defaults to Linear. Not allowed with other owner types.

noteOwnerType.description: The type of the element that owns the note, e.g. 'Dimension', 'RadialDimension', 'LevelDimension' or 'AngleDimension'.

noteAutotexts.description: The autotexts available in the notes of the given owner type, in ascending order of autotextId.

GetOpeningDefault.description: Returns the settings of the Opening tool defaults: the extrusion parameters (as GetOpeningDetails returns them) and the floor plan parameters (as GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters returns them). Available from Archicad 29.
GetOpeningDefault.name: GetOpeningDefault

extrusionParameters.description: The size and extrusion settings. A size Archicad does not give for the opening's shape is left out.

anchor.description: The anchor point of the opening's polygon.

constraint.description: How the opening's orientation is constrained.

endSurfaceId.description: The surface of the end faces. Only given when it is overridden.

extrusionSurfaceId.description: The surface of the extrusion faces. Only given when it is overridden.

limitType.description: How far the opening's extrusion reaches.

linkedStatus.description: Whether the opening's width and height are linked. Left out when Archicad gives none.

shapeType.description: The shape of the opening's polygon.

coverFillId.description: The fill of the cover fills.

coverFillTransformation.description: The orientation and distortion of the cover fill. Left out when Archicad gives none.

coverFillsUseFillsOfCutElements.description: Whether the cover fills are the fills of the cut elements instead of coverFillId.

cutSurfacesUseLineOfCutElements.description: Whether the cut surfaces use the line of the cut elements instead of cutSurfacesLinePen and cutSurfacesLineTypeId.

cutSymbolLibPartId.description: The id of the library part drawn as the symbol of the cut opening. Left out when the opening has no cut symbol.

dividedOpeningMode.description: How the parts of an opening divided by the floor plan cut are shown.

floorPlanDisplayMode.description: How the opening is shown on the floor plan.

openEdgeStyle.description: How the open edges of the opening are shown on the floor plan.

outlinesUseLineOfCutElements.description: Whether the outlines use the line of the cut elements instead of the uncut and overhead lines below.

referenceAxisLineTypeId.description: The line type of the reference axis.

referenceAxisOverhang.description: How far the reference axis reaches beyond the opening.

showReferenceAxis.description: Whether the reference axis of the opening is shown on the floor plan.

unCutSymbolLibPartId.description: The id of the library part drawn as the symbol of the uncut opening. Left out when the opening has no uncut symbol.

GetOpeningDetails.description: Returns the details of Opening elements: whether they exist, the parent element, the cut and connected elements, the geometry (anchor point, extrusion direction, axes, polygon) and the extrusion parameters (constraint, limit type, linked status, shape type, size, anchor, offsets, surface overrides). Available from Archicad 29.
GetOpeningDetails.name: GetOpeningDetails

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The details of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

connectedOpenings.description: The openings Archicad reports as connected to this one. Left out when they cannot be read.

exists.description: Whether the opening still exists in the project.

extrusionParameters.description: The size and extrusion settings. A size Archicad does not give for the opening's shape is left out.

anchor.description: The anchor point of the opening's polygon.

constraint.description: How the opening's orientation is constrained.

endSurfaceId.description: The surface of the end faces. Only given when it is overridden.

extrusionSurfaceId.description: The surface of the extrusion faces. Only given when it is overridden.

limitType.description: How far the opening's extrusion reaches.

linkedStatus.description: Whether the opening's width and height are linked. Left out when Archicad gives none.

shapeType.description: The shape of the opening's polygon.

anchorPoint.description: The anchor point of the opening in world coordinates.

extrusionDirection.description: The direction the opening is extruded in.

polygon.description: The vertices of the opening's polygon, in the plane of xAxis and yAxis. Left out when the opening has no polygon.

xAxis.description: The X axis of the plane of the opening's polygon.

yAxis.description: The Y axis of the plane of the opening's polygon.

parentElementId.description: The element the opening was placed in. Left out when the opening has none.

GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters.description: Returns the floor plan parameters of Opening elements: the floor plan display mode, the divided opening mode, the open edge style, the reference axis, the cut surface and outline lines, the cover fills and the cut and uncut symbols. Available from Archicad 29.
GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters.name: GetOpeningFloorPlanParameters

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The floor plan parameters of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

coverFillId.description: The fill of the cover fills.

coverFillTransformation.description: The orientation and distortion of the cover fill. Left out when Archicad gives none.

coverFillsUseFillsOfCutElements.description: Whether the cover fills are the fills of the cut elements instead of coverFillId.

cutSurfacesUseLineOfCutElements.description: Whether the cut surfaces use the line of the cut elements instead of cutSurfacesLinePen and cutSurfacesLineTypeId.

cutSymbolLibPartId.description: The id of the library part drawn as the symbol of the cut opening. Left out when the opening has no cut symbol.

dividedOpeningMode.description: How the parts of an opening divided by the floor plan cut are shown.

floorPlanDisplayMode.description: How the opening is shown on the floor plan.

openEdgeStyle.description: How the open edges of the opening are shown on the floor plan.

outlinesUseLineOfCutElements.description: Whether the outlines use the line of the cut elements instead of the uncut and overhead lines below.

referenceAxisLineTypeId.description: The line type of the reference axis.

referenceAxisOverhang.description: How far the reference axis reaches beyond the opening.

showReferenceAxis.description: Whether the reference axis of the opening is shown on the floor plan.

unCutSymbolLibPartId.description: The id of the library part drawn as the symbol of the uncut opening. Left out when the opening has no uncut symbol.

GetOpeningSymbolParameters.description: Returns the GDL parameters of the cut and uncut floor plan symbols of Opening elements, in the format of GetGDLParametersOfElements. A symbol the opening does not have is left out. Available from Archicad 29.
GetOpeningSymbolParameters.name: GetOpeningSymbolParameters

elements.description: The Opening elements (made with the Opening tool) to read.

openings.description: The GDL parameters of the floor plan symbols of the openings, in the order of the given elements.

cutSymbolParameters.description: The GDL parameters, in the format GetGDLParametersOfElements uses. Separators, titles and dictionary parameters have no value here and are left out.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of an array parameter.

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of an array parameter, 1 for a one-dimensional array.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

value.description: The value of the parameter as the parameter list holds it: a number, a boolean, a string, or 'On' or 'Off' for a LightSwitch. For an array parameter, a list of its dimension1 x dimension2 items, the first index outer.

unCutSymbolParameters.description: The GDL parameters, in the format GetGDLParametersOfElements uses. Separators, titles and dictionary parameters have no value here and are left out.

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of an array parameter.

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of an array parameter, 1 for a one-dimensional array.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

value.description: The value of the parameter as the parameter list holds it: a number, a boolean, a string, or 'On' or 'Off' for a LightSwitch. For an array parameter, a list of its dimension1 x dimension2 items, the first index outer.

GetOpeningTransformations.description: Gets the placement of Opening elements, Windows, Doors and Skylights without changing them: a global-to-local transformation matrix, its inverse, and the origin and axes in world coordinates derived from the inverse. For Windows, Doors and Skylights the local-to-global matrix is the one Archicad returns, and mirrored ones give a left-handed matrix (isMirrored). For Opening elements it is built from the opening geometry (Archicad 29 and later): origin at the anchor point, the X and Y axes of the opening and Z = X × Y, which points against the extrusion direction. Needs Archicad 27 or later.
GetOpeningTransformations.name: GetOpeningTransformations

openingTransformations.description: The transformation of each given Opening, or an error, in the order of the input elements.

determinant.description: The determinant of the 3x3 part of localToGlobal: 1, or -1 for a mirrored Window, Door or Skylight.

globalToLocal.description: The global-to-local matrix (API_Tranmat), the inverse of localToGlobal: the 12 values of a 3x4 matrix, row by row, so x' = m[0]*x + m[1]*y + m[2]*z + m[3], y' = m[4]*x + ... + m[7], z' = m[8]*x + ... + m[11].

isMirrored.description: True when the matrix is left-handed (negative determinant), which Archicad returns for a mirrored opening.

localToGlobal.description: The local-to-global matrix, in the same layout: the matrix ACAPI_Element_GetOpeningTransformation returns for a Window, Door or Skylight, or the one built from the geometry of an Opening element.

origin.description: The origin of the opening's local coordinate system in world coordinates, from localToGlobal. For an Opening element this is its anchor point.

xAxis.description: The local X axis in world coordinates, from localToGlobal.

yAxis.description: The local Y axis in world coordinates, from localToGlobal.

zAxis.description: The local Z axis in world coordinates, from localToGlobal. For an Opening element it is X × Y, which points against its extrusion direction.

GetPenTables.description: Returns the details of the given Pen Table attributes.
GetPenTables.name: GetPenTables

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Pen Table. If omitted, every field is returned. Requesting only the fields you need avoids fetching the 255-element pens array.

penTables.description: A list of pen tables or errors.

GetPens.description: Returns the given pens, or all of them, in effect in the current window: index, color, width and description. It also works when the pens in effect are not a Pen Table attribute. Available from Archicad 27.
GetPens.name: GetPens

indices.description: The indices of the pens to return, from 1 to the number of pens (GetCurrentPenTable returns penCount). If omitted, every pen is returned.

pens.description: The pens in effect in the current window, or errors. The order is that of the given indices.

GetPointFromUser.description: Asks the designer to click a point in the current window and returns it. Archicad waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then; the call fails when the input is cancelled.
GetPointFromUser.name: GetPointFromUser

constraint.description: Constrains the click, for example to a fixed X coordinate or to a direction. Default: no constraint.

prompt.description: Shown in the control box while Archicad waits for the click. Single-byte text: the box takes a char field. Archicad's main thread waits for the click or for Escape, and every other JSON command queues behind this one until then.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

position.description: The clicked point in the project's coordinates.

GetPolygonFromUser.description: Waits for the user to input a polygon in the active Archicad window and returns its points and arcs.
GetPolygonFromUser.name: GetPolygonFromUser

constraint.description: Constrains the nodes after the start point, for example to a direction from the previous node (type Angle with fromLastPoint). The start point is not constrained. Default: no constraint.

prompt.default: Click polygon nodes and finish the input
prompt.description: Prompt shown while placing the remaining polygon nodes.

snapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to for the start point. Archicad's polygon input has no snap filter, so the other nodes snap as usual. Default: Archicad's usual snapping.

startPrompt.default: Click the start point of the polygon
startPrompt.description: Prompt for selecting the polygon start point.

cancelled.description: True if the user cancelled the input (ESC).

GetPrinterAndPlotterInfo.description: Retrieves the printer selected in Archicad, with its name and orientation, and the selected plotter, with its name and model.
GetPrinterAndPlotterInfo.name: GetPrinterAndPlotterInfo

plotter.description: The plotter selected in Archicad, or an error when it cannot be read.

printer.description: The printer selected in Archicad, or an error when it cannot be read.

GetPrinterInfo.description: Retrieves Archicad's current print settings: the print area, grid, fixed text size and scale (the settings PrintView takes).
GetPrinterInfo.name: GetPrinterInfo

fixText.description: Whether text is printed in fixed size.

GetProductVersionInfo.description: Retrieves the version information of the running Archicad: build number, language code, product family and version text, plus the product name, product type, main/update/hotfix versions, the available domains (Architecture, MEP) and the CEIP project identifier of the open project from Archicad 29. Requires Archicad 28 or later.
GetProductVersionInfo.name: GetProductVersionInfo

availableDomains.description: The domains available in the running Archicad. Archicad 29 or later.

buildNumber.description: The build number of the running Archicad.

ceipProjectId.description: The CEIP project identifier of the open project. Left out when no saved project is open. Archicad 29 or later.

hotfixVersion.description: The hotfix version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

languageCode.description: The Graphisoft language code of the running Archicad (for example INT, GER).

mainVersion.description: The main version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

productFamilyId.description: The identifier of the product family.

productName.description: The name of the product. Archicad 29 or later.

productType.description: The Graphisoft product type. Archicad 29 or later.

updateVersion.description: The update version, as text. Archicad 29 or later.

versionNumbers.description: The three parts of the version number. Archicad 28 only.

versionString.description: The full version of the running Archicad as text.

GetProfiles.description: Returns the details of the given Profile attributes.
GetProfiles.name: GetProfiles

fields.description: Names of the fields to return for each Profile. If omitted, every field is returned. Note the raw cross-section vector geometry itself is not exposed; width/height/minimumWidth/minimumHeight/widthStretchable/heightStretchable/hasCoreSkin/profileModifiers are derived measurements matching what the Profile Editor shows, computed from the profile's internal stretch/parameter data.

profiles.description: A list of profiles or errors.

GetProjectData.description: Gets the content of the project data with the given names.
GetProjectData.name: GetProjectData

names.description: The names of the project data to get.

values.description: The project data in the order of the given names, or an error for a name that has no project data.

GetProjectDataKeys.description: Lists the project data stored by Tapir in the project: the names, the identifiers of the add-on objects that store them, whether they are kept on this client only and the Teamwork user who has reserved them. Project data is text (for example JSON) saved in the project file by scripts and Grasshopper definitions, such as their settings or the mapping of elements to an external system.
GetProjectDataKeys.name: GetProjectDataKeys

keys.description: The project data stored by Tapir in the project.

GetProjectInfo.description: Retrieves information about the currently loaded project.
GetProjectInfo.name: GetProjectInfo

isTeamwork.description: True, if the project is a Teamwork (BIMcloud) project.

isUntitled.description: True, if the project is not saved yet.

projectLocation.description: The location of the project in the filesystem or a BIMcloud project reference. A BIMcloud project reference is returned without the user name and login token.

projectPath.description: The path of the project. A filesystem path or a BIMcloud server relative path.

GetProjectInfoFields.description: Retrieves the names and values of all project info fields.
GetProjectInfoFields.name: GetProjectInfoFields

GetProjectInfoGroups.description: Retrieves the Project Info groups in their order, each with its fields: id, name, value and, when exactly one project info autotext has the name of the field, the autotext key that SetProjectInfoField takes. Available from Archicad 30.
GetProjectInfoGroups.name: GetProjectInfoGroups

GetProjectNotes.description: Gets the Project Notes of the project (File > Info > Project Notes): client, project name, company, address, architect, draftsmen, project status, date of issue, keywords and notes.
GetProjectNotes.name: GetProjectNotes

architect.description: Architect: the full name of the Project Info contact. Archicad keeps it as name parts (title prefix, given, middle and family name, title suffix); SetProjectNotes puts a new value into the given name and clears the other parts, so it reads back unchanged. Use SetProjectInfoField to set the parts.

dateOfIssue.description: Date of issue (free text, as typed in Project Notes).

draftsmen.description: Draftsmen: the full name of the Project Info CAD technician, kept as name parts like architect.

GetProjectPreferences.description: Gets pages of the project preferences (Options > Project Preferences): the working units, the dimensions, the calculation units, the zones and the reference levels, and the Floor Plan Cut Plane Settings. Further pages may follow.
GetProjectPreferences.name: GetProjectPreferences

preferenceTypes.description: The preference pages to get. Every page when missing.

returns.description: The pages asked for, by name.

calculationUnits.description: The Calculation Units page: the units, the number of decimals and the extra accuracy of the values in element lists and schedules. GetCalculationUnits answers the same page.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for angle values.
Number of decimals to display for area values.
Number of decimals to display for length values.
Number of decimals to display for volume values.

dimensions.description: The Dimensions page: the dimension standard and the format (unit, decimals, extra accuracy and zero handling) of each dimension type.

angle.description: The format of the angle dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

area.description: The format of the area values the dimensions show (area calculations).

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

dimensionStandardIndex.description: The index of the dimension standard the page follows.

doorWindow.description: The format of the door, window and skylight dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

elevation.description: The format of the elevation dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

level.description: The format of the level dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

linear.description: The format of the linear dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

parapet.description: The format of the sill height (parapet) dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

radial.description: The format of the radial dimensions.

hideZeroDecimals.description: Hide the zero decimals at the end of the values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

showZeroInch.description: Show zero inches in feet and inches values.

showZeroWhole.description: Show the zero before the decimal point of values below one.

floorPlanCutPlane.description: The Floor Plan Cut Plane Settings (Document > Floor Plan Cut Plane): where the floor plan cuts the model and which range of it the floor plan shows.

absoluteDisplayLimit.description: The absolute display limit from Project Zero in meters: elements set to show on the floor plan down to the absolute display limit are shown down to this level.

bottomLevel.description: The bottom of the floor plan range: elements are shown down to this level.

offset.description: The offset of the level from that story in meters.

relativeStory.description: The story the level is measured from, relative to the current story: 0 is the current story, 1 the story above it, -1 the story below it.

cutPlaneHeight.description: The height of the cut plane from the current story in meters.

topLevel.description: The top of the floor plan range: elements are shown up to this level.

offset.description: The offset of the level from that story in meters.

relativeStory.description: The story the level is measured from, relative to the current story: 0 is the current story, 1 the story above it, -1 the story below it.

referenceLevels.description: The Reference Levels page: two named levels that elevations can be measured from, besides Project Zero and the stories.

elevation.description: The elevation of the reference level from Project Zero in meters.

name.description: The name of the reference level, e.g. Sea Level.

elevation.description: The elevation of the reference level from Project Zero in meters.

name.description: The name of the reference level, e.g. Sea Level.

workingUnits.description: The Working Units page: the units and the number of decimals the model's lengths, areas, volumes and angles are shown with.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for angle values.
Number of decimals to display for area values.
Number of decimals to display for length values.

roundInch.description: Rounding of the fractional inch units, as the denominator of the smallest fraction shown: 1, 2, 4, 8, 16, 32 or 64.

decimals.description: Number of decimals to display for volume values.

zones.description: The Zones page: the reduction of the calculated zone area under a low ceiling. The wall inset (niche) sizes of the page are not available through the API.

lowCeilingAreaReduction.description: Up to three ceiling height limits split a zone into height ranges; the area of each range is reduced by its own percent in the calculated area of the zone.

activeHeightLimits.description: How many of the three height limits are in use: 0 (no reduction) to 3.

heightLimits.description: The three height limits, each with the reduction of the area under it (and above the previous limit); the first activeHeightLimits of them are in use. In SetProjectPreferences the given items change the limits of the same index.

height.description: The ceiling height limit in meters.

reductionPercent.description: The reduction of the area under this limit, in percent.

reductionPercentAboveHeightLimits.description: The reduction of the area above the highest height limit, in percent.

GetPropertiesOfToolDefaults.description: Returns the property definitions of the tool defaults (the settings new elements get) of the given element types, filtered by kind (all by default), and optionally the value of each property in the tool default.
GetPropertiesOfToolDefaults.name: GetPropertiesOfToolDefaults

elementTypes.description: The element types whose tool defaults (the settings new elements get) are read.

includeValues.description: Adds the value of each property in the tool default (propertyValue), or an error in its place when it has none. Default is false.

propertiesOfToolDefaults.description: The properties of the tool defaults of each element type, in the order of the given element types. Invalid element types are represented by error objects.

GetPropertyAvailabilityOfDefaults.description: Tells whether the given properties are available and whether they are visible in the current tool default of an element type, before creating new elements. It checks the native tool default only, not a Favorite that is not applied. Unknown properties are reported as errors, not as unavailable. Available from Archicad 26.
GetPropertyAvailabilityOfDefaults.name: GetPropertyAvailabilityOfDefaults

elementType.description: The element type whose current tool default is checked. This is the native tool default, a Favorite counts only after it was applied.

propertyAvailabilities.description: The order is that of the given properties.

GetPropertyDefinitionsOfAttributes.description: Returns the property definitions of the given attributes (for example Building Materials): the user defined, the fundamental built-in, or all of them.
GetPropertyDefinitionsOfAttributes.name: GetPropertyDefinitionsOfAttributes

propertyDefinitionsOfAttributes.description: The property definitions of each attribute, in the order of the given attributes.

GetPropertyDefinitionsOfElementComponent.description: Returns the property definitions available on the given element components, optionally filtered to user defined or built-in ones.
GetPropertyDefinitionsOfElementComponent.name: GetPropertyDefinitionsOfElementComponents

filter.description: Which property definitions to return: the user defined (Custom) ones, the built-in ones, or all. The default is All.

propertyDefinitionsOfElementComponents.description: The property definitions available on each element component, in the order of the given element components. GetAllProperties returns the full details of a property.

GetPropertyEditability.description: Tells whether the values of the given properties can be modified, and whether the properties are visible, for the given elements. Also tells whether they can be modified in the tool defaults of element types (from Archicad 26) and in the default values of the property definitions themselves. Unknown elements, element types and properties are reported as errors, not as locked properties.
GetPropertyEditability.name: GetPropertyEditability

elementTypes.description: Checks whether the value of each property can be modified in the tool default of these element types.

elements.description: Checks whether the value of each property can be modified for these elements, and whether each property is visible for them.

propertyDefinitionDefaults.description: When true, checks whether the default value of each property definition can be modified. This is the default value of the property definition itself, not the tool default of an element type.

returns.description: Only the lists that were asked for are present.

editabilityOfElementTypeDefaults.description: Present when elementTypes were given. The order of the outer list is that of the given element types. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

editable.description: Whether the value of the property can be modified in the tool default of the element type.

editabilityOfElements.description: Present when elements were given. The order of the outer list is that of the given elements. The order of the inner lists are that of the given properties.

editable.description: Whether the value of the property can be modified for the element. False for example for read-only properties or expressions with cyclic references.

visible.description: Whether the property is visible for the element.

editabilityOfPropertyDefinitionDefaults.description: Present when propertyDefinitionDefaults is true. The order is that of the given properties.
