actualHeight.description: The height of the curtain wall as calculated by Archicad (ACAPI_CurtainWall_GetCWHeight). Omitted when Archicad cannot calculate it.

angle.description: The rotation angle of the curtain wall in radians.

belowViewLinePen.description: Pen index of the curtain wall's view below the cut plane on the floor plan, the uncut lines (API_CurtainWallType::uncutLinePen).

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type of the curtain wall's view below the cut plane on the floor plan, the uncut lines (API_CurtainWallType::uncutLineType). Omitted when not set.

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Cut fill background pen; the building material's pen can be overridden on the element level. Before Archicad 27 always reported as not overridden.

cutFillPen.description: Cut fill foreground pen; the building material's pen can be overridden on the element level. Before Archicad 27 always reported as not overridden.

cutProjectionMode.description: Projection mode of the cut part of the curtain wall on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::cutProjectionMode).

frameCutLinePen.description: Pen index of the cut part of the frames on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::frameCutLinePen).

frameCutLineTypeId.description: Line type of the cut part of the frames on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::frameCutLineType). Omitted when not set.

height.description: The height setting stored on the curtain wall element.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the curtain wall's vertical extent.

overheadProjectionMode.description: Projection mode of the overhead part (above the cut plane) of the curtain wall on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::overheadProjectionMode).

panelCutLinePen.description: Pen index of the cut part of the panels on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::panelCutLinePen).

panelCutLineTypeId.description: Line type of the cut part of the panels on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::panelCutLineType). Omitted when not set.

pen.description: The pen index of the curtain wall (API_CurtainWallType::pen).

referenceLine.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the curtain wall on the floor plan, one more than its segments (each pair of consecutive coordinates is one segment), as CreateCurtainWalls and ModifyCurtainWalls take them in coordinates. Empty when Archicad cannot return it.

uncutProjectionMode.description: Projection mode of the uncut part (below the cut plane) of the curtain wall on the floor plan (API_CurtainWallType::uncutProjectionMode).

useFrameTypesAttributes.description: The frames use the attributes of their frame types instead of frameCutLinePen/frameCutLineTypeId.

usePanelTypesAttributes.description: The panels use the attributes of their panel types instead of panelCutLinePen/panelCutLineTypeId.

zCoordinate.description: The absolute elevation of the bottom of the curtain wall: its home story's level plus its offset from it (API_CurtainWallType::planeOffset), as CreateCurtainWalls and ModifyCurtainWalls take it.

begCoordinate.description: The start of the frame. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

endCoordinate.description: The end of the frame. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

frameContour.description: The parameters of the frame contour.

homeStoryLevel.description: The absolute level of the curtain wall's home story: the z the other z values of this item are measured from. Add it to them for absolute coordinates.

panelConnectionHole.description: The parameters of the panel connection hole.

d.description: Depth of the panel connection hole.

w.description: Width of the panel connection hole.

segmentIndex.description: The index of the curtain wall segment to which this frame belongs.

CurtainWallFrameType.description: Enumeration of available curtain wall frame types.

homeStoryLevel.description: The absolute level of the curtain wall's home story: the z the other z values of this item are measured from. Add it to them for absolute coordinates.

isDegenerate.description: Indicates if the panel is degenerate. Omitted when Archicad cannot tell.

isHidden.description: Indicates if the panel is hidden (deleted panels remain in the database).

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the panel polygon. Their z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

segmentIndex.description: The index of the curtain wall segment to which this panel belongs.

CurtainWallPattern.description: The column (primary) or row (secondary) pattern of a curtain wall segment: the sizes of the columns/rows of one pattern unit and how the unit is repeated along the segment.

flexibleIndices.description: Zero-based indices of the columns/rows of the pattern unit that 'BestDivision' may stretch. When omitted, all of them are flexible. Ignored by 'FixedSizes'.

sizes.description: The sizes (widths of the columns or heights of the rows) of the pattern unit in meters, in order from the start of the segment or from the bottom. The unit is repeated to fill the segment.

CurtainWallPatternCell.description: The panel and frame classes of one cell of the pattern unit of a curtain wall segment. Panel classes are numbered as Archicad numbers them: 0 is no panel (the cell is left empty), 1 is the first panel class of the curtain wall (as listed in the Curtain Wall Settings, from the favorite or the tool defaults), 2 the second and so on. Frame classes: 0 is no frame (the cell is merged with its neighbour), 1 the Division frame, 2 the Corner frame, 3 the Boundary frame, 4 the first custom frame class of the curtain wall, 5 the second and so on. Fields not given keep the default assignment of the cell.

bottomFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the bottom edge of the cell (the grid line at the bottom of the row).

columnIndex.description: Zero-based column of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the start of the segment.

crossingFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the diagonal frame of the cell. Only used when crossingFrameType is not 'None'.

leftFrameClassIndex.description: The frame class of the frame on the left edge of the cell (the grid line at the start of the column).

panelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the cell. 0 leaves the cell without a panel (Archicad keeps a hidden 'deleted panel' subelement there). With a crossing frame it is the class of the left (or lower) half; see rightPanelClassIndex for the other half.

rightPanelClassIndex.description: The panel class of the right (or upper) half of a cell with a crossing frame. Defaults to panelClassIndex.

rowIndex.description: Zero-based row of the cell within the pattern unit, counted from the bottom.

CurtainWallPatternLogic.description: How the pattern unit fills the segment: 'FixedSizes' keeps the given sizes and repeats the unit, which may leave a partial unit at the end (Archicad: Fixed Size); 'BestDivision' stretches the flexible columns/rows so that whole units fill the segment with the least stretching (Archicad: Best Division).

CurtainWallPatternOrigin.description: Where the pattern unit is anchored on the segment: at its start, centered with a unit starting at the center, centered with a unit centered on the center, or at its end.

begCoordinate.description: The start of the segment's reference line. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

endCoordinate.description: The end of the segment's reference line. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

gridAngle.description: The angle of the grid in radians.

gridOrigin.description: The origin of the segment's grid. Its z is measured from the curtain wall's home story (see homeStoryLevel), not from project zero.

homeStoryLevel.description: The absolute level of the curtain wall's home story: the z the other z values of this item are measured from. Add it to them for absolute coordinates.

isNegativeArc.description: Indicates if the arc is negative.

CutPlane.description: Defines a 3D cut plane using the plane equation: pa*x + pb*y + pc*z + pd = 0

pa.description: Coefficient of x in the plane equation. The x coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pb.description: Coefficient of y in the plane equation. The y coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pc.description: Coefficient of z in the plane equation. The z coordinate of the normal vector of the plane.

pd.description: Constant term in the plane equation, in meters. The distance of the plane from the origin along the normal vector.

DatabaseById.description: Selects a database by ID; a window type may also be supplied.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

DatabaseByWindowType.description: Selects a database by window type; a database ID may also be supplied.

databaseId.description: The database to activate. When windowType is omitted, the window type is taken from the database; when both are given, they must match.

storyIndex.description: Story index to activate. Only valid when windowType is 'FloorPlan'. As returned by GetStories.

name.description: The name of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

referenceId.description: The reference id of the database. Missing when the database info cannot be read.

type.description: The type of the database.

DatabaseIdOrError.description: An Archicad database identifier or an error.

DatabaseIdsOrErrors.description: A list of Archicad database identifiers or errors.

Date.description: A date in its string representation as defined in ISO 8601: YYYY-MM-DD.

available.description: Whether the property is available for the tool default of the element type.

visible.description: Whether the property is visible for the tool default of the element type.

DeletionExecutionResult.description: The result of a deletion for one target. On a dry run a target that passed every check gets wouldDelete instead of being deleted.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

activeDesignOptions.description: The list of active design options in the combination. Available from Archicad 29.

designOptionCombinationId.description: The guid identifier of the design option combination.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option combination can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Available from Archicad 29.

name.description: The name of the design option combination.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option combination is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

DesignOptionCombinationId.description: The identifier of a design option combination.

DesignOptionCombinationIdOrError.description: A design option combination identifier or an error.

DesignOptionCombinationIdsOrErrors.description: A list of design option combination identifiers or errors.

id.description: The string id of the design option.

name.description: The name of the design option.

ownerSetName.description: The name of the owner design option set.

designOptions.description: The design options to turn off in the combination. The other options of the combination are left as they are.

id.description: The string id of the design option.

isEditable.description: Whether the design option can be renamed, deleted or changed now (for example it is not reserved by someone else in Teamwork). Returned by GetDesignOptions.

name.description: The name of the design option.

notEditableError.description: The reason why the design option is not editable. Only present when isEditable is false.

ownerSetName.description: The name of the owner design option set.

DesignOptionId.description: The identifier of a design option.

DesignOptionIdOrError.description: A design option identifier or an error.

DesignOptionIdsOrErrors.description: A list of design option identifiers or errors.

DesignOptionLinkType.description: The type of the associated design option.

DesignOptionSetId.description: The identifier of a design option set.

angle.description: The rotation angle (radian) of the marker symbol

clipPolygon.description: The clip polygon of the detail/worksheet

referredDrawing.description: Guid of the referred drawing. Only if the marker refers to a drawing.

referredPMViewPoint.description: Guid of the referred view point. Only if the marker refers to a view point.

referredView.description: Guid of the referred view. Only if the marker refers to a view.

DetailsOfElement.description: Details of an element. When the optional fields filter is given in the input, only the requested fields are present; the required list below applies to unfiltered requests.

compoundInfoString.description: The compound info string of the element, e.g. the summary of its composite or profile, as Archicad shows it. Present only when requested in additionalFields and the element has a non-empty one.

creatorToolUnId.description: The unique ID of the tool that created the element. Present only when requested in additionalFields and Archicad reports one for the element.

elementId.description: The identifier of the element. Returned when elementId is listed in fields, and always when no elements are given.

floorPlanPolygons.description: Cut-fill polygons as drawn on the floor plan (wall joins resolved by ArchiCAD). Only collected for construction element types whose floor plan symbol comes from a real cut through the element - walls, columns, beams and their segments, slabs, roofs, shells, meshes, morphs, curtain walls and their segments/panels/frames, stairs and their risers/treads/structures. Absent for every other type, when the element has no cut fill, or when the floor plan database is not accessible.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink; such elements are read-only.

infoString.description: The element ID (info string) as Archicad shows it. Present only when requested in additionalFields.

libraryPartUnId.description: The unique ID of the library part the element was placed from. Present only when requested in additionalFields and the element is library part based (e.g. object, lamp, door, window).

DimensionData.description: Dimension element data including witness points and geometry.

appearance.description: The dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings.

defaultWitnessForm.description: The witness line form of the dimension's settings (None, Small, Large or Fix); each witness point has its own witnessForm.

defaultWitnessVal.description: The value that goes with defaultWitnessForm, in meters. For Fix it is the length of the witness lines (the custom witness line length of the Dimension Settings). Each witness point has its own witnessVal.

elevationOrigin.description: The level an Elevation dimension measures from (kept for the other types too).

linePen.description: The pen of the dimension and witness lines.

marker.description: The marker at the witness points. Its size is not returned: the value the API reports did not match the marker size in the Dimension Settings for linear dimensions.

pen.description: The pen of the marker.

type.description: The marker type, named after API_MarkerID.

witnessPoints.description: The witness points of the dimension. Besides the geometry each item carries the base element reference as CreateAssociativeDimensions takes it (API_Base: baseElementId, line, inIndex, special, nodeType, nodeStatus, nodeId): read a dimension placed by hand to learn the values an element type needs.

DimensionDetails.description: The settings of a linear dimension (the Dimension tool), with the names ModifyAssociativeDimensions takes. The witness points are read with GetDimensionData.

appearance.description: The dimension type, as in the Dimension Settings.

defaultWitnessForm.description: The witness line form of the dimension's settings; each witness point has its own witnessForm.

defaultWitnessVal.description: The value that goes with defaultWitnessForm, in meters. Each witness point has its own witnessVal.

dimensionLinePosition.description: A point of the dimension line.

direction.description: The direction of the dimension line.

elevationOrigin.description: The level an Elevation dimension measures from (kept for the other types too).

linePen.description: The pen of the dimension and witness lines.

marker.description: The marker at the witness points. Its size is not returned: the value the API reports did not match the marker size in the Dimension Settings for linear dimensions.

pen.description: The pen of the marker.

type.description: The marker type, named after API_MarkerID.

textFrame.description: The text frame of the dimension's settings. Each witness point keeps its own (GetDimensionData).

textHeight.description: The text height of the dimension's settings in millimeters. Each witness point keeps its own (GetDimensionData).

textPen.description: The text pen of the dimension's settings. Each witness point keeps its own (GetDimensionData).

DimensionOrigin.description: The origin a level dimension measures from.

DisplayValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the displayed value.

Document3DAttributeOptions.description: The uniform attribute options (cut and uncut surfaces, shading, hidden edges).

elemPen.description: The uniform pen of the element contours.

hiddenEdgeLinePen.description: The pen of the hidden edges.

hiddenEdgeLineType.description: The index of the line type of the hidden edges.

shadContPen.description: The pen of the shadow contours.

shadFill.description: The index of the shadow fill.

shadFillBkgPen.description: The background pen of the shadow fill.

shadFillPen.description: The pen of the shadow fill.

shouldUseElemPen.description: Use a uniform pen for the element contours.

shouldUseUniformCutAttributes.description: Use uniform attributes on the cut surfaces.

uncutSurfaceBkgPen.description: The background pen of the uncut surfaces.

uniformFillBkgPen.description: The uniform fill background pen of the cut surfaces.

uniformFillPen.description: The uniform fill pen of the cut surfaces.

uniformLineType.description: The index of the uniform line type of the cut surfaces.

Document3DBoundaryDisplay.description: How the boundary contours are displayed.

Document3DPlanConnection.description: The connection of the 3D Document to the model.

changes.description: All changes belonging to the given document revision.

DocumentRevisionId.description: The identifier of a document revision.

DocumentRevisionReference.description: A reference to a document revision belonging to the current issue

DocumentRevisionReferences.description: All document revisions belong to the current issue.

DrawingAnchorPoint.description: The node of the drawing's bounding box the drawing is placed by (API_DrawingType::anchorPoint). Used only when useOwnOriginAsAnchor is false.

DrawingColorMode.description: How the drawing's pens are output (API_DrawingType::colorMode).

contentBox.description: The full boundary box of the Drawing's content, independent of its frame, as returned by Archicad.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

bounds.description: Bounds of the drawing on the layout.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). Archicad stores it as is; pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it. Present only when isCutWithFrame is true.

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Present only when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Present only when numberingType is CustomNumber.

drawingScale.description: The scale of the drawing, taken from its source view (e.g. 0.01 for 1:100).

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon (see clipPolygon) instead of showing the full auto-fit extent.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex.description: The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes.

isTransparentBackground.description: Whether the drawing's background is transparent (API_DrawingType::isTransparentBk).

linkPath.description: Path of the drawing's external source file (the Drawing Manager's Path column). Present only when the source is a file (external view, DWG/DXF, PDF, image, ...). Read-only.

linkType.description: The Drawing Manager's Source column: what kind of source the drawing is linked to. Read-only; absent when the link could not be read.

manualUpdate.description: The Drawing Manager's Update Type: true for Manual, false for Automatic. Read-only.

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing, in model meters. Used only by clipped drawings; Archicad then adds modelOffset * drawingScale (times ratio, rotated by angle) to pos.

navigatorItemId.description: Archicad's internal identifier of this Drawing's link (API_DrawingType::drawingGuid as Archicad reports it). This is NOT the navigator item id of the source view: CreateDrawings passes the source view in this field, but once the Drawing is created Archicad reports its own identifier, which is different for every Drawing (even two Drawings of the same view), is neither the source view nor the Drawing's item in the Layout Book, and is not accepted by navigator commands such as GetViewSettings. To find the source view of a placed Drawing, use the sourceNavigatorItemId of its DrawingItem in the Layout Book tree (GetNavigatorItemTree). Read-only: Archicad has no API to relink a Drawing to a different source (see ChangeDrawingLink).

penTableIndex.description: Attribute index of the pen set the drawing uses when penTableUsageMode is PenTableIndex (API_DrawingType::penTableIndex).

pos.description: Position of the drawing on the layout, in meters. Without a clip polygon it is the lower left corner of the drawing (before rotation); with one it is where the origin of the source view lands (a modelOffset can move it by modelOffset * drawingScale).

rasterizeDPI.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, a PDF drawing is rasterized at (API_DrawingType::rasterizeDPI).

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

status.description: The Drawing Manager's Status column. Read-only; absent when Archicad could not check the drawing.

storedInProject.description: The Drawing Manager's Stored in Project column: whether the drawing's content is stored in the project file. Read-only.

titleElementId.description: Id of the drawing title, itself a placed GDL object element (font/pen/size aside, its own settings are reachable like any other element, e.g. with GetGDLParametersOfElements/SetGDLParametersOfElements). Absent if the drawing has no title object.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

useOwnOriginAsAnchor.description: Whether the drawing is placed by its own origin instead of anchorPoint (API_DrawingType::useOwnOrigoAsAnchor).

DrawingLinkType.description: The kind of source a drawing is linked to (the Drawing Manager's Source column): a view of this project (InternalView), a view of another Archicad project file (ExternalView), a drawing file, a DWG/DXF file, a PDF, an image, a PlotMaker file, an Add-On generated drawing, or an unknown/other source.

DrawingNameType.description: How the drawing's title name is assembled (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

begC.description: The start point of the line, in layout coordinates.

endC.description: The end point of the line, in layout coordinates.

lineTypeIndex.description: The index of the line type of the line.

penIndex.description: The index of the pen of the line.

DrawingNumberingType.description: How the drawing's title ID is assigned (Identification tabpage of the Drawing Settings dialog).

DrawingPenTableUsageMode.description: Which pen table the drawing uses (API_DrawingType::penTableUsageMode): its own, the one of the model, or the pen set given by penTableIndex.

destBox.description: Pict: the bounding box of the picture.

determination.description: How the type of the line or fill is determined (origin, inner line, contour line).

lineType.description: Line, Arc, PLine, Tri and Poly: the line type.

loc.description: Point: the location. Text: the left baseline position.

nArcs.description: The number of curved segments. Their geometry is not returned.

pen.description: The pen index of the primitive.

polygons.description: Poly: the sub polygons, the first one is the outline, the others are holes.

referencedElement.description: Ctrl_ElementRef: the element the item refers to. The drawing of a Wall ends with one such item for each Window and Door in it.

drwIndex.description: The drawing order index of the referenced element.

type.description: The API_PrimTypeID name without its API_Prim prefix and ID suffix.

DrawingSettings.description: Modifiable settings for a Drawing element placed on a layout.

angle.description: Rotation angle of the drawing in radians.

borderLineTypeIndex.description: Attribute index of the line type of the drawing's border.

borderPenIndex.description: Pen index of the drawing's border.

borderSize.description: Border size of the drawing (API_DrawingType::borderSize), in meters.

clipPolygon.description: Polygon used to clip the drawing view, in layout coordinates (meters on the layout, the same coordinate system as pos and bounds - not the coordinates of the source view's model). It is stored as given: pos, angle, ratio and modelOffset are not applied to it, so a polygon taken from the model must be transformed to the layout first. At least 3 points. Setting this also enables polygon clipping (isCutWithFrame becomes true); to remove clipping, set isCutWithFrame to false instead.

customName.description: The drawing's custom title name. Only used when nameType is CustomName.

customNumber.description: The drawing's custom title ID. Only used when numberingType is CustomNumber.

drawingScale.description: The nominal scale of the drawing. Archicad may keep the existing value of a placed Drawing; the element's execution result is then a failure that names the value kept, although the other settings given were applied.

hasBorderLine.description: Whether the drawing shows a printable border (Drawing Settings > Frame > Add Printable Border).

isCutWithFrame.description: Whether the drawing is clipped by a custom polygon. Set to false to clear an existing crop and restore the drawing's full auto-fit extent. Only consulted when no clipPolygon is supplied in the same call - supplying a clipPolygon always enables clipping. Setting it to true without a clipPolygon merely re-enables the clip polygon already stored on the Drawing.

isInNumbering.description: Whether the drawing is included in the automatic drawing numbering sequence.

isScaleIncludedInAutotextAndIndex.description: The 'Include scale in Autotext and index' checkbox of Drawing Settings (API_DrawingType::includeInAutoTextsAndIES): whether the drawing's scale is included in the 'Drawing Scale' and 'Original Scale' Autotexts and in indexes. Set it to false on e.g. a 1:1 schedule drawing placed next to a 1:200 plan so that the layout's scale Autotext shows only 1:200.

isTransparentBackground.description: Whether the drawing's background is transparent (API_DrawingType::isTransparentBk).

modelOffset.description: Offset of the model origin within the drawing, in model meters. Used only by clipped drawings; Archicad then adds modelOffset * drawingScale (times ratio, rotated by angle) to pos.

penTableIndex.description: Attribute index of the pen set the drawing uses (API_DrawingType::penTableIndex). Archicad uses it only when penTableUsageMode is PenTableIndex; give both to switch the drawing to a pen set.

pos.description: Position of the drawing on the layout, in meters. Without a clip polygon it is the lower left corner of the drawing (before rotation); with one it is where the origin of the source view lands (a modelOffset can move it by modelOffset * drawingScale).

rasterizeDPI.description: The resolution, in dots per inch, a PDF drawing is rasterized at (API_DrawingType::rasterizeDPI).

ratio.description: Scale ratio applied to the drawing relative to its source view.

titleLibraryPartIndex.description: Library part index of the drawing title (API_DrawingTitle::libInd). A negative/invalid index means no title object is instantiated; setting it to a valid index (e.g. copied from another drawing) makes Archicad create the title's own placed element.

useOwnOriginAsAnchor.description: Whether the drawing is placed by its own origin instead of anchorPoint (API_DrawingType::useOwnOrigoAsAnchor).

DrawingStatus.description: The Drawing Manager's Status column: UpToDate (OK) when the drawing matches its source, Modified when the source changed since the drawing was last updated, Unknown when the status cannot be determined (e.g. a missing external source).

DryRun.description: If true, the command makes all the checks of a real run and resolves the same targets, with the same errors, but changes nothing in the project and creates no undo step. The response is that of a real run with "dryRun": true added, and says for each target what the real run would do. Default is false.

DryRunFlag.description: Present, and true, only in the response of a dry run (the dryRun input was true): nothing was changed in the project.

EditModeStateItem.description: The state of one hierarchical editing mode.

elementId.description: The element being edited. Only returned when inEditMode is true and Archicad reports the edited element.

inEditMode.description: True when Archicad is in this editing mode.

circuitId.description: The electrical circuit to connect to.

elementId.description: An electrical device or an electrical panel.

electricalPanelId.description: The panel to add the new circuit to.

wiringTypeName.description: One of the wiring types of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

ElectricalCircuitDetails.description: The details of an electrical circuit.

childDevices.description: The electrical devices connected to the circuit.

childPanels.description: The electrical panels connected to the circuit.

name.description: The name of the circuit, including the circuit name prefix of its panel.

ownerPanelId.description: The panel that owns the circuit.

phases.description: The used phases, as Archicad displays them.

wiringTypeName.description: The name of the wiring type, as defined in the electrical project settings.

ElectricalCircuitDetailsOrError.description: The details of an electrical circuit or an error.

wiringTypeName.description: One of the wiring types of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

circuitId.description: The circuit to connect the new device to.

libraryPartId.description: The library part to use, as listed by GetAvailableLibraryParts.

loadClassificationName.description: One of the load classifications of the electrical project settings, or an empty string for none.

orientation.description: Defaults to the direction (1, 0, 0) and the rotation (0, 1, 0).

position.description: The anchor point of the new device.

xSize.description: The size along the local x axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ySize.description: The size along the local y axis. Some library parts calculate their own size, then the item fails.

ElectricalDeviceDetails.description: The details of an electrical device (a light, socket or other consumer).

anchorPoint.description: The anchor point of the element.

apparentPower.description: The apparent power of the device in VA.

connectedElements.description: The MEP elements directly connected to the device.

libraryPartId.description: The library part of the element.

loadClassificationName.description: The name of the load classification, as defined in the electrical project settings.

parentCircuitId.description: The circuit the device is connected to. Missing when the device is not connected to a circuit.

rotation.description: The base rotation of the element in radians.

xSize.description: The size of the element along its local x axis.

ySize.description: The size of the element along its local y axis.

curveMember.description: A curve member, creating a beam or a column.

favoriteName.description: The name of the favorite whose settings the new element gets.

segmentedSurfaceMembers.description: The segments of a segmented surface member (a curved wall), creating one element.

surfaceMember.description: A surface member, creating a wall, a slab or a roof.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's 3D model, including those of its subelements for a Stair, Railing or Curtain Wall, and of its segments for a Column or Beam. Empty when the element has no solid 3D model (for example a 2D element, or one filtered out of the 3D view).

elements.description: The elements or child groups to be grouped.

fromOtherDatabase.description: Always true: the element is not in the current database.

hotlinkId.description: The hotlink instance this element belongs to. Present only for elements that came in through a placed hotlink.

sort.description: The sort key of the classification reference (its Sort attribute). Given from Archicad 29, missing when it has no value.

source.description: Where the reference comes from: preview (mapped by the preview IFC export translator) or local (stored on the element). Missing in Archicad 25, 26 and 27, where the storedOnly input chooses between the stored references and all of them.

ifcGlobalId.description: The IFC GlobalId (22 characters) of ifcId. Only returned before Archicad 28, where ifcId is in the GUID form; from Archicad 28 ifcId already is the GlobalId.

enumerationReference.description: For an enumerated value, the values of the enumeration it refers to (IfcPropertyEnumeration), each as a string. Available from Archicad 28; left out when the property has none.

value.description: The value of the property as a string. List and enumerated values are separated by semicolons.

valueType.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel or IfcLengthMeasure. For a table value it is the type of its defined values. Left out when the property has no value to take the type from.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

propertySetName.description: The name of the property set, for example Pset_DoorCommon.

propertyName.description: The name of the property, for example FireRating.

type.description: The IFC type of the value, for example IfcLabel, IfcText, IfcIdentifier, IfcBoolean, IfcLogical, IfcInteger, IfcReal or a measure type like IfcThermalTransmittanceMeasure. A type Archicad does not know is rejected.

value.description: The new value of the property. Provide a boolean for IfcBoolean and IfcLogical (IfcLogical also accepts the string Unknown), a number for the numeric types and a string for every other type.

xRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated x axis.

yRatio.description: The scaling along the rotated y axis.

criteriaPropertyObjects.description: The linked property objects whose criteria match the element.

individualLibraryPartGuid.description: The guid of the individually assigned library part, the same as the guid returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

individualLibraryPartIndex.description: The index of the library part of the individually assigned property object, the same as the index returned by GetAvailableLibraryParts. 0 when no property object is assigned individually.

individualLibraryPartName.description: The name of the individually assigned library part. Absent when there is none or it cannot be read.

linkByCriteria.description: True when the property objects matching their criteria are linked to the element.

links.description: The links starting from the element.

elbowParameters.description: The elbow parameters of a routing node (RoutingNode::Modifier::SetElbowDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

mirrorAxis.description: The mirror axis: the line through two points on the floor plan.

ElementQuantities.description: The type-specific quantities of an element. The fields depend on the type of the element.

isCore.description: The skin is marked as core.

isFinish.description: The skin is marked as finish.

projectedArea.description: Projected area of the skin. Archicad reports 0 when the legacy intersection and surface calculation is turned on in the Project Preferences.

subElementId.description: The sub-element (for example a column or beam segment) the skin belongs to. Present only when Archicad attaches the skin to a sub-element.

ElementRelationsOrError.description: The type-specific relations of an element or an error. The variant depends on the type of the input element.

ElementReservationState.description: Free: nobody has reserved the element. Editable: the current user has reserved it. Locked: another user has reserved it (see reservedBy).

owner.description: The Teamwork owner of the element. In Teamwork the owner is the user who has reserved the element, so this is the same user as reservedBy; kept for compatibility. Left out when the element is free.

reservedBy.description: The user who has reserved the element. Left out when the element is free.

elementSets.description: The element sets that contain the element. Empty if the element is not part of any element set.

elementSetId.description: The identifier of an element set.

surfaces.description: The surfaces of the element as Archicad reports them: one item per surface attribute and building material pair of the element, so an element has as many items as it has distinct pairs (a basic wall with three different surfaces reports three items). Empty when Archicad reports no surface for the element, for example for an element without a 3D model.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material of the part of the element the surface belongs to.

exposedArea.description: The area of the surface that is not covered by any of the covering elements, in square meters.

surfaceId.description: The surface (material) attribute of the surface. Left out when the surface is not a project attribute, for example one defined by a GDL script.

bodies.description: The solid bodies of the element's own 3D model, in Archicad's order, or an error for a body without texture information. polygons.description: One item per face of the body, in Archicad's order: the texture coordinates at the first vertex of the face, or an error.

point.description: The first vertex of the face, in world coordinates.

u.description: The u texture coordinate at the point.

v.description: The v texture coordinate at the point.

triangles.description: The triangles covering the polygon of the element, holes excluded, as Archicad triangulates it.

vertices.description: The 2D coordinates of the three vertices of the triangle.

trimmedBy.description: The roofs and shells trimming this element, with the trim type.

trims.description: The elements this roof or shell trims.

crossingReferenceLine.description: Elements whose reference line intersects the reference line of the element.

GraphicOverrideCriterion.description: Structured conditions of a graphic override rule, turned into Archicad's criterion XML (an alternative to criterionXML). Give exactly one property (classificationSystem and libraryPartSubtype go next to the condition they belong to). 'and'/'or' combine other conditions, nested at most three levels like the rows of the criteria editor (see their description). GetGraphicOverrideRules returns this shape with includeCriterion. 'elementType' filters by the tool an element was created with; 'all3DTypes'/'all2DTypes' match every 3D or 2D element. The other properties are conditions of Archicad's criteria editor: classification, layer and Model View, Construction, Positioning, Plan and Section, Surfaces and Materials, ID and Categories, Geometry, custom properties, and fields of the Wall, Column, Beam, Slab, Roof, Shell, Object/Lamp, Door/Window, Opening, Curtain Wall and Stair tools. Their identifiers were captured from rules made in the criteria editor of Archicad 29; Archicad 27 keeps the generated rules as well. Not available: text content, the line pen of a dimension, hotlinked modules and Xrefs, and the MEP system (their stored format is not decoded yet).

all2DTypes.description: If true, matches every 2D drawing element type.

all3DTypes.description: If true, matches every 3D model element type.

and.description: Matches if all of the nested criteria match. Nesting follows the criteria editor's table, at most three levels: the top 'and' holds the rows, a row with several values is an 'or' (values joined with 'or') or an 'and' (joined with 'and'), and values joined with 'and' within an 'or' row are one more 'and'. A deeper 'and'/'or' is rejected.

structuralFunctionNot.description: Matches elements whose structural function does not equal this value.

structureType.description: Matches elements whose structure type (Wall/Beam/Column basic vs. composite vs. complex profile) equals this value.

subTypeNameIs.description: Matches elements whose subtype name equals this string exactly.

surface.description: Matches elements whose surface is this Surface (Material) attribute (by name). ArchiCAD only offers 'contains'/'does not contain' for this field, no strict equality.

surfaceNameContains.description: Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name contains this substring.

surfaceNameEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name ends with this substring.

surfaceNameIs.description: Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name equals this string exactly.

surfaceNameIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Surface (Material) attribute name does not equal this string.

surfaceNot.description: Matches elements whose surface is NOT this Surface (Material) attribute (by name).

textAlignment.description: Matches texts whose alignment equals this.

textLineSpacing.description: Matches texts whose line spacing equals this percentage (100 is single spacing).

textPenContains.description: Matches elements whose text pen number is this value (ArchiCAD's 'contains' operator for a pen field, by plain pen number 1-255).

textPenIs.description: Matches elements whose text pen number equals this value (by plain pen number 1-255). Applies to 2D annotation elements - see 'fontIs' for the anchor-exemption note.

textPenNotContains.description: Matches elements whose text pen number is NOT this value (by plain pen number 1-255).

textStyle.description: Matches texts with exactly this combination of styles (an empty list matches texts with none).

uniqueIdContains.description: Matches elements whose unique ID contains this substring.

uniqueIdEndsWith.description: Matches elements whose unique ID ends with this substring.

uniqueIdIsNot.description: Matches elements whose unique ID does not equal this string.

uniqueIdNotContains.description: Matches elements whose unique ID does not contain this substring.

uniqueIdStartsWith.description: Matches elements whose unique ID starts with this substring.

variantNameContains.description: Matches elements whose design option name contains this text.

variantSetIs.description: Matches elements whose Variant Set equals this string exactly (e.g. 'Main Model'). Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.

variantSetIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Variant Set does not equal this string. Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.

variantSetNameContains.description: Matches elements whose design option set name contains this text.

variantStateIs.description: Matches elements whose Variant State equals this string exactly (e.g. 'Main Model'). Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.

variantStateIsNot.description: Matches elements whose Variant State does not equal this string. Variants are an Archicad 27+ feature - this criterion is meaningless on earlier versions.

wallComplexity.description: Matches walls whose complexity equals this.

wallComplexityNot.description: Matches walls whose complexity is NOT this.

wallConnectedOpeningIdsIs.description: Matches walls whose connected opening IDs list equals this string exactly.

wallContourPen.description: Matches walls whose 2D contour pen equals this plain pen index.

wallCutHatchBackgroundPen.description: Matches walls whose cut hatch background pen equals this plain pen index.

wallCutLine.description: Matches walls whose cut line is this Line Type attribute (by name).

wallGeometryType.description: Matches walls whose geometry type equals this.

wallHatchBackgroundPen.description: Matches walls whose hatch background pen equals this plain pen index.

wallReferenceLinePosition.description: Matches walls whose reference line position equals this.

wallSideSurface.description: Matches walls whose side surface is this Surface attribute (by name).

wallTopOffset.description: Matches walls whose top offset equals this value.

wallUncutLine.description: Matches walls whose uncut line is this Line Type attribute (by name).

wallWidth.description: Matches walls whose width equals this value.

GraphicOverrideElementType.description: The tool an element was created with. Window, Door, Zone, Label, Object, Lamp and GridElement were checked on Archicad 27 and 29 against the override Archicad applies to each element; Skylight, CornerWindow, WallEnd and the MEP parts are recognized by Archicad but were not checked on elements. Sub-elements (curtain wall panels, stair treads, railing posts, ...) and groups are not offered by the criteria editor: a rule on CurtainWall, Stair or Railing applies to the whole element.

GraphicOverrideFillTypes.description: The fill types an override applies to.

GraphicOverrideRule.description: A graphic override rule with its rule group, criterion and style.

criterion.description: The criterion as structured conditions, returned with includeCriterion. It can be passed to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules as it is. The top 'and' holds the rows of the criteria editor's table; a row with several values is an 'or' or 'and' of them, and values joined with 'and' within an 'or' row are one more 'and'. A condition that is not decoded yet is a {"criterionXML": ...} leaf, written back unchanged. Left out when criterionXML is not in the format Archicad keeps rules in.

criterionXML.description: The criterion of the rule, in the XML format Archicad saves override rules in. Change its values and pass it to CreateGraphicOverrideRules or ModifyGraphicOverrideRules to make similar rules.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group the rule belongs to.

name.description: The current name of the rule group.

newName.description: The new name of the rule group. It must not be empty or used by another rule group.

GraphicOverrideRuleId.description: The identifier of a graphic override rule.

GraphicOverrideRuleIdOrError.description: A graphic override rule identifier or an error.

beforeGraphicOverrideRuleId.description: The rule of the target group the moved rule is put in front of. Left out: the rule becomes the last of the group.

ruleGroupName.description: The rule group the rule is moved to; it can be the rule's own group to change its place there. Created when no rule group has this name.

GraphicOverrideRuleOrError.description: A graphic override rule or an error.

name.description: The name of the rule. Rule names are unique within the project.

ruleGroupName.description: The name of the rule group to search the rule in. Left out: every rule group is searched.

GraphicOverrideStyle.description: What a graphic override rule overrides and how. A field that is left out is not overridden.

fillBackgroundColor.description: The color that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundPen.

fillBackgroundPen.description: The pen index that replaces the background pen of fills. Use either this or fillBackgroundColor.

fillBackgroundPenAppliesTo.description: The fills the background pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.

fillForegroundPen.description: The pen index that replaces the foreground pen of fills.

fillForegroundPenAppliesTo.description: The fills the foreground pen override applies to. Left out: all fills.

fillType.description: The fill type that replaces the fill type of fills.

fillTypeAppliesTo.description: The fills the fill type override applies to. Left out: all fills.

hiddenContours.description: The contours to hide when overrideContours is true.

lineMarkerTextPen.description: The pen index that replaces the pen of lines, markers and texts.

lineType.description: The line type that replaces the line type of lines.

overridePenColorAndThickness.description: Override the pen color and thickness.

surface.description: The surface that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surfaceColor.

surfaceAppliesTo.description: The surfaces the surface override applies to. Left out: all surfaces.

surfaceColor.description: The color that replaces the surface of elements. Use either this or surface.

GraphicOverrideSurfaceTypes.description: The surface types an override applies to.

GroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the group identifier.

Guid.description: A Globally Unique Identifier (or Universally Unique Identifier) in its string representation as defined in RFC 4122.

arcs.description: The arcs of the hatch outline.

backgroundColor.description: RGB color of the fill background. Only present when it overrides fillBackgroundPenIndex.

buildingMaterialId.description: The building material attribute used, if the hatch's type is a building material hatch.

fillId.description: The fill attribute used, if the hatch's type is a plain fill hatch.

fillOrientation.description: Orientation, origin and distortion of the fill pattern.

foregroundColor.description: RGB color of the fill foreground. Only present when it overrides fillPenIndex.

roomSpecial.description: Special area percent in a room (negative means OFF).

showArea.description: True if the area text is shown.

HatchOrientation.description: Orientation and distortion parameters of a fill. When modifying an element, omitted properties keep their current values.

innerRadius.description: Radius for circular fill distortion, used when type is Centered.

matrix00.description: X component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.

matrix01.description: X component of the secondary distortion vector.

matrix10.description: Y component of the primary distortion (direction) vector.

matrix11.description: Y component of the secondary distortion vector.

origin.description: The origin of the fill relative to the project origin.

HatchSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Hatch. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (outline plus optional holes) and may change the number of vertices.

backgroundColor.description: RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill background, used instead of fillBackgroundPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillBackgroundPenIndex when both are given.

fillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Setting a pen removes the backgroundColor override, so the pen shows.

fillOrientation.description: Orientation, origin and distortion of the fill pattern. Omitted properties keep their current values. A given origin detaches the fill from the project origin, and a Global fill becomes Rotated unless a type is given as well. Archicad ignores the orientation of Solid fills (there is no pattern to orient).

fillPenIndex.description: Setting a pen removes the foregroundColor override, so the pen shows.

foregroundColor.description: RGB color (components between 0.0 and 1.0) of the fill foreground, used instead of fillPenIndex. Takes precedence over fillPenIndex when both are given.

hierarchicalElementType.description: The classification of the input element (not of its owner): MainElement is the main element of a hierarchical element (e.g. a Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing), ChildElement is a subelement of one (e.g. a frame or a tread), SingleElement is not part of a hierarchical element.

ownerElementId.description: The owner element. For a main element (e.g. a Curtain Wall) or an element that is not part of a hierarchical element, Archicad returns the input element itself.

HierarchicalOwnerMode.description: root: the root of the hierarchical element tree, e.g. the Curtain Wall, Stair or Railing. parent: the immediate parent, which may itself be a subelement.

Hole2D.description: A 2D hole in an element defined by closed polylines. The outline is given in 'polygonOutline'; 'polygonCoordinates' is accepted as a legacy alias.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the edge of the hole.

Hole3D.description: A 3D hole in an element defined by closed polylines

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the hole.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the polygon of the hole.

Holes2D.description: A list of 2D holes in an element defined by closed polylines

Holes3D.description: A list of 3D holes in an element defined by closed polylines

Hotlink.description: The details of a hotlink node.

children.description: The children of the hotlink node if it has any.

instances.description: The hotlink instance elements placed from the node, in the order Archicad returns them - the input of ChangeHotlinkInstances and DeleteElements. Omitted when the node's instances cannot be read.

location.description: The path of the hotlink file.

name.description: The display name of the hotlink node.

HotlinkDetails.description: Details of a placed hotlink instance: which node it comes from and where it sits.

mirrored.description: True when the module's local X axis is reflected.

rotationAngle.description: Counter-clockwise rotation about the origin, in radians.

layerIndex.description: Move the instance to this layer. A layerIndex that is not a layer of the project is refused.

mirrored.description: Reflect the module's local X axis before the rotation.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance's current z is kept.

rotationAngle.description: Rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians.

adjustLevelDiffs.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

floorDifference.description: Optional story offset applied to the module's stories. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

floorIndex.description: Optional story the instance is placed on. Defaults to the current story.

hotlinkNodeId.description: The node to place, from GetHotlinks or CreateHotlinkNodes. On Archicad 25 a node that has never been placed cannot be read, so a node created through the API can only be placed from Archicad 26 on.

ignoreTopFloorLinks.description: Optional. Top-linked elements keep their height rather than their top story link. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer of the instance. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default layer, or to the built-in Archicad layer when that layer has been deleted. A layerIndex that is not a layer of the project is refused.

mirrored.description: Optional. Reflects the module's local X axis before the rotation. Defaults to false.

origin.description: If z is omitted, the instance is placed at 0.

relinkWallOpenings.description: Optional. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

rotationAngle.description: Optional rotation about the origin, counter-clockwise, in radians. Defaults to 0.

skipNested.description: Optional. Do not place hotlinks nested inside the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

suspendFixAngle.description: Optional. Rotate fixed-angle elements with the module. Defaults to the hotlink tool's current default.

existing.description: True when a node for the same source file already existed and was returned instead of created.

HotlinkNodeCreatedOrError.description: The created (or already existing) node's guid, or an error.

HotlinkNodeId.description: The identifier of a hotlink node - the reference to a module source file, which instances are placed from.

HotlinkOrigin.description: Where a hotlink instance's origin lands, in the project's coordinates.

HotlinkOwnersOfElement.description: The hotlink an element comes from. Both ids are omitted when the element is not part of a hotlinked module.

hotlinkElementId.description: The hotlink element which contains the element (ACAPI_Hotlink_GetContainingHotlinkGuid).

hotlinkInstanceId.description: The hotlink instance the element belongs to (ACAPI_Hotlink_GetHotLinkOwner).

isInHotlink.description: True when Archicad reports a hotlink for the element, that is, when at least one of the ids below is returned.

HotlinkOwnersOfElementOrError.description: The hotlink an element comes from, or an error.

proxyElementId.description: The proxy element in the current project.

sourceElementId.description: The element in the hotlink's source file the proxy was made from.

proxyElements.description: The proxy elements of the instance, in no particular order.

location.description: Absolute path of the hotlink's source file.

status.description: The API_HotlinkSourceStatus value without its prefix (AuthCanceld is spelled as in the API).

height.description: Z coordinate of the hotspot (can come from a GDL script).

name.description: The name of the translator, as the IFC Translators dialog shows it.

preview.description: Whether this is the first item of Archicad's translator list, which the Archicad API documents as the preview translator (the one the IFC properties of elements are previewed with). No API identifies the preview translator otherwise, and in some projects the IFC Translators dialog shows another translator as the preview one.

IFCObject.description: An object of the IFC model of the project, as the IFC API of Archicad 28 and later identifies it.

elementId.description: The element the IFC object belongs to. Left out when Archicad reports no element for it.

globalId.description: The IFC GlobalId of the object. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

hashValue.description: The hash value of the IFC object identifier (ObjectID::GenerateHashValue), for matching the objects of one response to each other. It is not stable between sessions; use elementId or globalId to identify an object.

ifcType.description: The IFC entity type of the object, for example IfcWall. Left out when Archicad does not report it.

IFCPropertySource.description: Where the property comes from: preview for the properties mapped by the preview IFC export translator, local for the IFC properties stored in the element. Available from Archicad 28.

IFCPropertyType.description: The kind of the IFC property.

storyIndex.description: The index of the story the element is assigned to in the IFC model.

InputConstraint.description: Archicad's drawing constraint for the clicks of a Get...FromUser command: the cursor can only move along it, as when a coordinate is locked in the Tracker. It is dissolved when the command returns, also on Escape and on errors.

fromLastPoint.description: If true, the value is measured from the last clicked point (Archicad's local origin), otherwise from the project origin.

type.description: What is fixed: X = the X coordinate, Y = the Y coordinate, Z = the Z coordinate (3D window), Angle = the direction from the reference point (the cursor moves along a line), Distance = the distance from the reference point (the cursor moves along a circle).

value.description: The fixed value: a coordinate or distance in meters, or for Angle an angle in radians, counterclockwise from the X axis.

depth.description: How far each segment looks. Applied to every segment. Defaults to 1.0.

floorIndex.description: The story to place the interior elevation on. Defaults to the current story.

id.description: ID string of the interior elevation.

name.description: Name of the interior elevation. Each segment is named after it.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the connected segment chain. Each consecutive pair of points becomes one segment, so a room with four walls needs five points to be closed, or four to be left open.

IssueCommentStatus.description: The status of an issue comment.

IssueElementType.description: The attachment type of an element component of an issue.

KeynoteAutoTextTokens.description: The autotext tokens of a keynote item. A token can be used as the text content of a label to reference the field of the keynote item.

KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrError.description: The autotext tokens of a keynote item or an error.

KeynoteAutoTextTokensOrErrors.description: A list of keynote autotext tokens or errors.

KeynoteFolderDetails.description: The details of a keynote folder, including its subfolders and items recursively.

KeynoteFolderId.description: The identifier of a keynote folder.

KeynoteFolderIdOrError.description: A keynote folder identifier or an error.

KeynoteFolderIdsOrErrors.description: A list of keynote folder identifiers or errors.

KeynoteItemDetails.description: The details of a keynote item.

KeynoteItemId.description: The identifier of a keynote item.

KeynoteItemIdOrError.description: A keynote item identifier or an error.

KeynoteItemIdsOrErrors.description: A list of keynote item identifiers or errors.

LabelArrowType.description: Arrow head shape for a Label's leader line.

LabelClass.description: Whether this is a textual or a symbol label.

paragraphCount.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text'. Read-only: number of paragraphs in the memo (Tapir's own Create/Modify commands always produce 1).

rawText.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text' and Archicad's autotext flag could be switched for the read: the text content read with that flag turned off, so an autotext shows its key (e.g. '<PROJECTNUMBER>') instead of its value.

runs.description: Present only when labelClass is 'Text' and the content has paragraphs (always for content Tapir created): one entry per styled run, a single run too.

LabelLeaderLineAnchorPoint.description: How the leader line connects to the label text.

LabelLeaderLineDetails.description: Full readable leader-line/frame state of a Label: every field of LabelLeaderLineSettableDetails plus the leader line's coordinates.

contourOffset.description: Padding between the Label's frame and its content, in mm.

framed.description: Put a frame around the content.

hasLeaderLine.description: Whether the Label has a leader line (pointer line).

hideWithBaseElem.description: Hide the label together with its parent element.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the leader line.

penIndex.description: Pen attribute index of the leader line.

squareRootAngle.description: Angle in radians, used only when leaderShape is 'SquareRoot'. Valid range 1-179 degrees.

LabelLeaderLineSettableDetails.description: Every user-configurable leader-line/frame/arrow setting of a Label (top-level API_LabelType fields, shared by both Text and Symbol label classes). Shared by CreateLabels ('leaderLine'), ModifyLabels ('leaderLine'), and the Get response.

contourOffset.description: Padding between the Label's frame and its content, in mm.

framed.description: Put a frame around the content.

hasLeaderLine.description: Whether the Label has a leader line (pointer line).

hideWithBaseElem.description: Hide the label together with its parent element.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the leader line.

penIndex.description: Pen attribute index of the leader line.

squareRootAngle.description: Angle in radians, used only when leaderShape is 'SquareRoot'. Valid range 1-179 degrees.

LabelSymbolStyleSettableDetails.description: Every user-configurable style setting specific to a Symbol-class Label (top-level API_LabelType fields documented as 'for symbol labels only'). Shared by CreateLabels ('symbolStyle'), ModifyLabels ('symbolStyle'), and the Get response.

backgroundFillPenIndex.description: Effective only if useBackgroundFill is true.

fontName.description: Name of the font, as the Font attributes carry it. index.description: The index of the new row in the table. Archicad 27: in the list of its shape, after the call.

MEPPreferenceRowChange.description: Changes one row of a preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values are changed. A value that does not belong to the kind of table is an error; the read-only values (reference ids, branchAxisAngle, isValid, and angle of an elbow table) are ignored.

angle.description: Ventilation transition tables, in the unit GetMEPPreferenceTables returns it. Read-only (ignored) in elbow tables.

delete.description: Deletes the row. The circular segment tables, and the elbow tables in Archicad 28, have a fixed row for each reference id; there the row is emptied instead. Cannot be combined with new values.

length.description: Branch tables and piping transition tables.

value.description: Rectangular duct and cable carrier segment tables. These tables keep their rows ordered by value, so a changed value can move the row; the indices of the other rows given in the same call are followed.

valid.description: Whether the row is valid. Archicad 27: whether the list of the shape has a row with the index.

MEPPreferenceRowIndex.description: The position of the row in its preference table, as ModifyMEPPreferenceTables expects it. Rows that cannot be read are left out of GetMEPPreferenceTables, so this is not always the position in the rows list.

MEPPreferenceRowKey.description: The key of a row. Segment tables: referenceId. Elbow tables: referenceId and angle. Branch tables: mainAxisReferenceId, branchAxisReferenceId and branchAxisAngle. Transition tables: beginReferenceId and endReferenceId. The angles are as GetMEPPreferenceTables returns them; Archicad 28 finds the rows by their reference ids only and rejects a key with an angle. Archicad 27: shape and index (AddMEPPreferenceTableRows: shape only).

index.description: Archicad 27 only: the index of the row in the list of its shape, from 0.

shape.description: Archicad 27 only: the shape whose list of values the row is in.

index.description: Archicad 27 only: the index of the row after the call, which can differ from the index of its key when setting a value moves rows. The keys are the indices before the call.

MEPPreferenceRowValues.description: The values of a row, lengths in meters. Segment tables: diameter, wallThickness and description. Elbow tables: diameter, radius and description. Branch tables: mainAxisDiameter, branchAxisDiameter, length, branchOffset, connectionLength and description. Pipe transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, length and description. Duct transition tables: beginDiameter, endDiameter, angle and description. Archicad 27: value and description.

value.description: Archicad 27 only: the value of the row.

isEditable.description: Whether the table can be edited.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Whether the table uses individual segmentation lengths. Available from Archicad 29.

MEPPreferenceTableChange.description: Changes one preference table, in the shape GetMEPPreferenceTables returns. Only the given values and rows are changed.

maximumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the minimum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

minimumSegmentationLength.description: Segment tables only; the maximum is kept when not given. Available from Archicad 29.

name.description: The new name of the table.

newRows.description: Rows to add to a rectangular duct or cable carrier segment table, after the other changes. Adding rows to the other tables is not supported yet.

rows.description: The rows to change or delete, each at most once. All indices refer to the table before this call.

useIndividualSegmentLengths.description: Segment tables only. Available from Archicad 29.

domain.description: The MEP domain of a preference table container.

sizes.description: The number of rows of each shape.

tableId.description: The id of a preference table, for the tableId of the preference table row commands.

MEPReferenceSet.description: The reference ids (nominal sizes) that the preference tables of a domain can use.

crossSectionReferenceId.description: Optional cross section reference id of the segment preference table (used for circular cross sections). Resolved against preferenceTableId if given, otherwise against the table of the current routing tool default.

crossSectionWidth.description: Optional cross section width applied to all segments.

defaults.description: Optional changes to the routing tool default of the domain before the route is placed. Only what is placed changes, not the routing tool's settings. A value that cannot be set gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

routingNode.description: The routing node default: the elbows and transitions placed at the nodes of the route. Available from Archicad 29.

factorRadius.description: The radius factor of the elbows placed at the nodes.

preferenceTableId.description: The guid of an elbow preference table of the domain (see GetMEPPreferenceTables with includeFittingTables).
The guid of a transition preference table of the domain (see GetMEPPreferenceTables with includeFittingTables).

floorIndex.description: Optional home story index (as returned by GetStories) of the routing element and all its parts. The node coordinates stay absolute: the route is placed at them, then moved to this home story. Without it, Archicad picks the home story, which follows the active story. A story that does not exist gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

layerIndex.description: Optional layer attribute index of the routing element and all its parts (routing segments, rigid segments, elbows and transitions). Only a positive index takes effect; otherwise the routing tool default layer is used. A layer that does not exist or is locked gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed.

nodeCoordinates.description: The corner points of the route polyline.

preferenceTableId.description: Optional guid of the segment preference table (see GetMEPPreferenceTables) applied to all segments. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

logicallyConnectedPortIdAtRouteBegin.description: The port logically connected to the beginning of the route (see GetMEPPorts). Not present when nothing is connected there.

logicallyConnectedPortIdAtRouteEnd.description: The port logically connected to the end of the route (see GetMEPPorts). Not present when nothing is connected there.

anchor.description: Applied to all segments of the routing element.

connectionStyle.description: New connection style applied to all segments.

floorPlanDisplayOption.description: New floor plan display option of the routing element. Available from Archicad 29.

nodePositions.description: New positions of the routing nodes. The size must match the number of nodes of the route.

onStoryVisibility.description: New on-story visibility of the routing element. Available from Archicad 29.

preferenceTableId.description: New segment preference table (guid as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables) applied to all segments. Not applicable to the CableCarrier domain.

preferredTransitionPlacement.description: New preferred transition placement applied to all nodes.

wallThickness.description: New wall thickness applied to all segments.

outgoingSegmentId.description: The routing segment starting at this node. Not present at the end of the route.

A transition preference table, as returned by GetMEPPreferenceTables.

A value that cannot be set gives an error for the item, and nothing is placed. The insulation thickness of a take-off cannot be set (Archicad stops with a fatal error).

removeInsulation.description: If true, the take-off is placed without insulation.

distanceFromBeginning.description: The distance of the take-off from the beginning of the segment, in meters. Must not be negative or more than the length of the segment.

rotationAroundMainAxis.description: Optional rotation of the take-off around the axis of the segment, in radians. Archicad places take-offs only at quarter turns, so it must be a multiple of pi/2 (negative values and full turns are allowed). Defaults to 0, which places the take-off facing left relative to the segment's direction; pi/2 faces up, pi faces right, 3*pi/2 (or -pi/2) faces down.

segmentId.description: The routing segment to place the take-off on (the elementId of an item of 'segments' returned by GetMEPRoutingElements).

MEPTransitionDefaults.description: The transition parameters of a routing node (RoutingNode::Modifier::SetTransitionDefaultParameters). Archicad 29 or newer.

level.description: The Z reference level of coordinates.
