showLines.description: Whether to show secondary mesh lines on plan.

sublines.description: The leveling sublines inside the polygon of the mesh. Replaces existing sublines entirely.

MeshRidges.description: How ridges between mesh facets are displayed in 3D: 'AllSharp' shows all ridges, 'AllSmooth' hides them, 'UserDefined' shows only ridges along user-defined level lines (the drawing-set look for contour-line topography).

MeshSkirtType.description: The type of the skirt structure.

coordinates.description: The 3D coordinates of the leveling subline of the mesh.

libPartName.description: The name of the element's library part, also when the library containing it is not loaded.

componentType.description: The component type: the API_3DTypeID enumerator name without its API_ prefix and ID suffix.

count.description: The number of components of this type.

ModelViewOptionId.description: The identifier of the model view option combination.

MorphBody.description: A Morph's full body geometry: an indexed vertex list plus one entry per face (polygon). Shared shape between GetDetailsOfElements' output and CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs' input - what Get reports is what Create/Modify accept back. There is no fillet/chamfer operation in the Archicad API - a caller wanting rounded geometry must supply the already-tessellated facets here; edgeOverrides only controls how an existing straight edge is DISPLAYED (hidden/visible/smooth-shaded), not its shape.

bodyType.description: Whether the body is a closed solid or an open surface shell. Reported accurately on Get; on Create/Modify this is set on the element but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect (bodyType has been observed always coming back Solid regardless of what was requested - see edgeOverrides' note).

edgeDefault.description: Default display status for every edge that has no entry in edgeOverrides. Reported accurately on Get. On Create/Modify it takes effect from Archicad 29 on, where it is applied to every edge of the element with ACAPI_Element_ChangeMorphEdgeType right after the element is created or changed (e.g. 'HardHidden' hides all edges of a triangulated body). The Morph's layer must be shown and unlocked: on a hidden or locked layer CreateMorphs creates no Morph and returns an error. On Archicad 28 and earlier it is set on the element but does not take effect due to the same confirmed Archicad SDK bug as edgeOverrides (element.morph.edgeType is silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change).

edgeOverrides.description: READ-ONLY in practice: reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (reflecting whatever Archicad itself currently has), but CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs silently ignore this field on input - per-edge display status cannot be set by an add-on due to a confirmed, still-unresolved Archicad SDK bug (element.morph.edgeType/bodyType are silently discarded by ACAPI_Element_Create/Change; see the GRAPHISOFT community forum thread 'Help with setting morph's hidden edges in the API'). To hide or smooth ALL edges of a Morph use edgeDefault, which does take effect from Archicad 29 on. Sparse when present - only edges whose display status differs from edgeDefault get an entry. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects.

silhouetteOnly.description: Show this edge's line only where it forms a silhouette/contour from the current viewpoint.

smooth.description: Shade the two adjacent faces smoothly across this edge instead of as a hard crease - the 'aide a la courbe' rounded-look hint. Does not change actual geometry.

isClosed.description: READ-ONLY, Get output only (ignored if sent to Create/Modify). Geometrically computed (Modeler::MeshBody::IsClosedBody): true if every edge in the body has exactly two adjacent faces (a watertight/manifold volume), false if any edge borders only one face (an open shell / has holes or gaps). Distinct from bodyType, which is the caller's declared INTENT (Solid vs Surface) rather than the actual computed geometry - a body can be declared bodyType 'Solid' yet still be geometrically open if a face is missing.

polygons.description: One entry per face loop (into `vertices`), counterclockwise as seen from outside the body. Optional - a body made entirely of wireEdges (see below) needs none. Set "filled": false on an entry to create only that loop's edges (e.g. the outline of a pyramid's side faces) without an actual filled face.

vertices.description: Flat, indexed vertex list, local to the Morph's own placement (not world coordinates). A Solid body needs at least 4 (a tetrahedron, the minimum closed volume); a Surface body has no closedness requirement at all - the minimum is 2 vertices joined by a single wireEdge (a lone vertex with no edge at all is rejected by Archicad itself, confirmed live) - enforced with a bodyType-aware error message, not by this minItems floor alone.

wireEdges.description: Standalone edges that belong to no face at all (e.g. a bare rectangle outline, or a pyramid with a filled base but wireframe-only sides - set "filled": false on a polygons entry for a whole closed loop like that instead, this is for individual edges not already covered by any polygon loop). Reported accurately by GetDetailsOfElements (every edge with zero adjacent faces); accepted back by CreateMorphs/ModifyMorphs. Identifies an edge by the (unordered) pair of vertex indices it connects - reuses whatever edge already exists between those two vertices if the polygons above happen to share it.

buildingMaterialId.description: The Morph's building material - a single, whole-volume property (what the mass is 'made of', governing cut-fill/quantity takeoff), NOT settable per face. Per-face appearance is controlled separately by each polygon's own surfaceId (see MorphBody) - confirmed live these are two independent, unrelated attributes (a Morph can have one uniform building material while showing a different Surface finish on each face).

castShadow.description: Whether the body casts shadow in 3D.

coverFillType.description: Floor plan fill type (only used when useCoverFillType is true).

cutFillBackgroundPen.description: Overridden cut fill background pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutFillPen.description: Overridden cut fill foreground pen (otherwise inherited from the building material). Omit to leave uninherited/unset.

cutLineType.description: Line type of the cut contour.

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, the per-story visibility (showContour/showFill) is calculated automatically from the Morph's vertical extent instead of using the explicit values.

level.description: Z position of the free shape relative to the floor level. Reported accurately on Get, but a confirmed Archicad SDK bug means it may not take effect on Create/Modify (same class of bug as bodyType/edgeType - see MorphBody's notes).

origin.description: Translation component of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's origin column).

overheadLinePen.description: Pen of the overhead part (floor plan only).

overheadLineType.description: Line type of the overhead part (floor plan only).

receiveShadow.description: Whether the body receives shadow in 3D.

showContour.description: Which stories display this Morph's contour. Reported accurately on Get, but confirmed live that Create/Modify do not reliably apply it (showAllBelow/showRelAbove/showRelBelow silently come back reset even when explicitly set and isAutoOnStoryVisibility is false) - the same class of confirmed Archicad SDK write bug as bodyType/edgeType/level (see MorphBody's notes). Set on the element regardless since doing so is harmless and forward-compatible.

showFill.description: Which stories display this Morph's floor plan fill. Same write-reliability caveat as showContour.

surfaceId.description: The Morph's own default Surface (element.morph.material) - used for any face that has no per-face surfaceId override of its own (see MorphBody polygons[].surfaceId). Distinct from buildingMaterialId (the whole-volume material). Confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this specific field when set through ACAPI_Element_Create alone (reproduced identically on Archicad 27 and 29 - not a version-specific issue, unlike polygons[].surfaceId below); CreateMorphs works around this transparently with an internal follow-up Change right after Create, so this field behaves correctly end-to-end despite the underlying quirk.

textureProjectionCoords.description: Texture projection coordinate system: origin, then 3 axis endpoints.

use3DHatching.description: Derive the floor plan fill from the 3D material instead of coverFillType.

useCoverFillType.description: Use a dedicated floor plan fill instead of the one from the building material.

useDistortedCoverFill.description: Show the floor plan hatching as if projected onto a plane.

xAxis.description: X axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's first column). Omit on Create to get an identity rotation; give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

yAxis.description: Y axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's second column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

zAxis.description: Z axis of the Morph's placement transform (tranmat's third column). Give all three of xAxis/yAxis/zAxis together or none at all.

filled.description: Defaults to true. Set to false to create only this loop's edges (a wireframe outline, e.g. a bare rectangle with no surface fill) without an actual face - holes/surfaceId are ignored in that case, since there is no fill for them to apply to.

holes.description: Optional hole loops cut out of this face, each a clockwise list of vertex indices.

surfaceId.description: Optional per-face surface (render material) override. Uses the Morph's default surface when omitted. Ignored during creation in Archicad 25.

vertexIds.description: Counterclockwise outer-loop vertex indices for this face.

MorphQuantities.description: Quantities of a Morph element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

floorPlanArea.description: Net area of the floor plan projection.

floorPlanPerimeter.description: Perimeter of the floor plan projection.

height.description: Height of the morph.

surface.description: Net area of the body surface.

NameKind.description: The kind of an item of the project that ResolveNames looks a name up among: a story, an attribute of the given type, an element type (matched by its API name and, from Archicad 27, by the name the Archicad interface shows), a property (built-in or custom; matched by its name and by its group and name together), or a classification (a classification system, matched by its name and by its name and version together, or an item of any system at any depth, matched by its name, by its ID and by both together).

NameMatch.description: An item of the project that a name matches, as ResolveNames returns it.

attributeIndex.description: The index of the attribute. Only for an attribute.

availability.description: The classification items the property is available for: an element has the property only when it is classified as one of them. Only for a custom property; built-in properties have no such list.

classificationItemCode.description: The ID of the classification item, as Archicad shows it (for example Ss_25_10). Only for a classification item.

classificationItemId.description: The classification item. Only for a classification item, not for a classification system.

classificationSystemId.description: The classification system, or the system of the classification item. Only for a classification.

classificationSystemName.description: The name of the classification system. Only for a classification.

level.description: The level of the story, in meters. Only for a story.

match.description: How the name matches. exact: the same characters. normalized: the same except for case, accents, spacing and separators (FireRating, fire_rating, Fire Rating). words: every word of one is a word of the other, or at least half of their words are shared. contains: one contains the other. similar: a few characters differ.

name.description: The name of the item in the project. For an element type, the name the Archicad interface shows (from Archicad 27; the API name before). For a classification item, its name, or its ID when it has no name.

propertyCollectionType.description: Whether the property holds one value, a list, or one or more choices of a list of options. Only for a property.

propertyGroupId.description: The group of the property. Only for a property.

propertyGroupName.description: The name of the group of the property. Only for a property.

propertyId.description: The property, as GetPropertyValuesOfElements and SetPropertyValuesOfElements take it. Only for a property.

propertyIsEditable.description: Whether the value of the property can be set. Only for a property.

propertyMeasureType.description: What a number value of the property measures. Only for a property; left out for the attribute index types of some built-in properties.

propertyType.description: Whether the property is built in or custom. Only for a property.

propertyValueType.description: The type of the values of the property. Only for a property.

score.description: How close the match is, from 0.6 to 1 (1 for exact and normalized matches).

storyIndex.description: The index of the story (the floor index the commands take). Only for a story.

NavigatorItem.description: A navigator item and the subtree below it.

childCount.description: The number of direct children Archicad reports for the item. Only present when GetNavigatorItemTree is called with includeChildCount true.

children.description: The children of the navigator item. Missing when the item has no children.

customName.description: True when the name was typed by hand instead of being inherited from the Project Map source - the View Settings name "Custom" radio button.

customUiId.description: True when the identifier was typed by hand instead of being inherited from the Project Map source - the View Settings ID "Custom" radio button.

isIndependent.description: True when the item is independent, that is when its link to the Project Map is broken.

name.description: The name of the navigator item.

prefix.description: The floor number for story items, an empty string for every other item type.

sourceNavigatorItemId.description: The identifier of the navigator item this one was created from: the Project Map item behind a view, or the source view behind a placed Drawing's Layout Book entry. Missing when the item has no such source; Project Map items never do.

uiId.description: The identifier shown next to the name on the navigator.

NavigatorItemId.description: The identifier of a navigator item.

NavigatorItemIdOrDatabaseIdAndWindowType.description: Identifies the window to change to. Either a navigatorItemId on its own (the navigator item's saved view settings are applied), or a windowType optionally narrowed to a specific databaseId, or a databaseId on its own (its window type is resolved automatically).

NavigatorItemIds.description: A list of navigator item identifiers.

NavigatorItemType.description: The type of the navigator item.

name.description: The name of the parent navigator item.

nextClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of the next sibling classification item. If not specified, the new classification item will be created as the last child of its parent.

parentClassificationItemId.description: The identifier of the parent classification item. If not specified, the new classification item will be created as a child of the root.

NonLocalizedValueEnumId.description: An enumeration value identifier using the nonlocalized value.

NormalAngleListPropertyValue.description: An angle list property value containing angles in an array. The values are measured in SI (radians).

NormalAnglePropertyValue.description: An angle property value containing a real angle. The value is measured in SI (radians).

NormalAreaListPropertyValue.description: An area list property value containing areas in an array. The values are measured in SI (square meters).

NormalAreaPropertyValue.description: An area property value containing a real area. The value is measured in SI (square meters).

NormalBooleanListPropertyValue.description: A boolean list property value containing boolean values in an array.

NormalBooleanPropertyValue.description: A boolean property value containing a valid boolean value.

NormalIntegerListPropertyValue.description: An integer list property value containing integers in an array.

NormalIntegerPropertyValue.description: An integer property value containing a valid integer number.

NormalLengthListPropertyValue.description: A length list property value containing length values in an array. The values are measured in SI (meters).

NormalLengthPropertyValue.description: A length property value containing a real length value. The value is measured in SI (meters).

NormalMultiEnumPropertyValue.description: A multiple choice enumeration property value containing the IDs of the selected enum values in an array.

NormalNumberListPropertyValue.description: A number list property value containing numbers in an array.

NormalNumberPropertyValue.description: A number property value containing a valid numeric value.

NormalOrUserUndefinedPropertyValue.description: A normal or a userUndefined property value.

NormalSingleEnumPropertyValue.description: A single enumeration property value containing the ID of the selected enum value.

NormalStringListPropertyValue.description: A string list property value containing strings in an array.

NormalStringPropertyValue.description: A string property value containing a valid string.

NormalVolumeListPropertyValue.description: A volume list property value containing volumes in an array. The values are measured in SI (cubic meters).

NormalVolumePropertyValue.description: A volume property value containing a real volume. The value is measured in SI (cubic meters).

NotAvailablePropertyValue.description: A notAvailable value means that the property is not available for the property owner (and therefore it has no property value for it).

keyword.description: The keyword of the note autotext.

autotextId.description: The numeric value of the autotext's API_NoteAutotextID in the Archicad API.

elementTypes.description: The element types the autotext is available for.

ObjectDetails.description: Shared shape for Object and Lamp elements (both use the same API_ObjectType struct). lightColor/lightIsOn only apply to Lamps. Per the Archicad SDK's own remarks, per-story visibility (visibility.showRelAbove/showRelBelow) and visibility.linkToSettings.newCreationMode were 'not extended' for Object/Lamp the way they were for other element types - still settable here for schema symmetry, but Archicad may silently ignore them.

fixPoint.description: 0-based index of the hotspot to keep fixed when the object is resized (raw API_ObjectType.fixPoint value, not 1-based).

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: Recalculate per-story visibility automatically from the object's vertical extent ('All Relevant Stories').

lightColor.description: Lamp only. Reported accurately here, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (always reports the library part's own default light color). lightIsOn (the on/off state) does not have this problem.

offset.description: Offset of the symbol's origin from the insertion point. Reported accurately here, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify (always reports the library part's own default hotspot offset regardless of what is sent) - same class of read-only-in-practice field as Morph's bodyType/edgeType/level.

useFixSize.description: Use the A/B (dimensions.x/dimensions.y) values as fixed sizes.

useFixedAngle.description: Use a fixed rotation angle (API_ObjectType.fixedAngle - stored as Int32 in the API despite being boolean in practice). Reported accurately here, but confirmed live that Archicad silently discards this value through both Create and Modify.

useObjectLineTypes.description: Use the line type defined in the library part instead of 'lineTypeId'.

useObjectMaterials.description: Use the materials defined in the library part instead of 'surfaceId'.

useObjectPens.description: Use the pen defined in the library part instead of 'pen'.

useObjectSectionAttributes.description: Use the section attributes defined in the library part instead of 'sectionFillId'/'sectionFillPen'/'sectionFillBackgroundPen'/'sectionContourPen'.

OpeningRelationsOfElement.description: Relations of a curtain wall panel, skylight, window or door: the zones on the two sides of the opening.

coreOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the core skin of the owner wall, to convert to the wall side reference.

elementId.description: A window or door placed in a wall.

sideOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the side of the owner wall, to convert to the core skin reference.

coreOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the core skin of the owner wall.

sideOffset.description: Reveal depth offset measured from the side of the owner wall.

OverriddenMaterial.description: A surface material that may override the one inherited from the element's structure (building material, composite or profile).

overridden.description: True if the material is overridden on the element level.

OverriddenPen.description: A pen index that may override the one inherited from the element's structure. On Archicad versions where the underlying element does not support this override, 'overridden' is always false.

overridden.description: True if the pen is overridden on the element level.

OverriddenValue.description: A value the active graphic override combination may replace. 'overridden' tells whether it does; only then the value is given: 'attributeId' for line types, fills and surfaces, 'penIndex' for pens, 'color' for background pens and surfaces set to a color.

PartialStructureDisplay.description: The Partial Structure Display mode of the current window.

description.description: Textual description of the pen.

index.description: Index of the pen [1..255].

width.description: Thickness of the pen defined in paper millimeters.

PenTableAttributeOrError.description: A pen table attribute or an error.

PerspectiveProjectionParameters.description: The parameters of a perspective projection of the 3D window.

azimuth.description: The azimuth of the camera in degrees: the direction from the target to the camera, counterclockwise from the X axis. Archicad works it out from the camera and target positions, so a set value is replaced by that.

distance.description: The distance between the camera and the target.

isTwoPointPersp.description: True for a two-point perspective (vertical edges stay vertical).

rollAngle.description: The roll angle of the camera.

sun.description: The sun position of the perspective. Get3DProjectionSettings always returns it; Set3DProjectionSettings changes only the values given and keeps the current sun when it is missing.

targetPosition.description: The position of the target point the camera looks at.

viewCone.description: The view cone angle of the camera in degrees.

PlaceSettingsUpdate.description: The place settings to change (API_PlaceInfo), with its field names. Only the given keys are changed; an empty object changes nothing and returns the current settings.

sumTime.description: Whether summer time (+1 hour) is on.

timeZoneInMinutes.description: The time zone, in minutes from Greenwich.

timeZoneOffset.description: Tells apart time zones with the same timeZoneInMinutes.

model.description: The model of the selected plotter.

name.description: The name of the selected plotter.

PolyArc.description: Representation of an arc segment of a two dimensional polygon/polyline.

arcAngle.description: Angle of the arc; it is positive, if the arc is on the right-hand side of the straight segment.

begIndex.description: Node index of one end point of the arc.

endIndex.description: Node index of the other end point of the arc.

PolygonAncestry.description: Read from the vertexAncestry and edgeAncestry of Archicad's API_RegularizedPoly; -1 marks a vertex or edge that Archicad created (for example at a self-intersection).

contours.description: One item per contour of this result: the outline first, then the holes in order.

edges.description: For each edge of the contour (edge i runs from vertex i to the next one), the input edge it came from.

vertices.description: For each vertex of the contour, the input vertex it came from.

PolygonEdgeAncestry.description: An input vertex or edge: the contour (0 is the outline, k the hole at index k-1 of the request) and the vertex or edge in it (edge i runs from vertex i to the next one). Both are -1 when Archicad created it.

PolygonInputMethod.description: Polygon input method. 'General' = free polygon, 'Rect' = axis-aligned rectangle, 'RotRect' = rotated rectangle, 'Polyline' = open polyline.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline. A last coordinate equal to the first is ignored.

PolygonVertexAncestry.description: An input vertex or edge: the contour (0 is the outline, k the hole at index k-1 of the request) and the vertex or edge in it (edge i runs from vertex i to the next one). Both are -1 when Archicad created it.

PolylineAncestry.description: Read from the vertexAncestry and edgeAncestry of Archicad's API_RegularizedPoly; -1 marks a vertex or edge that Archicad created (for example at a self-intersection).

edges.description: For each segment of the result (segment i runs from point i to point i+1), the index of the input segment it came from.

vertices.description: For each point of the result, the index of the input point it came from.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

PolylineEdgeAncestry.description: An input point or segment by its index (segment i runs from point i to point i+1); -1 when Archicad created it.

PolylineSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Polyline. Setting coordinates replaces the entire polygon (single contour, no holes) and may change the number of vertices.

PolylineVertexAncestry.description: An input point or segment by its index (segment i runs from point i to point i+1); -1 when Archicad created it.

PossibleEnumValues.description: The possible enum values of the property when the property type is enumeration.

PossibleNumericValues.description: The possible numeric values of a GDL parameter.

description.description: The description of the value.

stepBegin.description: Only present when flag is 'Step': the value is stepBegin + n*stepValue for n >= 0.

stepValue.description: Only present when flag is 'Step' - see stepBegin.

value.description: The numeric value. Present for all flags except 'Step', which instead carries stepBegin/stepValue.

PossibleStringValues.description: The possible string values of a GDL parameter.

name.description: The name of the selected printer.

portrait.description: The selected orientation: true for portrait, false for landscape.

PrinterPrintArea.description: The area Archicad prints, as set in the print settings. 'unknown' for a value this add-on does not name.

skins.description: The profile's skins (hatches), each with its building material/surface/fill, contour and cut-end line settings, and per-edge line data.

ProfileAttributeOrError.description: A profile attribute or an error.

ProfileEdge.description: One edge of a profile skin's outline.

isCutEndLine.description: Whether the edge is a cut end line of the profile (GetProfiles' edges[].isCutEndLine).

isInnerLine.description: Whether the edge is an inner line of the profile (GetProfiles' edges[].isInnerLine).

ProfileModifier.description: A stretchable edge-offset parameter of the profile, as named by the profile's author in the Profile Editor. Its value is a live geometric measurement matching what the Profile Editor's dimension shows.

name.description: User-authored label, e.g. 'Largeur support'. Present only if the profile's author assigned one.

value.description: Present only when the parameter's dimension anchors could be resolved to concrete positions.

ProfileSkin.description: One skin (hatch) of the profile's cross-section.

outlineArcs.description: Marks which consecutive outlineCoords pairs are connected by an arc instead of a straight edge.

outlineCoords.description: The skin's outline polygon vertices, present only when the skinOutlines field is requested alongside skins.

outlineSubPolyEnds.description: Index (into outlineCoords) of the last vertex of each contour, for skins whose outline has holes or multiple contours.

skinId.description: Internal identifier of this skin, stable for the lifetime of the profile. Pass it back in CreateProfiles' skinOverrides to target this skin for modification.

polygonArcs.description: Optional arcs along this contour's edges. begIndex/endIndex are 0-based positions within this contour's own polygonCoordinates.

ProfileSkinData.description: One new skin (hatch). Its shape is one or more closed polygon contours: the first is the outer boundary, any further ones are holes cut out of it - the same polygon+holes convention as e.g. CreateSlabs' polygonCoordinates/polygonArcs/holes, just expressed as a list of contours instead of a separate holes array.

contours.description: Closed polygon contours forming this skin's cross-section, in the Profile's local coordinate system. Each contour is closed automatically - do not repeat its first vertex at the end.

edgeOverrides.description: Per-edge pen/visibility/line type, targeted by 0-based edge index. Edge indices follow the same order as this skin's contours/polygonCoordinates: the outer contour's edges first (one edge per vertex, wrapping around), then each hole's, in the order the contours were given. Verify exact indices for a created skin via a follow-up GetProfiles call's skins[].edges before relying on them.

attributesByType.description: One item per requested attribute type, in the order of attributeTypes.

clientOnly.description: True when the project data is kept on this client only and is not shared in Teamwork.

guid.description: The identifier of the add-on object that stores the project data.

name.description: The name of the project data.

teamworkOwner.description: The Teamwork user who has reserved the project data. Omitted when nobody has reserved it or the project is not a Teamwork project.

name.description: The name of the project data.

content.description: The content of the project data.

name.description: The name of the project data.

clientOnly.description: Creates the project data on this client only, it is not shared in Teamwork. Used only when the project data is created. The default is false.

content.description: The content of the project data, for example a JSON string.

name.description: The name of the project data.

unique.description: Creates the project data as a unique add-on object: in Teamwork only one can exist with its name, even when several users create it at the same time. Used only when the project data is created, and cannot be combined with clientOnly. The default is false.

projectInfoId.description: The id of the project info field.

projectInfoName.description: The name of the project info field visible on UI.

projectInfoValue.description: The value of the project info field.

projectInfoGroupId.description: The Project Info group to create the field in. Available from Archicad 30, where the field goes to the first group when omitted; on older versions giving it is an error.

projectInfoName.description: Display name of the project info field.

projectInfoValue.description: Initial value of the project info field.

ProjectInfoFieldId.description: The identifier of a field of a Project Info group. It is not the autotext key that GetProjectInfoFields returns as projectInfoId. Available from Archicad 30.

ProjectInfoFields.description: A list of project info fields.

fields.description: The fields of the group in their order, including the subfields of calculated fields (e.g. the address components of a full address field).

name.description: The name of the group.
The name of the field visible on UI.

projectInfoId.description: The autotext key of the field, as GetProjectInfoFields returns it and SetProjectInfoField takes it. Given when exactly one project info autotext has the name of the field, omitted otherwise.

value.description: The value of the field. The value of a field with subfields is calculated from the subfields.

ProjectInfoGroupId.description: The identifier of a Project Info group. Available from Archicad 30.

ProjectInfoGroupIdOrError.description: A Project Info group identifier or an error.

ProjectInfoGroupIdsOrErrors.description: A list of Project Info group identifiers or errors.

beforeProjectInfoGroupId.description: The group to move the group before. When omitted, the group is moved to the end of the group list.

name.description: The new name of the group. It must not be used by another group.

ProjectInfoGroups.description: The Project Info groups in their order in the Project Info dialog. Available from Archicad 30.

ProjectionSunSettings.description: The sun position of a 3D projection, the Sun Position of the 3D Projection Settings dialog (API_SunAngleSettings). Each perspective and axonometry has its own, independent of the project's date and time (SetSunSettings). The 3D shading and shadows of the projection come from it.

day.description: Used when sunPositionOption is DateAndTime. 0 when no date is set.

month.description: Used when sunPositionOption is DateAndTime. 0 when no date is set.

summerTime.description: True when the time is daylight saving time.

sunAltitude.description: The altitude of the sun, used when sunPositionOption is Angles. In the same units Get3DProjectionSettings returns it.

sunAzimuth.description: The azimuth of the sun, used when sunPositionOption is Angles. In the same units Get3DProjectionSettings returns it.

sunPositionOption.description: Angles: the sun is at sunAzimuth and sunAltitude. DateAndTime: Archicad calculates the sun from the project location and the date and time given here.

year.description: Used when sunPositionOption is DateAndTime. 0 when no date is set.

PropertyAvailabilityUpdate.description: Classification items the property is available for: set replaces the list, add and remove edit it.

availability.description: The identifiers of classification items the new property is available for.

defaultValue.description: The default value of the new property. Optional; when omitted, the default value is Undefined.

group.description: The property group defined by name or id. If both fields exists the id will be used.

PropertyDefinitionArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a property definition

defaultValue.description: New default value: a basic value or expressions. Switching between the two is allowed.

description.description: New description of the property.

enumOrder.description: Every option's display text, once, in the new order (applied after rename, remove and add).

expressions.description: The new expression strings for the property. Only for expression-based properties.

groupId.description: Move the property into this custom property group.

isEditable.description: Whether users may edit the value of the property on elements (Property Manager: Editable).

name.description: New name of the property.

possibleEnumValues.description: Values already on the property keep their identifier, so element values assigned to them survive; values not listed here are kept as well.

removeEnumValues.description: Enum options to remove. Elements holding a removed option lose that value.

renameEnumValues.description: Change the text of existing enum options. The option keeps its identifier, so element values follow the new text.

availability.description: Classification items a custom property is available for.

defaultEnumValueIds.description: The option guids an enumeration property's default holds. Only for custom enumeration properties whose default is set.

defaultValueDisplay.description: The basic default value as text. Only for custom, non expression-based properties whose default is set.

expressions.description: The expression strings of an expression-based property. Only present when isExpressionBased is true.

isExpressionBased.description: True if the property value is computed from an expression.

PropertyGroupArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing a property group

PropertyGroupId.description: The identifier of a property group.

PropertyGroupIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property group identifier.

PropertyIdArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property identifier.

PropertyImportConflictPolicy.description: What to do with a property whose name already exists in its group: append imports it under a new unused name, replace replaces the existing definition, skip keeps the existing one.

PropertyValue.description: The string value of a property, formatted according to the command's options.

PropertyValueArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueDetails.description: A normal, userUndefined, notAvailable or notEvaluated property value.

PropertyValueErrorItem.description: An error in place of a property value.

isAvailable.description: Whether the property is available for the element. Only returned when includeAvailability is true.

PropertyValueOrErrorItem.description: A property value or an error

PropertyValuesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing the property values.

PropertyValuesOrError.description: A list of property values or an error.

PropertyValuesOrErrorArray.description: A list of property value lists.

bottomOffset.description: The base height of the railing relative to the floor level.

contourPen.description: Pen index of the railing's contour line (API_RailingType::contourPen).

height.description: The segment height new segments of the railing are made with (the default segment).

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, Archicad recomputes 'visibility' automatically from the actual elevation of the railing (API_RailingType::isAutoOnStoryVisibility).

referenceLine.description: The 2D coordinates of the reference line of the railing, one per node.

referenceLinePen.description: Pen index of the railing's reference line (API_RailingType::referenceLinePen).

segmentHeights.description: The height of each segment of the railing, in the order of the reference line.

visibility.description: The stories the railing is shown on (API_RailingType::visibility).

zCoordinate.description: The absolute elevation of the base of the railing.

polygonCoordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline, without a closing coordinate.

polygons.description: The valid polygons Archicad made of the input: none, one or more.

arcs.description: The arcs of the regularized polyline.

coordinates.description: The 2D coordinates of the regularized polyline. Empty when nothing valid is left of it.

name.description: Name of the renovation filter.

renovationFilterId.description: Identifier of the renovation filter. The same identifier is the renovationFilterGuid of GetViewSettings and SetViewSettings.

name.description: The name of the status as the running Archicad shows it (localized).

firstRevisionIssueId.description: The identifier of the first issue in which the given change is issued.

customSchemeKey.description: The identifier of the custom field. The same key is used in the customSchemeData of the revision changes.

customSchemeName.description: The name of the custom field.

RevisionChangesArrayItem.description: A wrapper containing an array of revision changes

RevisionChangesOfEntities.description: The revision changes of the requested entities, in the order of the input, or an error for an entity whose changes could not be retrieved.

RevisionIssueId.description: The identifier of a revision issue.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

angle.description: Single-plane: the slope in radians.

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the roof's contour (API_ShellBaseType::ltypeInd) - pairs with contourPen.

cutBodyType.description: How the roof's body is extended for connections with other elements (API_ShellBaseType::cutBodyType, on the Model panel of Roof Settings).

eavesOverhang.description: Multi-plane: the eaves overhang beyond the pivot polygon.

edgeSideMaterials.description: The custom side surface of each edge of the roof's polygon: the edges of polygonOutline first, then those of each hole in order, the item i of a polygon belonging to its edge from vertex i to vertex i + 1.

edgeTrims.description: Single-plane roofs only: the cut of each edge of the roof's polygon, in the order of edgeSideMaterials. ModifyRoofs takes the same list.

fillVisibility.description: The stories the roof's cover fill is shown on (API_ShellBaseType::visibilityFill).

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, Archicad recomputes 'visibility' and 'fillVisibility' automatically from the roof's vertical extent.

level.description: Height of the pivot line (single-plane) or the pivot polygon (multi-plane) above the floor level.

levels.description: Multi-plane: the roof levels, each with its height above the previous and its slope in radians.

materialsChained.description: Whether the surface materials are chained.

pivotEdges.description: Multi-plane roofs only: the roof planes of each edge of the pivot polygon. Item i belongs to the edge from vertex i to vertex i + 1 of pivotPolygonOutline; for a pivot polygon with holes, the edges of each hole follow, contour by contour.

levels.description: The roof plane of the edge on each level, from the pivot polygon upwards.

angle.description: Angle of the plane to the XY plane.

angleType.description: Gable for a vertical gable plane, Sloped otherwise.

eavesOverhang.description: Extension of the eaves outside the pivot polygon.

pivotPolygonOutline.description: Multi-plane: the pivot polygon the planes rise from. Arcs are not carried; a curved pivot edge comes back as its end points.

polygonOutline.description: The roof's polygon: the plane roof's outline, the multi-plane roof's contour.

sectionContourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the roof's contour where it is cut (API_ShellBaseType::sectContLtype) - pairs with sectionContourPen.

sectionContourPen.description: Pen of the roof's contour where it is cut (API_ShellBaseType::sectContPen).

visibility.description: The stories the roof's contour is shown on (API_ShellBaseType::visibilityCont).

RoofDetailsPivotLine.description: The pivot line about which a roof plane rotates.

RoofEdgeTrim.description: How an edge of a single-plane roof's polygon is cut (the edge's cut in the roof's settings).

angle.description: The angle of the edge cut in radians, as Archicad stores it. Only CustomAngle uses it.

trimType.description: Vertical, Perpendicular to the roof plane, Horizontal, or at 'angle' (CustomAngle). AlignWithCut is only reported, for shell edges; it cannot be written to a roof.

RoofOrShellRelationsOfElement.description: Relations of a roof or shell: the connected zones.

RoofPivotLine.description: A directed pivot line defined by its beginning and end coordinates. The roof plane rises on the left side of the line direction (begCoordinate towards endCoordinate); reverse the direction to tilt towards the other side.

RoofQuantities.description: Quantities of a Roof element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

bottomSurface.description: Net bottom surface of the roof.

bottomSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional bottom surface of the roof.

contourArea.description: Area of the roof contour polygon.

edgeSurface.description: Net surface of the edges of the roof.

grossBottomSurface.description: Gross bottom surface of the roof.

grossEdgeSurface.description: Gross surface of the edges of the roof.

grossTopSurface.description: Gross top surface of the roof.

hipsLength.description: Length of the hip edges (divided by 2, as Archicad reports it).

holesPerimeter.description: Total perimeter of the holes in the roof.

holesSurface.description: Total area of the holes in the roof.

openingsSurface.description: Total surface of the roof openings.

ridgesLength.description: Length of the ridge edges (divided by 2, as Archicad reports it).

topSurface.description: Net top surface of the roof.

topSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional top surface of the roof.

valleysLength.description: Length of the valley edges (divided by 2, as Archicad reports it).

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the roof.

h.description: Horizontal pixel position from the left edge of the view window.

v.description: Vertical pixel position from the top edge of the view window.

h.description: Horizontal pixel position from the left edge of the view window.

v.description: Vertical pixel position from the top edge of the view window.

SectionDetails.description: The geometry of a Section (CutPlane) or Elevation marker on the floor plan; for sections the fields CreateSections takes. Archicad stores both the same way.

depth.description: The distance of the first depth point from the first segment of the section or elevation line (depth of CreateSections).

depthCoordinates.description: The points of the depth line, the far boundary of the section or elevation. Empty when it cannot be read.

endCoordinate.description: The last point of the section or elevation line (endCoordinate of CreateSections).

idStr.description: The reference ID of the section or elevation.

mainCoordinates.description: The points of the section or elevation line, from start to end. More than two for a broken section line. Empty when the line cannot be read.

name.description: The name of the section or elevation.

startCoordinate.description: The first point of the section or elevation line (startCoordinate of CreateSections).

viewDirection.description: The unit vector perpendicular to the first segment of the section or elevation line, pointing to the side of the depth line: the direction the section or elevation looks in. CreateSections puts it to the left of the start to end direction.

SectionElevationDetails.description: Full readable state of a Section or Elevation element: every field of SectionElevationSettableDetails, plus its name and reference ID and read-only/informational fields.

beginMarkerElementId.description: Read-only: the Section Marker object at the starting point of the section line.

boundaryLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the boundary contour.

continuous.description: Continuous line if true, otherwise segmented.

currentPlanConnectivity.description: Read-only: current plan connectivity state of the open Section/Elevation window.

distantAreaPenIndex.description: Pen index of elements in the distant area.

distantAreaShadowFillBackgroundPenIndex.description: Read-only: fill background pen index for shadow polygons in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: always mirrors shadowFillBackgroundPenIndex, cannot be set independently (see distantAreaShadowFillId).

distantAreaShadowFillId.description: Read-only: fill attribute for shadow polygons in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: this always mirrors shadowFillId and cannot be set independently through the API (ACAPI_Element_CreateExt/ACAPI_Element_Change silently ignore an explicit value here and copy it from shadowFillId instead).

distantAreaShadowFillPenIndex.description: Read-only: fill pen index for shadow polygons in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: always mirrors shadowFillPenIndex, cannot be set independently (see distantAreaShadowFillId).

distantAreaUncutSurfaceFillBackgroundPen.description: Pencolor for uncut surface fills in the distant area if a uniform pencolor is selected.

distantAreaUncutSurfaceFillType.description: Read-only: method for displaying fills of uncut surfaces in the distant area. Confirmed live on Archicad 27: cannot be set independently through the API, always reads back as PenColor regardless of the value written (see distantAreaShadowFillId).

effectSunFrom3D.description: Use the same Sun parameters as in the 3D window.

endMarkerElementId.description: Read-only: the Section Marker object at the end point of the section line.

fontIndex.description: Font index of the marker text.

id.description: The reference ID shown in the marker and in the Project Map. If it contains a '/' character, the text is split between the beginning and end marks. ModifySections changes it.

intendedPlanConnectivity.description: Intended plan connectivity: whether the Section/Elevation is automatically rebuilt from the model (Online), rebuilt only on demand (Offline), or exploded into unlinked 2D drawing elements (Drawing).

isActive.description: Read-only: whether the segment is turned off or active.

isInDrawingMode.description: Read-only: whether the section is in drawing mode.

isSourceMarker.description: Read-only: whether this segment is a source marker.

isWindowOpened.description: Read-only: whether the Section/Elevation window is currently opened.

limitLinePenIndex.description: Pen index of the horizontal limit line.

limitLineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the horizontal limit line.

linePenIndex.description: Pen index of the section/elevation line.

lineTypeId.description: Line type attribute of the section/elevation line.

markerShowType.description: Show side (wing) markers or a single middle marker.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

index1.description: Optional 1-based first index for changing a single item of an array parameter. Only valid for array parameters and only together with a single (non-list) value.

index2.description: Optional 1-based second index for changing a single item of a two-dimensional array parameter. Only valid together with index1. Defaults to 1.

value.description: The new value of the parameter, in the unit GetGDLParametersOfElements reports it in (Angle parameters in radians). For array parameters provide a list of values for one-dimensional arrays (e.g. [1, 2, 3]) or a list of lists for two-dimensional arrays (e.g. [[11, 12], [21, 22]]); the list must contain exactly as many values as the parameter has items, resizing an array parameter is not supported. A two-dimensional array can also be given as a flat list of all its dimension1 x dimension2 items row by row, the layout GetGDLParametersOfElements returns. Alternatively provide index1 (and optionally index2) together with a single value to change one item of the array. Within one command call whole-array (list) values are applied after all single-value changes.

index1.description: Optional 1-based first index for changing a single item of an array parameter. Only valid for array parameters and only together with a single (non-list) value.

index2.description: Optional 1-based second index for changing a single item of a two-dimensional array parameter. Only valid together with index1. Defaults to 1.

ShellBaseFloorFill.description: Floor plan cover fill settings of a Roof or Shell (API_ShellBaseType).

use.description: Whether the cover fill is shown on the floor plan.

use3DHatching.description: Use the fill of the surface material (Vectorial 3D Hatch) as the cover fill.

useFillLocBaseLine.description: Align the cover fill with the pivot line instead of the fill handle.

useSlantedFill.description: Distort the cover fill to show the slope as seen from above.

ShellCutPolygon.description: A closed polygon cutting a shell: its clipping contour or a hole.

arcs.description: Arc segments of the polygon, with indices into coordinates.

coordinates.description: The points of the polygon, in the XY plane of 'plane'.

depth.description: Required for holes, ignored for the clipping contour: how far the cutting body is extruded from the polygon's plane, along its Z axis (negative values cut downwards).

plane.description: The plane of the polygon, in the coordinates of the shell's base plane: a hole is extruded from it along its Z axis. The base plane itself by default.

aboveViewLinePen.description: Pen used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type used when "Overhead All" is selected from the "Floor Plan Display" popup - pairs with aboveViewLinePen.

contourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the shell's uncut contour on the floor plan (API_ShellBaseType::ltypeInd).

contourPen.description: Pen of the shell's uncut contour on the floor plan (API_ShellBaseType::pen).

cutBodyType.description: How the body is extended for connections (Model panel). A shell uses Editable, UpwardsExtrusion or DownwardsExtrusion.

fillVisibility.description: The stories the shell's cover fill is shown on (API_ShellBaseType::visibilityFill).

isAutoOnStoryVisibility.description: When true, Archicad recomputes the story visibility automatically from the shell's vertical extent.

sectionContourLineTypeId.description: Line type of the contour of the cut surfaces (API_ShellBaseType::sectContLtype).

sectionContourPen.description: Pen of the contour of the cut surfaces (API_ShellBaseType::sectContPen).

visibility.description: The stories the shell's contour is shown on (API_ShellBaseType::visibilityCont).

ShellEdgeTrim.description: How a shell edge is cut.

angle.description: The trim angle in radians. Only CustomAngle uses it; pi/2 by default.

trimType.description: Vertical, Perpendicular or Horizontal to the shell, or at 'angle' (CustomAngle).

ShellProfile.description: A profile polyline of a shell, in the XY plane of its coordinate system.

arcs.description: Arc segments of the polyline, with indices into coordinates; index len(coordinates) is the first point again, which closes the polyline.

closed.description: Whether the segment from the last point back to the first one is part of the profile. False by default.

ShellQuantities.description: Quantities of a Shell element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

floorPlanArea.description: Projected floor plan area of the contour polygon.

grossOppositeSurface.description: Gross area of the opposite surface.

grossReferenceSurface.description: Gross area of the reference surface.

oppositeSurface.description: Net area of the surface opposite to the reference.

oppositeSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional area of the opposite surface.

referenceSurface.description: Net area of the reference surface.

referenceSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional area of the reference surface.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the shell.

SkylightDetails.description: The details of a Skylight: the settings CreateSkylights and ModifySkylights write, plus the library part, the owner and anchorLevel, which are only read.

aboveViewLineTypeId.description: Line type of the overhead lines.

anchorLevel.description: The global Z coordinate of the anchor point. Only read; Archicad sets it from the owner.

anchorPoint.description: Which point of the skylight anchorPosition places.

anchorPosition.description: Global XY coordinates of the skylight's anchor point.

azimuthAngle.description: Rotation angle in the horizontal plane, measured clockwise, in radians.

belowViewLineTypeId.description: Line type of the uncut lines.

cutLineTypeId.description: Line type of the cut lines of the skylight.

elevationAngle.description: Elevation angle of the owner's surface at the skylight, in radians.

fixMode.description: What the skylight keeps when the angle or the height of its owner changes.

lineTypeId.description: Line type of the skylight's floor plan symbol; used unless useObjectLineTypes is true.

pen.description: Pen of the skylight's floor plan symbol; used unless useObjectPens is true.

sectionFillId.description: Fill of the section of the skylight; used unless useObjectSectionAttributes is true.

surfaceId.description: Surface of the skylight; used unless useObjectMaterials is true.

polygonOutline.description: The 2D coordinates of the outline of the hole, as Archicad returns them. The outline is closed implicitly (the first vertex is not repeated at the end); a curved edge is given by its end points only.

level.description: Distance of the reference level of the slab from the floor level.

offsetFromTop.description: Vertical distance between the reference level and the top of the slab.

polygonArcs.description: Polygon outline arcs of the slab.

SlabQuantities.description: Quantities of a Slab element, as calculated by Archicad. Lengths in meters, areas in square meters, volumes in cubic meters.

bottomSurface.description: Net bottom surface of the slab.

bottomSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional bottom surface of the slab.

edgeSurface.description: Net surface of the edges of the slab.

grossBottomSurface.description: Gross bottom surface of the slab.

grossEdgeSurface.description: Gross surface of the edges of the slab.

grossTopSurface.description: Gross top surface of the slab.

holesPerimeter.description: Total perimeter of the holes in the slab.

holesSurface.description: Total area of the holes in the slab.

topSurface.description: Net top surface of the slab.

topSurfaceConditional.description: Conditional top surface of the slab.

volumeConditional.description: Conditional net volume of the slab.

SlabReferencePlaneLocation.description: Location of the slab reference plane.

SnapFilter.description: Which points and lines of the elements the cursor snaps to while the designer clicks (Archicad's neig filter). Without it, the cursor snaps as usual.

base.description: What the cursor snaps to before include and exclude are applied: All = everything, None = nothing, Edges = only the lines and edges of the elements, Nodes = only their points (end points, vertices, hotspots). Default: None when include is given, otherwise All.

exclude.description: The cursor does not snap to these. Applied after include.

include.description: The cursor also snaps to these.

SnapType.description: A kind of point or line the cursor can snap to. An element type name means the element's points (end points, vertices, corners, hotspots); with On it means its lines and edges (for walls the reference line). Hotspot is a hotspot element, Text the corners of a text, Label the points of a label, Dimension a dimension point and DimensionOn the dimension line.

targetId.description: The element to be cut or modified.

SolidLinkFlags.description: Flags controlling the behaviour of a solid element operation link.

inheritOperatorAttributes.description: If true, the target element inherits the attributes of the operator element.

skipPolygonHoles.description: If true, holes of the operator (roof/slab) are ignored during the operation.

solidLinksWithTheGivenOperator.description: Links where the given element is the operator (performing the cut).

linkTime.description: When the solid link was made, as a date and time string formatted like the times of revision issues. Omitted when Archicad does not report it.

solidLinksWithTheGivenTarget.description: Links where the given element is the target (being cut or modified).

linkTime.description: When the solid link was made, as a date and time string formatted like the times of revision issues. Omitted when Archicad does not report it.

SolidOperationType.description: The type of solid element operation.

path.description: The path of the special folder in the filesystem.

SpecialFolderPathOrError.description: The path of a special folder or an error.

SpecialFolderPathsOrErrors.description: A list of special folder paths or errors.

SpecialFolderType.description: The type of a special folder of the running Archicad.

SplineDetails.description: Geometry of a Spline element. Geometry is read-only: Archicad's own API does not support modifying Spline geometry via ACAPI_Element_Change. The settings fields (roomSeparator/linePenIndex/lineTypeId) ARE modifiable via SET.

roomSeparator.description: Is this a zone boundary line?

SplineSettings.description: Settings for modifying a Spline. Only these settings fields are modifiable - Archicad's own API does not support changing Spline geometry (coordinates/closed) via ACAPI_Element_Change.

StairBaselineData.description: The parameters of the Stair to check. Fields that are not given come from the current Stair tool defaults, as in CreateStairs.

baseLinePoints.description: 2D coordinates of the stair baseline polyline. Whether the baseline runs along the left edge, the right edge or the center of the flight is the Stair tool's baseline position, taken from the Stair tool defaults: with the baseline on the left edge, the flight lies to the right of it, looking from the first point to the last. The first point is kept; the length of the flight comes from the riser count and going, so the flight does not necessarily end at the last point given. Minimum 2 points for a straight stair, 3+ for L-shaped or U-shaped stairs.

finishVisible.description: Optional. If false, the tread/riser finishes are hidden and only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is modeled.

floorIndex.description: Optional floor index. If omitted, derived from zCoordinate.

zCoordinate.description: The Z coordinate (absolute elevation) of the stair base.

baseLineArcs.description: The arcs of the baseline after the solver ran, indexing baseLinePoints. Present only when the baseline has arcs.

baseLinePoints.description: The baseline polyline after the solver ran.

flightWidth.description: Width of the stair flight after the solver ran.

riserHeight.description: Height of each riser after the solver ran.

stepNum.description: Number of risers after the solver ran.

totalHeight.description: Total height of the stair after the solver ran.

treadDepth.description: Depth (going) of each tread after the solver ran.

StairBaselineSolutionState.description: Correct: the baseline was already valid, nothing changed. Solved: the solver turned it into a valid baseline, returned in baseLinePoints. NotSolved: no valid baseline was found; CreateStairs is likely to fail or create an invalid stair with this input.

StairDetails.description: The settings of a Stair element: the ones CreateStairs takes, and its floor plan and section display (stairDisplayType and the fields after it), which no command writes yet. The finishes and the structure are modeled by the Stair's subelements (risers, treads and structures), which GetSubelementsOfHierarchicalElements lists.

baseLineArcs.description: The curved segments of the baseline, present only when it has any.

baseLineEdges.description: The segment type of each baseline edge, one item per edge (edge i runs from baseLinePoints[i] to baseLinePoints[i + 1]), as CreateStairs takes them.

baseLinePoints.description: The baseline polyline the stair is placed along, in model coordinates, as given to CreateStairs.

baseLineVertices.description: The turn at each baseline point, one item per point, as CreateStairs takes them. A stair whose turns Archicad decided itself reports Landing at every point, also at the first and last.

landingEndEdgeOffset.description: The trail edge offset of the landing as Archicad calculated it.

landingStartEdgeOffset.description: The lead edge offset of the landing as Archicad calculated it.

finishVisible.description: Whether the tread/riser finishes are modeled. If false only the stair structure (e.g. a monolith) is.

floorPlanLayout.description: The floor plan display of the stair's components (API_StairType::fpdLayout).

level.description: Height of the stair base above the home story level.

monolithStructureSymbols.description: The symbol lines and fills of a monolithic structure, one item per view and visible or hidden part (API_StairType::monolithStructureSymbolData).

reflectedCeilingPlanLayout.description: The reflected ceiling plan display of the stair's components (API_StairType::rcpdLayout).

stairDisplayType.description: Whether the floor plan display of the stair is set in the stair itself (Custom) or comes from the Model View Options (ByModelViewOptions) (API_StairType::stairDisplayType).

structureSymbols.description: The symbol lines and fills of the stair's structure, one item per structure type and view (API_StairType::structSymbData).

hiddenFillId.description: Fill type of the hidden structure; left out when not set.

hiddenLineTypeId.description: Line type of the hidden structure lines; left out when not set.

visibleFillId.description: Fill type of the visible structure; left out when not set.

visibleLineTypeId.description: Line type of the visible structure lines; left out when not set.

structureVisibility.description: Whether the structure of the stair is shown on the floor plan (API_StairType::structureVisibility).

structureVisibilityOnStories.description: Which structure symbols are shown on which of the stair's relevant stories, one item per view (API_StairType::structureVisibilityOnStories).

stories.description: One item per story range relative to the stair's relevant stories (API_StairStructSymbRelevantStoriesID).

fills.description: Whether the fills of each structure type are shown, per visible or hidden part.

monolithParts.description: Which parts of a monolithic structure are shown, per visible or hidden part.

structures.description: Whether the lines of each structure are shown, per visible or hidden part.

treadDepth.description: The tread depth (going) stored in the Stair's settings. Archicad does not keep it in step with the modeled treads: a placed stair can read 0 or 1 here, so take the modeled going from the geometry of its treads or risers (Get3DGeometryOfElements) instead.

zCoordinate.description: Absolute elevation of the stair base.

StairGridType.description: How a stair's symbol is drawn on a story (API_StairGridTypeID).

StairLayout.description: The floor plan or reflected ceiling plan display of a Stair's components (API_StairLayoutData).

breakLineAngle.description: The angle of the break line, used when breakLineAngleType is AngleToVertical or AngleToHorizontal.

breakLineAngleNumberOfGoings.description: The number of goings the break line crosses, used when breakLineAngleType is NumberOfGoings.

breakLineDistance.description: The gap of the break line.

gridTypeAbove.description: The symbol shown on the stories above the stair's relevant stories.

gridTypeBelow.description: The symbol shown on the stories below the stair's relevant stories.

gridTypeBottom.description: The symbol shown on the bottom relevant story.

gridTypeMiddle.description: The symbol shown on the middle relevant stories.

gridTypeTop.description: The symbol shown on the top relevant story.

lineTypeId.description: The override line type; left out when not set.

lowerBreakLineCustomPosition.description: The height of the lower break line, used when breakLinePositionType is CustomHeight.

lowerBreakLineNthRiserPosition.description: The riser of the lower break line, used when breakLinePositionType is AtNthRiser.

overrideLineType.description: Whether lineTypeId overrides the line types of the stair's components.

overridePen.description: Whether pen overrides the line pens of the stair's components.

overrideSymbolFill.description: Whether symbolFillId and its pens override the symbol fills of the stair's components.

storyVisibility.description: The stories the stair is shown on.

symbolFillId.description: The override symbol fill type; left out when not set.

upperBreakLineCustomPosition.description: The height of the upper break line, used when breakLinePositionType is CustomHeight.

upperBreakLineNthRiserPosition.description: The riser of the upper break line, used when breakLinePositionType is AtNthRiser.

StairSymbolPart.description: Whether a stair structure symbol setting is for the visible or the hidden part of the structure (API_StairStructSymbPartID).

StairSymbolView.description: The view a stair structure symbol setting belongs to (API_StairStructSymbViewID).

dimension1.description: The 1st dimension of array (in case of array value).

dimension2.description: The 2nd dimension of array (in case of array value).

displayName.description: The display name of the parameter.

index.description: The index of the parameter.

itemDescriptions.description: Per-item text labels for an array-type parameter, one per array element in dim1xdim2 order. Only present when the library part defines them.

name.description: The name of the parameter.

type.description: The type of the parameter.

value.description: The value of the parameter.

valueDescription.description: The value description for numeric parameter.

StoriesParameters.description: A list of project stories, each with their complete parameters.

StoriesSettings.description: A list of story settings, used as input for creating or modifying multiple stories.

StoryParameters.description: Represents all parameters of a single project story, including its unique identifiers. Used in API responses.

dispOnSections.description: Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.

height.description: Story height, calculated as the level of the story above minus this story's level. The topmost story gets its height from the virtual story that Archicad keeps above it in the story settings; only an Archicad that did not report that virtual story would leave the top story without a height.

ifcId.description: The IFC GlobalId of the story, i.e. of the IfcBuildingStorey it is exported as (the same identifier the IFC Project Manager shows). Available from Archicad 28; older versions omit it.

index.description: The story index.

level.description: The story level.

name.description: The name of the story.

dispOnSections.description: Story level lines should appear on sections and elevations.

index.description: The story index. Optional. The stories are matched to the existing ones positionally, from the bottom up. Giving the index of any of them pins the numbering of the whole list, so stories below the existing structure - basements with negative indices - can be requested as well. When given for more than one story, the indices must be consecutive.

level.description: The story level.

name.description: The name of the story.

showAllAbove.description: Show on all stories above the home story.

showAllBelow.description: Show on all stories below the home story.

showRelAbove.description: Show this many stories above the home story (ignored when showAllAbove is true).

showRelBelow.description: Show this many stories below the home story (ignored when showAllBelow is true).

backgroundAsInRendering.description: The background is the same as in the rendering settings.

backgroundSkyColor.description: The sky color of the background (API_3DStyle.bkgSkyColor).

castShadowPercent.description: The intensity of the cast shadows, in percent.

chainBackgroundColors.description: The sky and the ground background colors are chained.

contourThickness.description: The thickness of the contours, in pixels.

engineId.description: The id of the 3D rendering engine (API_3DStyle.engineId).

model3D.description: The 3D model type: Block, Wireframe, Hidden Line or Shading, as the integer value of API_3DModelTypeID.

monochromeContourColor.description: The contour color of the monochrome model.

monochromeEnabled.description: The model is shown in monochrome colors.

monochromeSurfaceColor.description: The surface color of the monochrome model.

name.description: The name of the 3D style, unique within the project.

shadingContours.description: The contours in shaded mode, as the integer value of API_ShadingContoursID.

shadingPercent.description: The intensity of the shading, in percent.

shadowContourThickness.description: The thickness of the shadow contours, in pixels.

shadowElevation.description: The elevation of the shadow plane, used by the one level vectorial sun shadow options.

silhouetteThickness.description: The thickness of the silhouettes, in pixels.

vectorialHatchingThickness.description: The thickness of the vectorial hatching, in pixels.

vectorialSunShadow.description: The vectorial sun shadow options, as the integer value of API_VectorShadowID.

SuccessfulExecutionResult.description: The result of a successful execution.
